name: PaperC.Affine.card_solution_eq_card_ker

name: PaperC.Affine.card_solution_eq_ite
statement:
theorem card_solution_eq_ite
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (b : W) :
    Fintype.card (Solution A b) =
      if Compatible A b then
        2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.ker A)
      else
        0

name: PaperC.Affine.affineFiber_fourier_identity
statement:
theorem affineFiber_fourier_identity
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂)) (b : β → 𝔽₂) :
    (Fintype.card (β → 𝔽₂) : ℤ) *
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun x : V => A x = b).card : ℤ) =
      (Fintype.card V : ℤ) * relationSignedSum A b

name: PaperC.Affine.sum_binarySign_linear

    ∑ x : U, binarySign (f x) =
      if f = 0 then (Fintype.card U : ℤ) else 0

    |(relationEta A b : ℤ) * (2 : ℤ) ^ relationRho A - 1| ≤

name: PaperC.Affine.affineFiber_normalized_card_identity
statement:
theorem affineFiber_normalized_card_identity

    (2 : ℤ) ^ Fintype.card β *
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun x : V => A x = b).card : ℤ) =
      (Fintype.card V : ℤ) *
        ((relationEta A b : ℤ) * (2 : ℤ) ^ relationRho A)

name: PaperC.Affine.startEdgeParity_eq_sum_incidence
statement:
theorem startEdgeParity_eq_sum_incidence
    (x p : ℕ) {L : ℕ} (i : Fin L) :
    startEdgeParity x p i =
      ∑ v : Fin (L + 1),
        startIncidenceColumn i v *
          parityVec (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v) p

name: PaperC.Affine.sum_startEdgeParity_eq_sum_completeBoundary
statement:
theorem sum_startEdgeParity_eq_sum_completeBoundary
    (x p : ℕ) {L : ℕ} (u : Fin L → F₂) :
    (∑ i : Fin L, u i * startEdgeParity x p i) =
      ∑ v : Fin (L + 1),
        startCompleteBoundary L u v *
          parityVec (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v) p

name: PaperC.Affine.sum_twoStartEdgeParity_eq_sum_completeBoundary
statement:
theorem sum_twoStartEdgeParity_eq_sum_completeBoundary
    (x y p : ℕ) {L : ℕ}
    (u : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L) → F₂) :
    (∑ s : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L),
        u s * twoStartEdgeParity x y p s) =
      ∑ v : Sum (Fin (L + 1)) (Fin (L + 1)),
        twoStartCompleteBoundary L u v *
          parityVec (twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L v) p

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartCompleteBoundary_apply_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartCompleteBoundary_apply_inl
    {L : ℕ} (u : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L) → F₂)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    twoStartCompleteBoundary L u (Sum.inl v) =
      startCompleteBoundary L (fun i => u (Sum.inl i)) v

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartCompleteBoundary_apply_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartCompleteBoundary_apply_inr
    {L : ℕ} (u : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L) → F₂)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    twoStartCompleteBoundary L u (Sum.inr v) =
      startCompleteBoundary L (fun i => u (Sum.inr i)) v

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartCompleteBoundary_injective
statement:
theorem twoStartCompleteBoundary_injective
    (L : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (twoStartCompleteBoundary L)

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartRhs_apply_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartRhs_apply_inl (L : ℕ) (i : Fin L) :
    twoStartRhs L (Sum.inl i) = startRhs L i

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartRhs_apply_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartRhs_apply_inr (L : ℕ) (i : Fin L) :
    twoStartRhs L (Sum.inr i) = startRhs L i

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartSystem_apply_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartSystem_apply_inl
    (M x y L : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace M) (i : Fin L) :
    twoStartSystem M x y L ω (Sum.inl i) =
      startSystem M x L ω i

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartSystem_apply_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartSystem_apply_inr
    (M x y L : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace M) (i : Fin L) :
    twoStartSystem M x y L ω (Sum.inr i) =
      startSystem M y L ω i

name: PaperC.Affine.twoStartSystem_eq_twoStartRhs_iff
statement:
theorem twoStartSystem_eq_twoStartRhs_iff
    {M x y L : ℕ} (ω : SampleSpace M) (hL : 0 < L) :
    twoStartSystem M x y L ω = twoStartRhs L ↔
      StartEvent (valueBit ω) x L ∧
        StartEvent (valueBit ω) y L

name: PaperC.Affine.existsUnique_startCompleteBoundary_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_startCompleteBoundary_eq
    {L : ℕ} {w : Fin (L + 1) → F₂}
    (hw : startVertexSum L w = 0) :
    ∃! u : Fin L → F₂, startCompleteBoundary L u = w

name: PaperC.Affine.range_startCompleteBoundary_eq_ker_startVertexSum
statement:
theorem range_startCompleteBoundary_eq_ker_startVertexSum
    (L : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (startCompleteBoundary L) =
      LinearMap.ker (startVertexSum L)

name: PaperC.Affine.startBoundaryEquivEven_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem startBoundaryEquivEven_apply_coe
    (L : ℕ) (u : Fin L → F₂) :
    ((startBoundaryEquivEven L u :
      LinearMap.ker (startVertexSum L)) :
        Fin (L + 1) → F₂) =
      startCompleteBoundary L u

name: PaperC.Affine.startBoundaryToEven_injective
statement:
theorem startBoundaryToEven_injective (L : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.Affine.startBoundaryToEven_surjective

theorem startBoundaryToEven_surjective (L : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.Affine.startVertexSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem startVertexSum_apply

name: PaperC.Affine.startVertexSum_startCompleteBoundary_eq_zero
statement:
theorem startVertexSum_startCompleteBoundary_eq_zero

name: PaperC.Affine.startVertexSum_surjective

theorem startVertexSum_surjective (L : ℕ) :

theorem sum_startIncidenceColumn_eq_zero

name: PaperC.channel_coefficients_le_length
statement:
theorem channel_coefficients_le_length
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hbox₁ : cell₁ ∈ offsetBox L)
    (hbox₂ : cell₂ ∈ offsetBox L)
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂)
    (hne : cell₁ ≠ cell₂) :
    a ≤ L ∧ b ≤ L

name: PaperC.channel_coefficients_le_length_of_mem
statement:
theorem channel_coefficients_le_length_of_mem
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hmem₁ : cell₁ ∈ channelCells L a b h)
    (hmem₂ : cell₂ ∈ channelCells L a b h)
    (hne : cell₁ ≠ cell₂) :
    a ≤ L ∧ b ≤ L

name: PaperC.channel_difference_eq_multiple
statement:
theorem channel_difference_eq_multiple
    {a b : ℕ} (_ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂) :
    ∃ t : ℤ,
      cell₁.1 - cell₂.1 = (b : ℤ) * t ∧
      cell₁.2 - cell₂.2 = (a : ℤ) * t

name: PaperC.channel_difference_identity
statement:
theorem channel_difference_identity
    {a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell₁ cell₂ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h₁ : OnChannel a b h cell₁)
    (h₂ : OnChannel a b h cell₂) :
    (a : ℤ) * (cell₁.1 - cell₂.1) =
      (b : ℤ) * (cell₁.2 - cell₂.2)

name: PaperC.mem_channelCells
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_channelCells {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ} :
    cell ∈ channelCells L a b h ↔
      cell ∈ offsetBox L ∧ OnChannel a b h cell

name: PaperC.mem_offsetBox
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offsetBox {L : ℕ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ} :
    cell ∈ offsetBox L ↔
      (-1 ≤ cell.1 ∧ cell.1 ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1) ∧
      (-1 ≤ cell.2 ∧ cell.2 ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1)

name: PaperC.card_nat_Ico_modEq_cast_le_div_add_one
statement:
theorem card_nat_Ico_modEq_cast_le_div_add_one
    (a b v r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((#{x ∈ Ico a b | x ≡ v [MOD r]} : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (((((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (r : ℚ)) + 1

name: PaperC.channelCells_card_cast_le_firstStep
statement:
theorem channelCells_card_cast_le_firstStep
    (L a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (h : ℤ) :
    ((channelCells L a b h).card : ℚ) ≤
      (((((L : ℤ) - (-1 : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) + 1

name: PaperC.channelCells_card_cast_le_maxStep
statement:
theorem channelCells_card_cast_le_maxStep
    (L a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (h : ℤ) :
    ((channelCells L a b h).card : ℚ) ≤
      (((((L : ℤ) - (-1 : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
          (Nat.max a b : ℚ)) + 1

name: PaperC.channelCells_card_cast_le_secondStep
statement:
theorem channelCells_card_cast_le_secondStep
    (L a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (h : ℤ) :
    ((channelCells L a b h).card : ℚ) ≤
      (((((L : ℤ) - (-1 : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (a : ℚ)) + 1

name: PaperC.fst_injOn_channelCells
statement:
theorem fst_injOn_channelCells
    {L a b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {h : ℤ} :
    Set.InjOn Prod.fst (↑(channelCells L a b h) : Set (ℤ × ℤ))

name: PaperC.snd_injOn_channelCells
statement:
theorem snd_injOn_channelCells

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.card_rationalChannelUnits_eq_channelCells
statement:
theorem card_rationalChannelUnits_eq_channelCells

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelAffineCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem channelAffineCharacter_apply

    (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) :
    channelAffineCharacter L a b h c =
      ∑ unit : ChannelUnit L a b h,
        c unit * channelUnitAffineBit unit

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelRelationCoefficients_injective
statement:
theorem channelRelationCoefficients_injective
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} (hb : 0 < b) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelRelationCoefficients_mem_relationSpace
statement:
theorem channelRelationCoefficients_mem_relationSpace
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x)
    (c : EvenChannelSelection L a b h) :
    channelRelationCoefficients L a b h c ∈
      RelationSpace (twoStartSystem M x y L)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelUnitCell_mem_channelCells
statement:
theorem channelUnitCell_mem_channelCells
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} (unit : ChannelUnit L a b h) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelUnit_label_mul_eq
statement:
theorem channelUnit_label_mul_eq
    {x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x)
    (unit : ChannelUnit L a b h) :
    a * startCompleteVertexLabel x L unit.1.1 =
      b * startCompleteVertexLabel y L unit.1.2

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelUnit_left_injective
statement:
theorem channelUnit_left_injective
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} (hb : 0 < b) :

theorem channelUnit_right_injective

statement:
theorem channelVertexOffset_eq_neg_one_iff

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.channelVertexOffset_startRootVertex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem channelVertexOffset_startRootVertex (L : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.coordinateSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateSum_apply

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.coordinateSum_eq_selectedChannelUnits_card
statement:
theorem coordinateSum_eq_selectedChannelUnits_card

statement:
theorem coordinateSum_surjective

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.dotProduct_twoStartRhs_eq_boundary_roots
statement:
theorem dotProduct_twoStartRhs_eq_boundary_roots
    {L : ℕ} (u : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L) → F₂) :
    dotProduct u (twoStartRhs L) =
      twoStartCompleteBoundary L u
          (Sum.inl (startRootVertex L)) +
        twoStartCompleteBoundary L u
          (Sum.inr (startRootVertex L))

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.dotProduct_twoStartSystem_eq_sum_completeBoundary
statement:
theorem dotProduct_twoStartSystem_eq_sum_completeBoundary
    (M x y L : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace M)
    (u : Sum (Fin L) (Fin L) → F₂) :
    dotProduct u (twoStartSystem M x y L ω) =
      ∑ v : Sum (Fin (L + 1)) (Fin (L + 1)),
        twoStartCompleteBoundary L u v *
          valueBit ω (twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L v)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.finrank_evenChannelSelection
statement:
theorem finrank_evenChannelSelection

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.finrank_evenChannelSelection_all
statement:
theorem finrank_evenChannelSelection_all

theorem finrank_ker_coordinateSum

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.finrank_rationalCode

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.leftUnitBoundary_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnitBoundary_apply
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    leftUnitBoundary L a b h c v =
      ∑ unit : ChannelUnit L a b h,
        c unit *
          (Pi.single unit.1.1 (1 : F₂) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.leftUnitBoundary_injective
statement:
theorem leftUnitBoundary_injective

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.leftUnitBoundary_root
statement:
theorem leftUnitBoundary_root
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) :
    leftUnitBoundary L a b h c (startRootVertex L) =
      ∑ unit : ChannelUnit L a b h,
        c unit *
          (if channelVertexOffset unit.1.1 = -1 then 1 else 0)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.max_channelCoefficients_le_length
statement:
theorem max_channelCoefficients_le_length
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.mem_evenChannelSelection_iff_even_card
statement:
theorem mem_evenChannelSelection_iff_even_card
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}

    c ∈ EvenChannelSelection L a b h ↔
      Even (selectedChannelUnits c).card

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.mem_rationalChannelUnits
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_rationalChannelUnits

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.offsetVertexOfMem_channelVertexOffset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem offsetVertexOfMem_channelVertexOffset
    {L : ℕ} (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    offsetVertexOfMem (channelVertexOffset v)
        (channelVertexOffset_mem_offsetInterval v) =
      v

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.rationalCode_ne_bot_iff_two_le_card
statement:
theorem rationalCode_ne_bot_iff_two_le_card
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x) :
    rationalCode M x y L a b h
        ha hb hx hy hheight ≠ ⊥ ↔
      2 ≤ (rationalChannelUnits L a b h).card

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.rationalCode_ne_bot_iff_two_le_channelCells_card
statement:
theorem rationalCode_ne_bot_iff_two_le_channelCells_card

    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)

    rationalCode M x y L a b h
        ha hb hx hy hheight ≠ ⊥ ↔
      2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.rationalRelationMap_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalRelationMap_coe
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x)
    (c : EvenChannelSelection L a b h) :
    ((rationalRelationMap M x y L a b h
        ha hb hx hy hheight c :
      RelationSpace (twoStartSystem M x y L)) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.rationalRelationMap_injective

theorem rationalRelationMap_injective

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.relationCharacter_rationalRelationMap
statement:
theorem relationCharacter_rationalRelationMap
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startCompleteBoundary_liftEvenBoundary
statement:
@[simp]
theorem startCompleteBoundary_liftEvenBoundary
    {L : ℕ} (w : LinearMap.ker (startVertexSum L)) :

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startCompleteBoundary_root_eq_dot_startRhs

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startCompleteVertexLabel_cast
statement:
theorem startCompleteVertexLabel_cast
    {x L : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v : ℤ) =
      (x : ℤ) + channelVertexOffset v

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startCompleteVertexLabel_pos
statement:
theorem startCompleteVertexLabel_pos
    {x L : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    0 < startCompleteVertexLabel x L v

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startSystem_apply_eq_sum_incidence
statement:
theorem startSystem_apply_eq_sum_incidence
    (M x L : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace M) (i : Fin L) :
    startSystem M x L ω i =
      ∑ v : Fin (L + 1),
        startIncidenceColumn i v *
          valueBit ω (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startVertexSum_leftUnitBoundary
statement:
theorem startVertexSum_leftUnitBoundary
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) :
    startVertexSum L (leftUnitBoundary L a b h c) =
      coordinateSum (ChannelUnit L a b h) c

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.startVertexSum_rightUnitBoundary
statement:
theorem startVertexSum_rightUnitBoundary
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) :
    startVertexSum L (rightUnitBoundary L a b h c) =
      coordinateSum (ChannelUnit L a b h) c

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.sum_completeBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients
statement:
theorem sum_completeBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ω : SampleSpace M) (c : EvenChannelSelection L a b h) :
    (∑ v : Sum (Fin (L + 1)) (Fin (L + 1)),
        twoStartCompleteBoundary L
            (channelRelationCoefficients L a b h c) v *
          valueBit ω (twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L v)) =
      ∑ unit : ChannelUnit L a b h,
        (c : ChannelUnit L a b h → F₂) unit *
          (valueBit ω
              (startCompleteVertexLabel x L unit.1.1) +
            valueBit ω
              (startCompleteVertexLabel y L unit.1.2))

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.sum_startSystem_eq_sum_completeBoundary
statement:
theorem sum_startSystem_eq_sum_completeBoundary
    (M x L : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace M) (u : Fin L → F₂) :
    (∑ i : Fin L, u i * startSystem M x L ω i) =
      ∑ v : Fin (L + 1),
        startCompleteBoundary L u v *
          valueBit ω (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v)

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.twoStartCompleteBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartCompleteBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients_inl
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : EvenChannelSelection L a b h) (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    twoStartCompleteBoundary L
        (channelRelationCoefficients L a b h c) (Sum.inl v) =
      leftUnitBoundary L a b h c v

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.twoStartCompleteBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStartCompleteBoundary_channelRelationCoefficients_inr
    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (c : EvenChannelSelection L a b h) (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    twoStartCompleteBoundary L
        (channelRelationCoefficients L a b h c) (Sum.inr v) =
      rightUnitBoundary L a b h c v

name: PaperC.Affine.RationalChannelCode.valueBit_add_of_channelUnit
statement:
theorem valueBit_add_of_channelUnit
    {M x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ω : SampleSpace M) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x)
    (unit : ChannelUnit L a b h) :
    valueBit ω (startCompleteVertexLabel x L unit.1.1) +
        valueBit ω (startCompleteVertexLabel y L unit.1.2) =
      valueBit ω a + valueBit ω b

name: PaperC.reducedChannel_unique
statement:
theorem reducedChannel_unique
    (x y B H a b a' b' : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (ha' : 0 < a') (hb' : 0 < b')
    (hab : a.Coprime b) (hab' : a'.Coprime b')
    (haH : a ≤ H) (hbH : b ≤ H) (ha'H : a' ≤ H) (hb'H : b' ≤ H)
    (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x)
    (hclose :
      |(b : ℤ) * (y : ℤ) - (a : ℤ) * (x : ℤ)| <
        ((a + b) * B : ℕ))
    (hclose' :
      |(b' : ℤ) * (y : ℤ) - (a' : ℤ) * (x : ℤ)| <
        ((a' + b') * B : ℕ)) :
    a = a' ∧ b = b'

name: PaperC.abs_channelParameter_lt
statement:
theorem abs_channelParameter_lt
    {L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hcell : cell ∈ channelCells L a b h) :
    |h| < (((a + b) * (L + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_none_iff

    canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = none ↔
      reducedChannelCandidates x y B H = ∅

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_some_of_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_eq_some_of_mem
    {x y B H : ℕ} (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x)
    {c : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hc : c ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H) :
    canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = some c

name: PaperC.canonicalReducedChannel?_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedChannel?_mem
    {x y B H : ℕ} {c : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hc : canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H = some c) :
    c ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H

name: PaperC.card_reducedChannelCandidates_le_one
statement:
theorem card_reducedChannelCandidates_le_one
    {x y B H : ℕ} (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x) :
    (reducedChannelCandidates x y B H).card ≤ 1

name: PaperC.channel_mem_reducedCandidates_of_two_units
statement:
theorem channel_mem_reducedCandidates_of_two_units
    {x y L A a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    {h : ℤ}
    (hparameter : pairChannelError x y a b = h)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    (a, b) ∈
      reducedChannelCandidates x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A)

name: PaperC.mem_reducedChannelCandidates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_reducedChannelCandidates
    {x y B H a b : ℕ} :
    (a, b) ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H ↔
      0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a ≤ H ∧ b ≤ H ∧
        a.Coprime b ∧
        SatisfiesChannelInequality x y B a b

name: PaperC.pairChannelError_eq_of_exact_unit
statement:
theorem pairChannelError_eq_of_exact_unit
    {x y a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hchannel : OnChannel a b h cell)
    (hexact :
      (a : ℤ) * ((x : ℤ) + cell.1) =
        (b : ℤ) * ((y : ℤ) + cell.2)) :
    pairChannelError x y a b = h

name: PaperC.Affine.CanonicalRationalCode.canonicalReducedCandidate?_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedCandidate?_eq_none_iff
    {x y B H : ℕ} :
    canonicalReducedCandidate? x y B H = none ↔
      reducedChannelCandidates x y B H = ∅

name: PaperC.Affine.CanonicalRationalCode.canonicalReducedCandidate?_eq_some_of_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedCandidate?_eq_some_of_mem
    {x y B H : ℕ} (hx : 4 * H ^ 2 * B < x)
    {c : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hc : c ∈ reducedChannelCandidates x y B H) :
    canonicalReducedCandidate? x y B H =

name: PaperC.Affine.CanonicalRationalCode.canonicalReducedCandidate?_map_val
statement:
theorem canonicalReducedCandidate?_map_val
    (x y B H : ℕ) :
    Option.map Subtype.val
        (canonicalReducedCandidate? x y B H) =
      canonicalReducedChannel? x y B H

name: PaperC.Affine.CanonicalRationalCode.exists_canonical_candidate_of_two_le_multiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_candidate_of_two_le_multiplicity
    {A L x y : ℕ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ canonicalMultiplicity A L x y) :
    ∃ c : ReducedCandidate
        x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A),
      canonicalReducedCandidate?
          x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A) = some c ∧
        2 ≤ candidateMultiplicity L c

name: PaperC.Affine.card_eq_two_pow_finrank
statement:
theorem card_eq_two_pow_finrank :
    Fintype.card V = 2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ V

name: PaperC.Affine.uniformSolutionProbability_eq_ite
statement:
theorem uniformSolutionProbability_eq_ite
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (b : W) :
    uniformSolutionProbability A b =
      if Compatible A b then
        (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.ker A) : ℚ) /
          (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ V : ℚ)
      else
        0

name: PaperC.Affine.uniformSolutionProbability_of_compatible
statement:
theorem uniformSolutionProbability_of_compatible
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (b : W) (h : Compatible A b) :
    uniformSolutionProbability A b =
      (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.ker A) : ℚ) /
        (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ V : ℚ)

name: PaperC.Affine.uniformSolutionProbability_of_not_compatible
statement:
theorem uniformSolutionProbability_of_not_compatible
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (b : W) (h : ¬Compatible A b) :
    uniformSolutionProbability A b = 0

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.DefectRepresentation.value_eq_defectPart_mul_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DefectRepresentation.value_eq_defectPart_mul_sq
    {P : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (rep : DefectRepresentation P n) :

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_HDefectValues_le
statement:
theorem card_HDefectValues_le (H X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues (smallPrimesUpTo H) X).card ≤
      (Nat.sqrt X + 1) * 2 ^ (smallPrimesUpTo H).card

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_defectValues_le
statement:
theorem card_defectValues_le (P : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues P X).card ≤
      (Nat.sqrt X + 1) * 2 ^ P.card

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_defectValues_le_sum
statement:
theorem card_defectValues_le_sum (P : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (defectValues P X).card ≤
      ∑ support ∈ P.powerset, (valuesForSupport support X).card

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_intervalStartsContaining_le
statement:
theorem card_intervalStartsContaining_le
    (starts : Finset ℕ) (H n : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.card_valuesForSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_valuesForSupport_le (support : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.intervalStartsContaining_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem intervalStartsContaining_subset_Icc

    intervalStartsContaining starts H n ⊆ Finset.Icc (n - H) n

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_iff
statement:
theorem mem_defectValues_iff {P : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ defectValues P X ↔
      n ≤ X ∧
        ∃ support ⊆ P, ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X,
          n = support.prod id * a ^ 2

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_of_HDefectRepresentation
statement:
theorem mem_defectValues_of_HDefectRepresentation

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_defectValues_of_representation

theorem mem_defectValues_of_representation

    (hnX : n ≤ X) :

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_smallPrimesUpTo
statement:

theorem mem_smallPrimesUpTo {H p : ℕ} :

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.mem_valuesForSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_valuesForSupport_iff
    {support : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :

      n ≤ X ∧ ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X, n = support.prod id * a ^ 2

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.squarePart_le_sqrt

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.hDefective_of_HDefectRepresentation

name: PaperC.DefectivePredicate.oddFactorization_apply_eq_one_of_mem

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.mem_smallOddPrimeSupport_iff_prime_small_odd

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.one_le_largeOddKernel

name: PaperC.LargeOddKernel.parityVec_ne_zero_iff_mem_largeOddPrimeSupport

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.card_weakComposition_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem card_weakComposition_le_two_pow
    {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    Fintype.card (WeakComposition d m) ≤ 2 ^ (m + d)

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.choose_succ_eq
statement:
theorem choose_succ_eq (r : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    Ring.choose r (n + 1) =
      Ring.choose r n * ((r - n) / (n + 1 : ℚ))

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.choose_succ_recursion
statement:
theorem choose_succ_recursion (r : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1 : ℚ) * Ring.choose r (n + 1) =
      (r - n) * Ring.choose r n

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.halfChoose_succ_eq_catalan
statement:
theorem halfChoose_succ_eq_catalan (n : ℕ) :
    halfChoose (n + 1) =
      (-1 : ℚ) ^ n * (catalan n : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * n + 1)

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.two_pow_mul_rungeCoefficient_isRatInteger
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_rungeCoefficient_isRatInteger
    {d m : ℕ} (γ : Fin d → ℤ) (hmd : 2 * m ≤ d) :
    IsRatInteger ((2 : ℚ) ^ d * rungeCoefficient γ m)

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.two_pow_two_mul_halfChoose_isInt
statement:
theorem two_pow_two_mul_halfChoose_isInt (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * j) * halfChoose j = (z : ℚ)

name: PaperC.RungeCoefficients.two_pow_two_mul_rungeCoefficient_isRatInteger
statement:
theorem two_pow_two_mul_rungeCoefficient_isRatInteger
    {d : ℕ} (γ : Fin d → ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    IsRatInteger ((2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * m) * rungeCoefficient γ m)

name: PaperC.RungeTruncation.eval_rungeTruncation_eq_integral_div
statement:
theorem eval_rungeTruncation_eq_integral_div
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) (u : ℤ) :
    (rungeTruncation γ).eval (u : ℚ) =
      (((integralRungeTruncation γ).eval u : ℤ) : ℚ) /
        (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * k)

name: PaperC.RungeTruncation.map_integralRungeTruncation
statement:
theorem map_integralRungeTruncation
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) :
    (integralRungeTruncation γ).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) =
      Polynomial.C ((2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * k)) *
        rungeTruncation γ

name: PaperC.RungeTruncation.one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_rungeTruncation
statement:
theorem one_div_two_pow_le_abs_integer_sub_rungeTruncation
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) (a u : ℤ)
    (hne :
      (a : ℚ) ≠ (rungeTruncation γ).eval (u : ℚ)) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * k) ≤
      |(a : ℚ) - (rungeTruncation γ).eval (u : ℚ)|

name: PaperC.RungeTruncation.scaledRungeCoefficientUpTo_spec
statement:
theorem scaledRungeCoefficientUpTo_spec
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) {m : ℕ} (hmk : m ≤ k) :
    (scaledRungeCoefficientUpTo γ m : ℚ) =
      (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * k) *
        RungeCoefficients.rungeCoefficient γ m

name: PaperC.RungeTruncation.scaledRungeCoefficient_spec
statement:
theorem scaledRungeCoefficient_spec
    {d : ℕ} (γ : Fin d → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hmd : 2 * m ≤ d) :
    (2 : ℚ) ^ d * RungeCoefficients.rungeCoefficient γ m =
      (scaledRungeCoefficient γ m hmd : ℚ)

name: PaperC.RungeDichotomy.nat_le_two_pow_mul_of_dyadic_gap_and_tail
statement:
theorem nat_le_two_pow_mul_of_dyadic_gap_and_tail
    (a b : ℤ) (d U B : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (hne : (a : ℚ) ≠ (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d)
    (htail :
      |(a : ℚ) - (b : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ d| ≤
        (B : ℚ) / (U : ℚ)) :
    U ≤ 2 ^ d * B

name: PaperC.RungeDichotomy.nat_le_two_pow_mul_of_rungeTruncation_gap
statement:
theorem nat_le_two_pow_mul_of_rungeTruncation_gap
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (U B : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (hne :
      (a : ℚ) ≠
        (RungeTruncation.rungeTruncation γ).eval (U : ℚ))
    (htail :
      |(a : ℚ) -
        (RungeTruncation.rungeTruncation γ).eval (U : ℚ)| ≤
          (B : ℚ) / (U : ℚ)) :
    U ≤ 2 ^ (2 * k) * B

name: PaperC.RungeSplitProduct.natDegree_splitProduct
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_splitProduct (root : ι → F) :
    (splitProduct root).natDegree = Fintype.card ι

name: PaperC.RungeSplitProduct.splitProduct_not_isSquare
statement:
theorem splitProduct_not_isSquare
    [Nonempty ι] (root : ι → F) (hinjective : Function.Injective root) :
    ¬ ∃ q : F[X], splitProduct root = q ^ 2

name: PaperC.RungeSplitProduct.splitProduct_separable_iff
statement:
theorem splitProduct_separable_iff (root : ι → F) :
    (splitProduct root).Separable ↔ Function.Injective root

name: PaperC.inv_sqrt_nat_le_two_mul_sqrt_sub
statement:
lemma inv_sqrt_nat_le_two_mul_sqrt_sub (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹ ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt n - Real.sqrt ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: PaperC.rpow_neg_one_half_eq_inv_sqrt
statement:
lemma rpow_neg_one_half_eq_inv_sqrt (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹

name: PaperC.sqrt_nat_sq_sub_sq_eq_one
statement:
lemma sqrt_nat_sq_sub_sq_eq_one (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Real.sqrt n) ^ 2 - (Real.sqrt ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 1

name: PaperC.sqrt_nat_sub_one_le
statement:
lemma sqrt_nat_sub_one_le (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt n

name: PaperC.sum_Icc_inv_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_inv_sqrt_le (H : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H, (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt H

name: PaperC.sum_Icc_rpow_neg_one_half_le
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_rpow_neg_one_half_le (H : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H, (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt H

name: PaperC.DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo_subset_Icc
statement:
lemma DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo_subset_Icc (H : ℕ) :
    DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 H

name: PaperC.prod_one_add_inv_sqrt_le_exp_sum
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_inv_sqrt_le_exp_sum (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∏ n ∈ s, (1 + (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹)) ≤
      Real.exp (∑ n ∈ s, (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.prod_one_add_inv_sqrt_le_exp_two_sqrt
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_inv_sqrt_le_exp_two_sqrt
    (H : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : s ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 H) :
    (∏ n ∈ s, (1 + (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹)) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt H)

name: PaperC.prod_one_add_rpow_neg_one_half_le_exp_two_sqrt
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_rpow_neg_one_half_le_exp_two_sqrt
    (H : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : s ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 H) :
    (∏ n ∈ s, (1 + (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt H)

name: PaperC.prod_smallPrimesUpTo_one_add_inv_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem prod_smallPrimesUpTo_one_add_inv_sqrt_le (H : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt H)

name: PaperC.prod_smallPrimesUpTo_one_add_rpow_neg_one_half_le
statement:
theorem prod_smallPrimesUpTo_one_add_rpow_neg_one_half_le (H : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H,
        (1 + (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt H)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.card_positiveDefectValues_cast_le_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem card_positiveDefectValues_cast_le_eulerProduct
    {P : Finset ℕ} {X : ℕ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 ≤ p) :
    ((positiveDefectValues P X).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.card_positiveDefectValues_le_sqrtDiv_sum
statement:
theorem card_positiveDefectValues_le_sqrtDiv_sum
    {P : Finset ℕ} {X : ℕ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 ≤ p) :
    (positiveDefectValues P X).card ≤
      ∑ support ∈ P.powerset, Nat.sqrt (X / support.prod id)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.card_positiveHDefectValues_cast_le_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem card_positiveHDefectValues_cast_le_eulerProduct
    (H X : ℕ) :
    ((positiveDefectValues (smallPrimesUpTo H) X).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X *
        ∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo H, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.card_positiveValuesForSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_positiveValuesForSupport_le
    {support : Finset ℕ} {X : ℕ}
    (hSupport : ∀ p ∈ support, 1 ≤ p) :
    (positiveValuesForSupport support X).card ≤
      Nat.sqrt (X / support.prod id)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.cast_sqrt_div_prod_le
statement:
theorem cast_sqrt_div_prod_le
    (support : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    (Nat.sqrt (X / support.prod id) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * ∏ p ∈ support, (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.mem_positiveDefectValues_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_positiveDefectValues_iff
    {P : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ positiveDefectValues P X ↔
      n ≠ 0 ∧ n ≤ X ∧
        ∃ support ⊆ P, ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X,
          n = support.prod id * a ^ 2

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.mem_positiveValuesForSupport_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_positiveValuesForSupport_iff
    {support : Finset ℕ} {X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ positiveValuesForSupport support X ↔
      n ≠ 0 ∧ n ≤ X ∧
        ∃ a ≤ Nat.sqrt X, n = support.prod id * a ^ 2

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.positiveValuesForSupport_subset_image_Icc
statement:
theorem positiveValuesForSupport_subset_image_Icc
    {support : Finset ℕ} {X : ℕ}
    (hSupport : ∀ p ∈ support, 1 ≤ p) :
    positiveValuesForSupport support X ⊆
      (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.sqrt (X / support.prod id))).image
        (fun a ↦ support.prod id * a ^ 2)

name: PaperC.WeightedDefectCounting.sqrt_natCast_prod
statement:
theorem sqrt_natCast_prod (support : Finset ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (↑(support.prod id) : ℝ) =
      ∏ p ∈ support, Real.sqrt p

name: PaperC.card_positiveHDefectValues_cast_le_sqrt_mul_exp
statement:
theorem card_positiveHDefectValues_cast_le_sqrt_mul_exp
    (H X : ℕ) :
    ((WeightedDefectCounting.positiveDefectValues
        (DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H) X).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt H)

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.covers_primeDivisors
statement:
theorem covers_primeDivisors
    {H s : ℕ}
    (hbounded : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ s → p ≤ H) :
    ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ s →
      ∃ i : Fin (count H), smallPrime H i = p

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.exists_smallPrime_eq_of_prime_le
statement:
theorem exists_smallPrime_eq_of_prime_le
    {H p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hpH : p ≤ H) :
    ∃ i : Fin (count H), smallPrime H i = p

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.mem_range_smallPrime_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_smallPrime_iff {H p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ Set.range (smallPrime H) ↔ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ H

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.smallPrime_injective
statement:
theorem smallPrime_injective (H : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (smallPrime H)

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.smallPrime_le
statement:
theorem smallPrime_le (H : ℕ) (i : Fin (count H)) :
    smallPrime H i ≤ H

name: PaperC.PrimesUpTo.smallPrime_prime
statement:
theorem smallPrime_prime (H : ℕ) (i : Fin (count H)) :
    Nat.Prime (smallPrime H i)

name: PaperC.PrimeCountBridge.count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo
statement:
theorem count_eq_card_smallPrimesUpTo (H : ℕ) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H =
      (DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo H).card

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div
statement:
theorem count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div (H : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < Nat.log 2 H / 2) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤
      2 ^ (Nat.log 2 H / 2) + (2 * H) / (Nat.log 2 H / 2)

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div_of_four_le
statement:
theorem count_le_pow_halfLog_add_div_of_four_le {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤
      2 ^ (Nat.log 2 H / 2) + (2 * H) / (Nat.log 2 H / 2)

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.count_le_seven_mul_div_log
statement:
theorem count_le_seven_mul_div_log {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    PrimesUpTo.count H ≤ (7 * H) / Nat.log 2 H

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le
statement:
theorem halfLog_mul_card_highPrimes_le (H : ℕ) :
    (Nat.log 2 H / 2) * (highPrimes H).card ≤ 2 * H

name: PaperC.ChebyshevPrimeCount.log_mul_count_le_seven_mul
statement:
theorem log_mul_count_le_seven_mul {H : ℕ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) :
    Nat.log 2 H * PrimesUpTo.count H ≤ 7 * H

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.four_mul_q_mul_B_le_dyadicCutoff
statement:
theorem four_mul_q_mul_B_le_dyadicCutoff (B q : ℕ) :
    4 * q * B ≤ B * 2 ^ (q + 2)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_dyadicPrimes
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dyadicPrimes {B K p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K ↔
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ p ≤ B * 2 ^ K

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
statement:
theorem mem_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
    {B q p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hBp : B < p)
    (hpUpper : p < 4 * q * B) :
    p ∈ dyadicPrimes B (q + 2)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.mem_primesBetween
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primesBetween {B X p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ primesBetween B X ↔ p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ p ≤ X

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.primesBetween_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primesBetween_self (B : ℕ) :
    primesBetween B B = ∅

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
statement:
theorem subset_dyadicPrimes_add_two_of_prime_lt_four_mul
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B (q + 2)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_primes_lt_four_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_primes_lt_four_mul_le
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) /
        (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B) :
    (∑ p ∈ dyadicPrimes B K, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_primes_lt_four_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_primes_lt_four_mul_le
    {B q : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ P, B < p)
    (hupper : ∀ p ∈ P, p < 4 * q * B) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_sq_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hP : P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B K) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      28 / ((B : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ))

name: PaperC.DyadicPrimeReciprocalSums.sum_inv_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_subset_dyadicPrimes_le
    (B K : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hP : P ⊆ dyadicPrimes B K) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (p : ℚ)) ≤
      14 * (K : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 B : ℚ)

name: PaperC.sum_Ioc_rpow_neg_three_halves_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_rpow_neg_three_halves_le
    (B X : ℕ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc B X, (n : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))) ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt B)⁻¹

name: PaperC.LargeEulerProduct.prod_one_add_B_div_mul_sqrt_le_exp_two_sqrt
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_B_div_mul_sqrt_le_exp_two_sqrt
    (B X : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ioc B X) :
    (∏ p ∈ S,
        (1 + (B : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p))) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt B)

name: PaperC.LargeEulerProduct.prod_one_add_mul_rpow_neg_three_halves_le_exp_sum
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_mul_rpow_neg_three_halves_le_exp_sum
    (B : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ S,
        (1 + (B : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
      Real.exp
        (∑ p ∈ S,
          (B : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))

name: PaperC.LargeEulerProduct.prod_one_add_mul_rpow_neg_three_halves_le_exp_two_sqrt
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_mul_rpow_neg_three_halves_le_exp_two_sqrt
    (B X : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ioc B X) :
    (∏ p ∈ S,
        (1 + (B : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt B)

name: PaperC.LargeEulerProduct.rpow_neg_three_halves_eq_inv_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem rpow_neg_three_halves_eq_inv_mul_sqrt
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) =
      ((p : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p)⁻¹

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.canonicalKernelTriple_injective_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem canonicalKernelTriple_injective_of_ne_zero
    {B m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : canonicalKernelTriple B m = canonicalKernelTriple B n) :
    m = n

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.canonicalKernelTriple_mem_kernelTriplesUpTo
statement:
theorem canonicalKernelTriple_mem_kernelTriplesUpTo
    {B X n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X) :
    canonicalKernelTriple B n ∈ kernelTriplesUpTo B X

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo_subset_kernelTriplesUpTo
statement:
theorem canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo_subset_kernelTriplesUpTo (B X : ℕ) :
    canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo B X ⊆ kernelTriplesUpTo B X

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.cast_sqrt_div_small_mul_large_le
statement:
theorem cast_sqrt_div_small_mul_large_le
    (X : ℕ) {small large : Finset ℕ}
    (hdisj : Disjoint small large) :
    (Nat.sqrt (X / (small.prod id * large.prod id)) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * smallSupportWeight small *
        (∏ p ∈ large, (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.disjoint_of_subset_smallPrimesUpTo_of_subset_largePrimesBetween
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_subset_smallPrimesUpTo_of_subset_largePrimesBetween
    {B X : ℕ} {small large : Finset ℕ}
    (hsmall : small ⊆ smallPrimesUpTo B)
    (hlarge : large ⊆ largePrimesBetween B X) :
    Disjoint small large

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.invSqrtWeight_mul_kernelWeight_eq_denominatorWeight
statement:
theorem invSqrtWeight_mul_kernelWeight_eq_denominatorWeight
    (B : ℕ) (large : Finset ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ large, (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹) *
        ((B : ℝ) ^ large.card / (large.prod id : ℕ)) =
      largeSupportDenominatorWeight B large

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.kernelTripleWeight_canonical
statement:
theorem kernelTripleWeight_canonical (B n : ℕ) :
    kernelTripleWeight B (canonicalKernelTriple B n) =
      largeKernelWeight B n

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.kernelTripleWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem kernelTripleWeight_nonneg (B : ℕ) (t : KernelTriple) :
    0 ≤ kernelTripleWeight B t

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.largeKernelWeight_eq_cardDistinctFactors
statement:
theorem largeKernelWeight_eq_cardDistinctFactors (B n : ℕ) :
    largeKernelWeight B n =
      (B : ℝ) ^
          (ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors (largeOddKernel B n)) /
        (largeOddKernel B n : ℝ)

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.largeKernelWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem largeKernelWeight_nonneg (B n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ largeKernelWeight B n

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.largePrimesBetween_subset_Ioc
statement:
theorem largePrimesBetween_subset_Ioc (B X : ℕ) :
    largePrimesBetween B X ⊆ Finset.Ioc B X

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.largeSupportDenominatorWeight_eq_largeSupportWeight
statement:
theorem largeSupportDenominatorWeight_eq_largeSupportWeight
    {B X : ℕ} {large : Finset ℕ}
    (hlarge : large ⊆ largePrimesBetween B X) :
    largeSupportDenominatorWeight B large =
      largeSupportWeight B large

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.mem_largePrimesBetween
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_largePrimesBetween {B X p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largePrimesBetween B X ↔
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧ p ≤ X

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.sum_kernelTriplesUpTo_eq_support_sums
statement:
theorem sum_kernelTriplesUpTo_eq_support_sums (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ kernelTriplesUpTo B X, kernelTripleWeight B t) =
      ∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        ∑ large ∈ (largePrimesBetween B X).powerset,
          (Nat.sqrt
            (X / (small.prod id * large.prod id)) : ℝ) *
            ((B : ℝ) ^ large.card / (large.prod id : ℕ))

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.sum_kernelTriplesUpTo_le_support_weight_sums
statement:
theorem sum_kernelTriplesUpTo_le_support_weight_sums (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ kernelTriplesUpTo B X, kernelTripleWeight B t) ≤
      ∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        ∑ large ∈ (largePrimesBetween B X).powerset,
          Real.sqrt X * smallSupportWeight small *
            largeSupportWeight B large

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.sum_largeKernelWeight_eq_sum_canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo
statement:
theorem sum_largeKernelWeight_eq_sum_canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo
    (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, largeKernelWeight B n) =
      ∑ t ∈ canonicalKernelTriplesUpTo B X, kernelTripleWeight B t

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.sum_largeKernelWeight_le_eulerProducts
statement:
theorem sum_largeKernelWeight_le_eulerProducts (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, largeKernelWeight B n) ≤
      Real.sqrt X *
        (∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B,
          (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)) *
        ∏ p ∈ largePrimesBetween B X,
          (1 + (B : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.sum_largeKernelWeight_le_sum_kernelTriplesUpTo
statement:
theorem sum_largeKernelWeight_le_sum_kernelTriplesUpTo
    (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, largeKernelWeight B n) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ kernelTriplesUpTo B X, kernelTripleWeight B t

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.support_pair_contribution_le
statement:
theorem support_pair_contribution_le
    {B X : ℕ} {small large : Finset ℕ}
    (hsmall : small ⊆ smallPrimesUpTo B)
    (hlarge : large ⊆ largePrimesBetween B X) :
    (Nat.sqrt (X / (small.prod id * large.prod id)) : ℝ) *
        ((B : ℝ) ^ large.card / (large.prod id : ℕ)) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * smallSupportWeight small *
        largeSupportWeight B large

name: PaperC.LargeKernelWeightedCounting.support_weight_sums_eq_eulerProducts
statement:
theorem support_weight_sums_eq_eulerProducts (B X : ℕ) :
    (∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        ∑ large ∈ (largePrimesBetween B X).powerset,
          Real.sqrt X * smallSupportWeight small *
            largeSupportWeight B large) =
      Real.sqrt X *
        (∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B,
          (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)) *
        ∏ p ∈ largePrimesBetween B X,
          (1 + (B : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.canonicalTerminalKernelTriple_injective_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem canonicalTerminalKernelTriple_injective_of_ne_zero
    {B m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h :
      canonicalTerminalKernelTriple B m =
        canonicalTerminalKernelTriple B n) :
    m = n

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.canonicalTerminalKernelTriple_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalTerminalKernelTriple_mem
    {B T X n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ boundedLargeKernelValues B T X) :
    canonicalTerminalKernelTriple B n ∈
      terminalKernelTriples B T X

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.canonicalTerminalKernelTriples_subset
statement:
theorem canonicalTerminalKernelTriples_subset
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    canonicalTerminalKernelTriples B T X ⊆
      terminalKernelTriples B T X

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    ((boundedLargeKernelValues B T X).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.sqrt T *
        ∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B,
          (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le_exp
statement:
theorem card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le_exp
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    ((boundedLargeKernelValues B T X).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.sqrt T *
        Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt B)

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le_weight_sums
statement:
theorem card_boundedLargeKernelValues_cast_le_weight_sums
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    ((boundedLargeKernelValues B T X).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
          Real.sqrt X *
            (∏ p ∈ small, (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹) *
            (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.card_boundedLargeKernelValues_le_sqrt_sum
statement:
theorem card_boundedLargeKernelValues_le_sqrt_sum
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    (boundedLargeKernelValues B T X).card ≤
      ∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
          Nat.sqrt (X / (small.prod id * r))

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.card_canonicalTerminalKernelTriples
statement:
theorem card_canonicalTerminalKernelTriples
    (B T X : ℕ) :
    (canonicalTerminalKernelTriples B T X).card =
      (boundedLargeKernelValues B T X).card

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.cast_sqrt_div_le
statement:
theorem cast_sqrt_div_le
    (X d : ℕ) :
    (Nat.sqrt (X / d) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X * (Real.sqrt d)⁻¹

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.cast_sqrt_div_small_mul_kernel_le
statement:
theorem cast_sqrt_div_small_mul_kernel_le
    (X r : ℕ) (small : Finset ℕ) :
    (Nat.sqrt (X / (small.prod id * r)) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt X *
        (∏ p ∈ small, (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹) *
        (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹

name: PaperC.TerminalKernelCount.mem_boundedLargeKernelValues
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedLargeKernelValues
    {B T X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ boundedLargeKernelValues B T X ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ X ∧ largeOddKernel B n ≤ T

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.card_terminalBadStartIncidences_le
statement:
theorem card_terminalBadStartIncidences_le
    {N L B : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (terminalBadStartIncidences N L B).card ≤
      (unitLargeKernelValues B (dyadicCutoff N L)).card * L

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.card_terminalBadStarts_cast_le_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem card_terminalBadStarts_cast_le_eulerProduct
    {N L B : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ((terminalBadStarts N L B).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * L * Real.sqrt (dyadicCutoff N L) *
        ∏ p ∈ DefectCounting.smallPrimesUpTo B,
          (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.card_terminalBadStarts_cast_le_exp
statement:
theorem card_terminalBadStarts_cast_le_exp
    {N L B : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ((terminalBadStarts N L B).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * L * Real.sqrt (dyadicCutoff N L) *
        Real.exp (2 * Real.sqrt B)

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.card_terminalBadStarts_le
statement:
theorem card_terminalBadStarts_le
    {N L B : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (terminalBadStarts N L B).card ≤
      L * (unitLargeKernelValues B (dyadicCutoff N L)).card

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.card_terminalBadStarts_le_incidences
statement:
theorem card_terminalBadStarts_le_incidences
    (N L B : ℕ) :
    (terminalBadStarts N L B).card ≤
      (terminalBadStartIncidences N L B).card

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.image_fst_terminalBadStartIncidences
statement:
theorem image_fst_terminalBadStartIncidences
    (N L B : ℕ) :
    (terminalBadStartIncidences N L B).image Prod.fst =
      terminalBadStarts N L B

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.image_terminalBadIncidenceCode_subset
statement:
theorem image_terminalBadIncidenceCode_subset
    {N L B : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (terminalBadStartIncidences N L B).image
        terminalBadIncidenceCode ⊆
      (unitLargeKernelValues B (dyadicCutoff N L)).product
        (Finset.range L)

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.mem_terminalBadStartIncidences
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_terminalBadStartIncidences
    {N L B : ℕ} {xj : ℕ × ℕ} :
    xj ∈ terminalBadStartIncidences N L B ↔
      xj.1 ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧
        xj.2 < L ∧
          largeOddKernel B (xj.1 + xj.2) = 1

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.mem_terminalBadStarts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_terminalBadStarts
    {N L B x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ terminalBadStarts N L B ↔
      x ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧
        ∃ j < L, largeOddKernel B (x + j) = 1

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.mem_unitLargeKernelValues
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_unitLargeKernelValues
    {B X n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ unitLargeKernelValues B X ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ X ∧ largeOddKernel B n = 1

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.terminalBadIncidenceCode_injective
statement:
theorem terminalBadIncidenceCode_injective :
    Function.Injective terminalBadIncidenceCode

name: PaperC.BadStartCount.unitLargeKernelValues_eq_bounded
statement:
theorem unitLargeKernelValues_eq_bounded
    (B X : ℕ) :
    unitLargeKernelValues B X =
      boundedLargeKernelValues B 1 X

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.card_orderedDependencyEdges_cast_le_prime_sum
statement:
theorem card_orderedDependencyEdges_cast_le_prime_sum
    {N L Y : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hLN : L ≤ N)
    (hLY : L ≤ Y) :
    ((orderedDependencyEdges N L Y).card : ℚ) ≤
      (L + 1 : ℚ) ^ 2 *
        ∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
          ((N : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.card_orderedDependencyEdges_le_sum_sq
statement:
theorem card_orderedDependencyEdges_le_sum_sq
    {N L Y : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hL : L ≤ N) :
    (orderedDependencyEdges N L Y).card ≤
      ∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
        (startsUsingPrime N L Y p).card ^ 2

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.card_startsUsingPrime_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_startsUsingPrime_cast_le
    {N L Y p : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hLY : L ≤ Y)
    (hpY : Y < p) :
    ((startsUsingPrime N L Y p).card : ℚ) ≤
      (L + 1 : ℚ) * ((N : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 1)

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.card_startsWithDivisibleOffset_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_startsWithDivisibleOffset_cast_le
    {N p j : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hj : j ≤ p + 1) :
    ((startsWithDivisibleOffset N p j).card : ℚ) ≤
      (N : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 1

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.dvd_sub_one_add_iff_modEq
statement:
theorem dvd_sub_one_add_iff_modEq
    {p x j : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hj : j ≤ p + 1) :
    p ∣ x - 1 + j ↔
      x ≡ p + 1 - j [MOD p]

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.exists_largePrime_of_mem_runSupport_of_good
statement:
theorem exists_largePrime_of_mem_runSupport_of_good
    {N L Y x n : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hn : n ∈ startRunSupport x L) :
    ∃ p,
      p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport Y n ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_eq
statement:
theorem exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_eq
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hy : y ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hdist : Nat.dist x y = L) :
    ∃ p,
      p.Prime ∧ Y < p ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates y L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_le
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hy : y ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hdist : Nat.dist x y ≤ L) :
    ∃ p,
      p.Prime ∧ Y < p ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates y L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_lt
statement:
theorem exists_shared_largePrime_of_good_of_dist_lt
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hy : y ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hdist : Nat.dist x y < L) :
    ∃ p,
      p.Prime ∧ Y < p ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates y L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeAdjacent_iff
statement:
theorem largePrimeAdjacent_iff
    {L Y x y : ℕ} :
    LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧
        ∃ p,
          p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y ∧
          p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates y L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeAdjacent_of_common_run_tree_vertex
statement:
theorem largePrimeAdjacent_of_common_run_tree_vertex
    {N L Y x y n : ℕ}
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hnx : n ∈ startRunSupport x L)
    (hny : n ∈ startTreeSupport y L) :
    LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeAdjacent_of_good_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem largePrimeAdjacent_of_good_of_dist_le
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hy : y ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hdist : Nat.dist x y ≤ L) :
    LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeAdjacent_of_lt_of_sub_le
statement:
theorem largePrimeAdjacent_of_lt_of_sub_le
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hgap : y - x ≤ L) :
    LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeAdjacent_symm
statement:
theorem largePrimeAdjacent_symm
    {L Y x y : ℕ} :
    LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x y →
      LargePrimeAdjacent L Y y x

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.largePrimeDependencyGraph_adj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem largePrimeDependencyGraph_adj
    {N L Y : ℕ}
    {x y : {z : ℕ // z ∈ goodStarts N L Y}} :
    (largePrimeDependencyGraph N L Y).Adj x y ↔
      LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x.1 y.1

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_goodStarts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_goodStarts {N L Y x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ goodStarts N L Y ↔
      x ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧ x ∉ terminalBadStarts N L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_largePrimeCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_largePrimeCoordinates {x L Y p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y ↔
      ∃ n ∈ startTreeSupport x L,
        p ∈ largeOddPrimeSupport Y n

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_largePrimesInRange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_largePrimesInRange {Y X p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y X ↔
      p.Prime ∧ Y < p ∧ p ≤ X

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_largePrimesInRange_of_mem_coordinates
statement:
theorem mem_largePrimesInRange_of_mem_coordinates
    {N L Y x p : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hL : L ≤ N)
    (hx : x ∈ goodStarts N L Y)
    (hp : p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y) :
    p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N)

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_orderedDependencyEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_orderedDependencyEdges
    {N L Y : ℕ} {xy : ℕ × ℕ} :
    xy ∈ orderedDependencyEdges N L Y ↔
      xy.1 ∈ goodStarts N L Y ∧
        xy.2 ∈ goodStarts N L Y ∧
          LargePrimeAdjacent L Y xy.1 xy.2

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_orderedPairsUsingPrime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_orderedPairsUsingPrime
    {N L Y p : ℕ} {xy : ℕ × ℕ} :
    xy ∈ orderedPairsUsingPrime N L Y p ↔
      xy.1 ∈ startsUsingPrime N L Y p ∧
        xy.2 ∈ startsUsingPrime N L Y p

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_startRunSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startRunSupport {x L n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ startRunSupport x L ↔
      ∃ j < L, x + j = n

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_startTreeSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startTreeSupport {x L n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ startTreeSupport x L ↔
      n = x - 1 ∨ ∃ j < L, x + j = n

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_startsUsingPrime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startsUsingPrime {N L Y p x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ startsUsingPrime N L Y p ↔
      x ∈ goodStarts N L Y ∧
        p ∈ largePrimeCoordinates x L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.mem_startsWithDivisibleOffset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startsWithDivisibleOffset
    {N p j x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ startsWithDivisibleOffset N p j ↔
      x ∈ dyadicBlock N ∧ p ∣ x - 1 + j

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.ne_of_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
statement:
theorem ne_of_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hxy : (x, y) ∈ orderedDependencyEdges N L Y) :
    x ≠ y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.not_largePrimeAdjacent_self
statement:
theorem not_largePrimeAdjacent_self
    (L Y x : ℕ) :
    ¬LargePrimeAdjacent L Y x x

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.orderedDependencyEdges_subset_primeWitnessCover
statement:
theorem orderedDependencyEdges_subset_primeWitnessCover
    {N L Y : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hL : L ≤ N) :
    orderedDependencyEdges N L Y ⊆
      orderedPrimeWitnessCover N L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.pair_self_not_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
statement:
theorem pair_self_not_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
    (N L Y x : ℕ) :
    (x, x) ∉ orderedDependencyEdges N L Y

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.startsUsingPrime_subset_offsetUnion
statement:
theorem startsUsingPrime_subset_offsetUnion
    {N L Y p : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    startsUsingPrime N L Y p ⊆
      (Finset.range (L + 1)).biUnion fun j ↦
        startsWithDivisibleOffset N p j

name: PaperC.LargePrimeDependencyGraph.swap_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
statement:
theorem swap_mem_orderedDependencyEdges
    {N L Y x y : ℕ}
    (hxy : (x, y) ∈ orderedDependencyEdges N L Y) :
    (y, x) ∈ orderedDependencyEdges N L Y

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.card_largePrimesInRange_le
statement:
theorem card_largePrimesInRange_le
    (N Y : ℕ) :
    (largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N)).card ≤ 3 * N

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.card_orderedDependencyEdges_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_orderedDependencyEdges_cast_le
    {N L Y : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hLN : L ≤ N)
    (hLY : L ≤ Y) (hY : 4 ≤ Y) :
    ((orderedDependencyEdges N L Y).card : ℚ) ≤
      (L + 1 : ℚ) ^ 2 *
        (28 * (N : ℚ) ^ 2 /
            ((Y : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 Y : ℚ)) +
          6 * (N : ℚ) ^ 2 / (Y : ℚ) +
          3 * (N : ℚ))

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.largePrimesInRange_subset_dyadicPrimes
statement:
theorem largePrimesInRange_subset_dyadicPrimes
    {N Y : ℕ} (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N) ⊆
      dyadicPrimes Y (3 * N)

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.sum_div_add_one_sq_eq
statement:
theorem sum_div_add_one_sq_eq
    (N Y : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
        ((N : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2) =
      (N : ℚ) ^ 2 *
          (∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
            1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) +
        2 * (N : ℚ) *
          (∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
            1 / (p : ℚ)) +
        (largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N)).card

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.sum_div_add_one_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_div_add_one_sq_le
    {N Y : ℕ} (hY : 4 ≤ Y) :
    (∑ p ∈ largePrimesInRange Y (3 * N),
        ((N : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2) ≤
      28 * (N : ℚ) ^ 2 /
          ((Y : ℚ) * (Nat.log 2 Y : ℚ)) +
        6 * (N : ℚ) ^ 2 / (Y : ℚ) +
        3 * (N : ℚ)

name: PaperC.DependencyEdgeBound.sum_inv_largePrimesInRange_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_largePrimesInRange_le

name: PaperC.CRT.representative_lt_product
statement:
theorem representative_lt_product
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i ∈ indices, modulus i ≠ 0) :
    (Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
        residue modulus indices hcoprime : ℕ) <
      (indices.map modulus).prod

name: PaperC.CRT.satisfies_iff_intModEq_representative
statement:
theorem satisfies_iff_intModEq_representative
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (x : ℕ) :
    (∀ i ∈ indices,
        (x : ℤ) ≡ (residue i : ℤ) [ZMOD (modulus i : ℤ)]) ↔
      (x : ℤ) ≡
        (Nat.chineseRemainderOfList
          residue modulus indices hcoprime : ℕ)
        [ZMOD ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℤ)]

name: PaperC.CRT.satisfies_iff_modEq_representative
statement:
theorem satisfies_iff_modEq_representative
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (x : ℕ) :
    (∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]) ↔
      x ≡
        Nat.chineseRemainderOfList residue modulus indices hcoprime
          [MOD (indices.map modulus).prod]

name: PaperC.CRT.solutions_modEq
statement:
theorem solutions_modEq
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)

    (hx : ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i])
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ indices, y ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]) :
    x ≡ y [MOD (indices.map modulus).prod]

name: PaperC.RelationalInterpolation.eventually_sum_nonneg_and_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_sum_nonneg_and_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (admissible : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (relationalHosts A : ℕ → ℕ → Finset α)
    (u : ℕ → ℕ → α → ℝ)
    (H₂ Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hsubset :
      ∀ N L, admissible N L →
        A N L ⊆ relationalHosts N L)
    (hu :
      ∀ N L, admissible N L →
        ∀ a ∈ A N L, 0 ≤ u N L a)
    (hcard :
      ∃ Ncard : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ Ncard, ∀ L,
        admissible N L →
          ((relationalHosts N L).card : ℝ) ≤ H₂ N L)
    (hsq :
      ∃ Nsq : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ Nsq, ∀ L,
        admissible N L →
          (∑ a ∈ A N L, (u N L a) ^ 2) ≤ Q N L) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ N₀, ∀ L,
      admissible N L →
        0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ A N L, u N L a ∧
          ∑ a ∈ A N L, u N L a ≤
            Real.sqrt (H₂ N L) * Real.sqrt (Q N L)

    (hsq :

    ∑ x ∈ A, u x ≤
      (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2)

theorem sum_le_sqrt_relationalHosts_bound_mul_sqrt_sqBound
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (relationalHosts : ℕ → ℕ → Finset α)
    {N L : ℕ} {A : Finset α} {u : α → ℝ} {H₂ Q : ℝ}

name: PaperC.RungeScaling.scaledRungeValue_eq_abs_integer
statement:
theorem scaledRungeValue_eq_abs_integer
    {k U : ℕ} (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) (s : Fin (2 * k) → ℝ)
    (hsnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (hsq : ∀ i, (s i) ^ 2 =
      1 + (γ i : ℝ) / (U : ℝ))
    (a : ℤ)
    (hproduct :
      (∏ i, ((U : ℝ) + (γ i : ℝ))) = (a : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    scaledRungeValue U s = |(a : ℝ)|

name: PaperC.RungeScaling.scaledRungeValue_sq

      1 + (γ i : ℝ) / (U : ℝ)) :
    (scaledRungeValue U s) ^ 2 =
      ∏ i, ((U : ℝ) + (γ i : ℝ))

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.abs_tail_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_tail_le_two_mul
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {M R U : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hU : 4 * R < U)
    (hc : ∀ m, |c m| ≤ M * (2 * R) ^ m) (k : ℕ) :
    |(∑' m : ℕ, coefficientSeriesTerm c U m) -
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), coefficientSeriesTerm c U m| ≤
      2 * M * (2 * R / U) ^ (k + 1)

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.cast_eval_rungeTruncation_eq_pow_mul_realPartialSum
statement:
theorem cast_eval_rungeTruncation_eq_pow_mul_realPartialSum
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) {u : ℤ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (((RungeTruncation.rungeTruncation γ).eval (u : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      (u : ℝ) ^ k *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          coefficientSeriesTerm (realRungeCoefficient γ) (u : ℝ) m

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.eval_rungeTruncation_eq_pow_mul_partialSum
statement:
theorem eval_rungeTruncation_eq_pow_mul_partialSum
    {k : ℕ} (γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ) {u : ℚ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (RungeTruncation.rungeTruncation γ).eval u =
      u ^ k *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          RungeCoefficients.rungeCoefficient γ m / u ^ m

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.norm_coefficientSeriesTerm_le
statement:
theorem norm_coefficientSeriesTerm_le
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {M R U : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hU : 4 * R < U)
    (hc : ∀ m, |c m| ≤ M * (2 * R) ^ m) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖coefficientSeriesTerm c U m‖ ≤
      M * (2 * R / U) ^ m

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.pow_mul_abs_tail_le
statement:
theorem pow_mul_abs_tail_le
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {M R U : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hU : 4 * R < U)
    (hc : ∀ m, |c m| ≤ M * (2 * R) ^ m) (k : ℕ) :
    U ^ k *
        |(∑' m : ℕ, coefficientSeriesTerm c U m) -
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), coefficientSeriesTerm c U m| ≤
      2 * M * (2 * R) ^ (k + 1) / U

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.summable_coefficientSeriesTerm
statement:
theorem summable_coefficientSeriesTerm
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {M R U : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hU : 4 * R < U)
    (hc : ∀ m, |c m| ≤ M * (2 * R) ^ m) :
    Summable (coefficientSeriesTerm c U)

name: PaperC.RungeTailEstimate.tsum_sub_sum_range_eq_tail
statement:
theorem tsum_sub_sum_range_eq_tail
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} {U : ℝ}
    (hs : Summable (coefficientSeriesTerm c U)) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑' m : ℕ, coefficientSeriesTerm c U m) -
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), coefficientSeriesTerm c U m =
      ∑' n : ℕ, coefficientSeriesTerm c U (n + (k + 1))

    (q : ι → ℝ)

    (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)
    (active : ι → Bool) :
    eventProbability

        (NoRetainedActive active) =
      ∏ i, if active i = true then 1 - q i else 1

name: PaperC.SpatialThinningFinite.eventProbability_noRetainedActive_exponential_eq

theorem eventProbability_noRetainedActive_exponential_eq
    (g : ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i)
    (active : ι → Bool) :
    eventProbability
        (bernoulliProductPMF
          (exponentialRetention g)
          (fun i ↦ exponentialRetention_nonneg g hg i)
          (fun i ↦ exponentialRetention_le_one g i))
        (NoRetainedActive active) =
      Real.exp
        (-(∑ i, if active i = true then g i else 0))

          (exponentialRetention g)
          (fun i ↦ exponentialRetention_nonneg g hg i)
          (fun i ↦ exponentialRetention_le_one g i))

      Real.exp
        (-(∑ i, if active i = true then g i else 0))

name: PaperC.CRT.card_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_div_add_one
statement:
theorem card_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_div_add_one
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hpositive : ∀ i ∈ indices, 0 < modulus i)
    (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((#{x ∈ Ico a b |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]} : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (((((b : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
          ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℚ)) + 1

name: PaperC.CRT.card_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_scaled
statement:
theorem card_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_scaled
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hpositive : ∀ i ∈ indices, 0 < modulus i)
    (a b C₀ N : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlength : b - a ≤ C₀ * N)
    (hproduct_le : (indices.map modulus).prod ≤ N) :
    ((#{x ∈ Ico a b |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [MOD modulus i]} : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      ((((C₀ + 1) * N : ℕ) : ℚ) /
        ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℚ))

name: PaperC.CRT.card_product_Ico_satisfies_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_product_Ico_satisfies_cast_le
    (residue₁ residue₂ modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hpositive : ∀ i ∈ indices, 0 < modulus i)
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂) :
    ((({x ∈ Ico a₁ b₁ |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue₁ i [MOD modulus i]} ×ˢ
        {y ∈ Ico a₂ b₂ |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, y ≡ residue₂ i [MOD modulus i]}).card : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (((((b₁ : ℤ) - (a₁ : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
          ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℚ) + 1) *
        (((((b₂ : ℤ) - (a₂ : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
          ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℚ) + 1)

name: PaperC.CRT.card_product_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_scaled
statement:
theorem card_product_Ico_satisfies_cast_le_scaled
    (residue₁ residue₂ modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus))
    (hpositive : ∀ i ∈ indices, 0 < modulus i)
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ C₀ N : ℕ) (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlength₁ : b₁ - a₁ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (hlength₂ : b₂ - a₂ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (hproduct_le : (indices.map modulus).prod ≤ N) :
    ((({x ∈ Ico a₁ b₁ |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue₁ i [MOD modulus i]} ×ˢ
        {y ∈ Ico a₂ b₂ |
          ∀ i ∈ indices, y ≡ residue₂ i [MOD modulus i]}).card : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (((((C₀ + 1) * N : ℕ) : ℚ) /
          ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℚ)) ^ 2)

name: PaperC.ComponentSquareClass.canonical_decomposition
statement:
theorem canonical_decomposition
    {B : ℕ} {C : Finset ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ C, 0 < n)
    (hlarge :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → B < p →
        (∑ n ∈ C, parityVec n p) = 0) :
    0 < componentSquareClass B C ∧
      Squarefree (componentSquareClass B C) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ componentSquareClass B C → p ≤ B) ∧
      0 < componentSquareRoot C ∧
      componentProduct C =
        componentSquareClass B C * componentSquareRoot C ^ 2

name: PaperC.ComponentSquareClass.componentProduct_pos
statement:
theorem componentProduct_pos

    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ C, 0 < n) :

name: PaperC.ComponentSquareClass.componentSquareClass_unique
statement:
theorem componentSquareClass_unique
    {B : ℕ} {C : Finset ℕ}
    {d z : ℕ}
    (hdPos : 0 < d)
    (hzPos : 0 < z)
    (hdSquarefree : Squarefree d)
    (hdSupport : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → p ≤ B)
    (hfactor : componentProduct C = d * z ^ 2) :
    d = componentSquareClass B C

name: PaperC.ComponentSquareClass.decomposition_unique
statement:
theorem decomposition_unique
    {B : ℕ} {C : Finset ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ C, 0 < n)
    (hlarge :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → B < p →
        (∑ n ∈ C, parityVec n p) = 0)
    {d z : ℕ}
    (hdPos : 0 < d)
    (hzPos : 0 < z)
    (hdSquarefree : Squarefree d)
    (hdSupport : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → p ≤ B)
    (hfactor : componentProduct C = d * z ^ 2) :
    d = componentSquareClass B C ∧ z = componentSquareRoot C

name: PaperC.ComponentSquareClass.exists_squarefree_mul_sq
statement:
theorem exists_squarefree_mul_sq
    {B : ℕ} {C : Finset ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ C, 0 < n)
    (hlarge :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → B < p →
        (∑ n ∈ C, parityVec n p) = 0) :
    ∃ d z : ℕ,
      0 < d ∧ Squarefree d ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → p ≤ B) ∧
      0 < z ∧ componentProduct C = d * z ^ 2

statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_componentProduct_eq_one

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.common_largeOddKernel_dvd

theorem common_largeOddKernel_dvd
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    largeOddKernel B t ∣ X ∧
      largeOddKernel B t ∣ t ∧
      largeOddKernel B t ∣ Y

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_defect_dichotomy

theorem exactUnit_defect_dichotomy
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y) :
    (largeOddKernel B t = 1 ∧
        HDefective B X ∧ HDefective B t ∧ HDefective B Y) ∨
      (1 < largeOddKernel B t ∧
        ¬HDefective B X ∧ ¬HDefective B t ∧ ¬HDefective B Y)

    largeOddKernel B X = largeOddKernel B t ∧
      largeOddKernel B Y = largeOddKernel B t

theorem exactUnit_largeOddPrimeSupport_eq
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}

    largeOddPrimeSupport B X =

      largeOddPrimeSupport B Y =

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_large_factorization_odd_iff
statement:
theorem exactUnit_large_factorization_odd_iff
    {B a b t X Y p : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    (Odd (X.factorization p) ↔ Odd (t.factorization p)) ∧
      (Odd (t.factorization p) ↔ Odd (Y.factorization p))

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exactUnit_large_parity_eq
statement:
theorem exactUnit_large_parity_eq
    {B a b t X Y p : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : B < p) :
    parityVec X p = parityVec t p ∧
      parityVec t p = parityVec Y p

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.exists_common_large_odd_prime
statement:
theorem exists_common_large_odd_prime
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}
    (h : ExactUnitFactorization B a b t X Y)
    (hk : largeOddKernel B t ≠ 1) :
    ∃ p : ℕ,
      p.Prime ∧ B < p ∧
        parityVec X p ≠ 0 ∧ parityVec t p ≠ 0 ∧
        parityVec Y p ≠ 0 ∧
        p ∣ largeOddKernel B t ∧
        p ∣ X ∧ p ∣ t ∧ p ∣ Y

name: PaperC.ExactUnitLargeKernel.hDefective_right_iff
statement:
theorem hDefective_right_iff
    {B a b t X Y : ℕ}

name: PaperC.ResidualChannelLemmaSevenTwo.mem_residualPrimeRange_of_nonempty

    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card)
    (hX :
      (L + 1) * 2 ^ (Nat.max a b + 2) ≤ X) :
    residualPrimeMass L a b h =
      ∑ p ∈ primesBetween (L + 1) X,
        ((residualPrimeCells L a b p h).card : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)

name: PaperC.ResidualChannelLemmaSevenTwo.residualPrimeMass_le

    {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}

    (hqTwo : 2 ≤ Nat.max a b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ L + 1)

    residualPrimeMass L a b h ≤
      896 * (L + 1 : ℚ) / (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)

name: PaperC.TerminalMatching.two_vertex_components_kernel_package
statement:
theorem two_vertex_components_kernel_package
    {x y L : ℕ}
    {Cs Ct : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent}
    {vs ws vt wt : Occurrence L}
    (hvs : vs ∈ componentVertices x y L Cs)
    (hws : ws ∈ componentVertices x y L Cs)
    (hvsws : vs ≠ ws)
    (hcardS : Fintype.card Cs.supp = 2)
    (hfreeS : ¬IsPinnedComponent x y L Cs)
    (hvt : vt ∈ componentVertices x y L Ct)
    (hwt : wt ∈ componentVertices x y L Ct)
    (hvtwt : vt ≠ wt)
    (hcardT : Fintype.card Ct.supp = 2)
    (hfreeT : ¬IsPinnedComponent x y L Ct)
    (hST : Cs ≠ Ct) :
    let Xs := twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L vs
    let Ys := twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L ws
    let Xt := twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L vt
    let Yt := twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L wt
    let Rs := largeOddKernel (L + 1) Xs
    let Rt := largeOddKernel (L + 1) Xt
    Rs = largeOddKernel (L + 1) Ys ∧
      Rt = largeOddKernel (L + 1) Yt ∧
      1 < Rs ∧ 1 < Rt ∧
      Nat.Coprime Rs Rt ∧
      (((Rs * Rt : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣
        crossDeterminant Xs Ys Xt Yt)

name: PaperC.DefectCodeRunge.kernelWord_translatedRungeInput
statement:
theorem kernelWord_translatedRungeInput
    {m r U R : ℕ}
    (smallPrime : Fin r → ℕ) (f : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hf0 : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0)
    (hcover : ∀ i p, parityVec (f i) p ≠ 0 →
      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective f)
    (hlower : ∀ i, U ≤ f i)
    (hupper : ∀ i, f i ≤ U + R)
    (x : Fin m → F₂)
    (hx :
      x ∈ LinearMap.ker
        (DefectCodeRank.augmentedParityMap smallPrime f)) :
    let S := HammingBound.wordSupport x
    let selected : {i // i ∈ S} → ℕ := fun i ↦ f i
    Function.Injective
        (RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected) ∧
      (∀ i,
        |RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i| ≤ R) ∧
      ∃ a : ℤ,
        (∏ i,
          ((U : ℤ) +
            RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i)) = a ^ 2

    {m r U R : ℕ}

    (f s a : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hrep : ∀ i, f i = s i * (a i) ^ 2)
    (hs : ∀ i, s i ≠ 0)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0)
    (hsmall : ∀ i p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ s i →
      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective f)
    (hlower : ∀ i, U ≤ f i)
    (hupper : ∀ i, f i ≤ U + R)
    (x : Fin m → F₂)
    (hx :
      x ∈ LinearMap.ker
        (DefectCodeRank.augmentedParityMap smallPrime f)) :
    let S := HammingBound.wordSupport x
    let selected : {i // i ∈ S} → ℕ := fun i ↦ f i
    Function.Injective
        (RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected) ∧
      (∀ i,
        |RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i| ≤ R) ∧
      ∃ q : ℤ,
        (∏ i,
          ((U : ℤ) +
            RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i)) = q ^ 2
