    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0)
    (hsmall : ∀ i p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ s i →
      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p)
    (x : Fin m → F₂)
    (hx :
      x ∈ LinearMap.ker
        (DefectCodeRank.augmentedParityMap smallPrime f)) :
    ∃ q : ℕ,
      ∏ i ∈ HammingBound.wordSupport x, f i = q ^ 2

      ∃ j : Fin r, smallPrime j = p)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective f)
    (hlower : ∀ i, U ≤ f i)
    (hupper : ∀ i, f i ≤ U + R)

name: PaperC.DefectCodeDistance.reindex_translatedRungeInput
statement:
theorem reindex_translatedRungeInput
    {α : Type*} {S : Finset α} {U R k : ℕ}
    (selected : S → ℕ)
    (hcard : S.card = 2 * k)
    (hinjective :
      Function.Injective
        (RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected))
    (hbounded :
      ∀ i, |RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i| ≤ R)
    (hsquare :
      ∃ q : ℤ,
        (∏ i,
          ((U : ℤ) +
            RungeTranslation.translatedShift U selected i)) = q ^ 2) :
    ∃ γ : Fin (2 * k) → ℤ,
      Function.Injective γ ∧
      (∀ i, |γ i| ≤ R) ∧
      ∃ q : ℤ, (∏ i, ((U : ℤ) + γ i)) = q ^ 2

name: PaperC.ExactUnitIsolation.exactUnit_graph_dichotomy

theorem exactUnit_graph_dichotomy
    {x y L a b t : ℕ}

    {v w : Fin (L + 1)}
    (h :
      ExactUnitFactorization
        (L + 1) a b t
        (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v)
        (startCompleteVertexLabel y L w)) :
    (IsDefective x y L (Sum.inl v) ∧
        IsDefective x y L (Sum.inr w)) ∨
      ((largePrimeGraph x y L).Adj
          (Sum.inl v) (Sum.inr w) ∧
        IsNontrivialUnpinnedComponent
          (largePrimeGraph x y L)
          (pinnedVertices x y L)
          ((largePrimeGraph x y L).connectedComponentMk
            (Sum.inl v)) ∧
        Fintype.card
            ((largePrimeGraph x y L).connectedComponentMk
              (Sum.inl v)).supp =
          2)

    (hx : x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (hy : y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (hheight : h = (b : ℤ) * y - (a : ℤ) * x) :
    Module.finrank F₂
        (RationalChannelCode.rationalCode
          T x y L a b h ha hb
          (hN.trans (mem_boundedRatioBlock.mp hx).1)
          (hN.trans (mem_boundedRatioBlock.mp hy).1)
          hheight) =
      (channelCells L a b h).card - 1

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.card_boundedRatioPairs_le
statement:
theorem card_boundedRatioPairs_le
    {N M κ₀ : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ κ₀ * N) :
    (boundedRatioPairs N M).card ≤ (κ₀ * N) ^ 2

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.card_separatedBoundedRatioPairs_le
statement:
theorem card_separatedBoundedRatioPairs_le
    (N M L : ℕ) :
    (separatedBoundedRatioPairs N M L).card ≤ (M - N) ^ 2

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.channelTranslationParameter_bounds
statement:
theorem channelTranslationParameter_bounds
    {N M L a b x y : ℕ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ} {t : ℤ}
    (hx : x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (hy : y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (hcell : cell ∈ offsetBox L)
    (htx : (x : ℤ) + cell.1 = (b : ℤ) * t)
    (hty : (y : ℤ) + cell.2 = (a : ℤ) * t) :
    (N : ℤ) - 1 ≤ (b : ℤ) * t ∧
      (b : ℤ) * t < (M : ℤ) + L ∧
      (N : ℤ) - 1 ≤ (a : ℤ) * t ∧
      (a : ℤ) * t < (M : ℤ) + L

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.channelTranslationParameter_unique
statement:
theorem channelTranslationParameter_unique
    {a b x : ℕ} {i t₁ t₂ : ℤ}
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (h₁ : (x : ℤ) + i = (b : ℤ) * t₁)
    (h₂ : (x : ℤ) + i = (b : ℤ) * t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.exists_channelTranslationParameter
statement:
theorem exists_channelTranslationParameter
    {N M L a b x y : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {cell : ℤ × ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hpair : (x, y) ∈ boundedChannelStartPairs N M a b h)
    (hcell : cell ∈ channelCells L a b h) :
    ∃ t : ℤ,
      (x : ℤ) + cell.1 = (b : ℤ) * t ∧
      (y : ℤ) + cell.2 = (a : ℤ) * t

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.exists_mem_dyadicShell
statement:
theorem exists_mem_dyadicShell
    {N J x : ℕ}
    (hxLower : N ≤ x)
    (hxUpper : x < 2 ^ J * N) :
    ∃ r < J, x ∈ dyadicShell N r

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.fst_injOn_boundedChannelStartPairs
statement:
theorem fst_injOn_boundedChannelStartPairs
    {N M a b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) {h : ℤ} :
    Set.InjOn Prod.fst
      (↑(boundedChannelStartPairs N M a b h) : Set (ℕ × ℕ))

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_boundedChannelStartPairs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedChannelStartPairs
    {N M a b x y : ℕ} {h : ℤ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedChannelStartPairs N M a b h ↔
      x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      pairChannelError x y a b = h

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_boundedDyadicShell
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedDyadicShell {N M r x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ boundedDyadicShell N M r ↔
      N ≤ x ∧ x < M ∧
      2 ^ r * N ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ (r + 1) * N

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_boundedRatioBlock
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedRatioBlock {N M x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ↔ N ≤ x ∧ x < M

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_boundedRatioPairs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedRatioPairs {N M x y : ℕ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedRatioPairs N M ↔
      N ≤ x ∧ x < M ∧ N ≤ y ∧ y < M

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_dyadicShell
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dyadicShell {N r x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ dyadicShell N r ↔
      2 ^ r * N ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ (r + 1) * N

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.mem_separatedBoundedRatioPairs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_separatedBoundedRatioPairs
    {N M L x y : ℕ} :
    (x, y) ∈ separatedBoundedRatioPairs N M L ↔
      x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      L < Nat.dist x y

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.nontrivialChannelHeights_card_le_three_mul_add_one

theorem nontrivialChannelHeights_card_le_three_mul_add_one

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.pair_mem_boundedHeightTwoPairCover_of_choice

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.pair_mem_boundedLargeChannelPairCover_of_choice

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.self_le_two_pow

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioGeometry.snd_injOn_boundedChannelStartPairs

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.assignmentCountBound_le_ratio_mul_kernelWeightQ
statement:
theorem assignmentCountBound_le_ratio_mul_kernelWeightQ
    {κ₀ N M L n : ℕ}
    (hNM : N ≤ M) (hMκ : M ≤ κ₀ * N) (hL : L ≤ N)
    (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M + L)) :
    assignmentCountBound N M L n ≤
      (2 * (κ₀ + 1) : ℚ) * (N : ℚ) *
        RelationalHosts.largeKernelWeightQ (L + 1) n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.boundedRelationalHosts_subset_certificateCover
statement:
theorem boundedRelationalHosts_subset_certificateCover
    {N M L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    boundedRelationalHosts N M L ⊆ certificateCover N M L

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_boundedRelationalHosts_cast_le_assignmentSum
statement:
theorem card_boundedRelationalHosts_cast_le_assignmentSum
    {N M L : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hNM : N ≤ M) :
    ((boundedRelationalHosts N M L).card : ℚ) ≤
      2 * (L + 1 : ℚ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M + L),
          assignmentCountBound N M L n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_boundedRelationalHosts_cast_le_kernelSumQ
statement:
theorem card_boundedRelationalHosts_cast_le_kernelSumQ
    {κ₀ N M L : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hNM : N ≤ M)
    (hMκ : M ≤ κ₀ * N) (hL : L ≤ N) :
    ((boundedRelationalHosts N M L).card : ℚ) ≤
      4 * (κ₀ + 1 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) * (N : ℚ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M + L),
          RelationalHosts.largeKernelWeightQ (L + 1) n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_certificate_union_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_certificate_union_cast_le
    {N M L n : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hNM : N ≤ M)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    ((leftCertificates N M L n v ∪
        rightCertificates N M L n v).card : ℚ) ≤
      2 * assignmentCountBound N M L n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_leftCertificates_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_leftCertificates_cast_le

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_rightCertificates_cast_le

theorem card_rightCertificates_cast_le

    (v : Fin (L + 1)) :
    ((rightCertificates N M L n v).card : ℚ) ≤
      assignmentCountBound N M L n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_startsForAssignment_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_startsForAssignment_cast_le
    {N M L n : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hNM : N ≤ M)
    (assignment : LargePrimeAssignment L n) :
    ((startsForAssignment N M L n assignment).card : ℚ) ≤

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_startsForSomeAssignment_cast_le

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.card_startsWithSelectedLabel_le_one

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.chosenRelation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chosenRelation_ne_zero

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.left_mem_startsForSomeAssignment_of_selected_right
statement:
theorem left_mem_startsForSomeAssignment_of_selected_right
    {N M L x y : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hx : x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (hy : y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M)
    (u : RelationSpace (twoStartSystem (M + L) x y L))
    (v : Fin (L + 1))

      twoStartCompleteBoundary L

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.mem_boundedRelationalHosts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedRelationalHosts
    {N M L x y : ℕ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedRelationalHosts N M L ↔
      x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      L < Nat.dist x y ∧
      0 < relationRho (twoStartSystem (M + L) x y L)

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.mem_startsForAssignment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startsForAssignment
    {N M L n y : ℕ} {assignment : LargePrimeAssignment L n} :
    y ∈ startsForAssignment N M L n assignment ↔
      y ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      ∀ p : LargePrimeIndex L n,
        parityVec
            (startCompleteVertexLabel y L (assignment p))
            p.1 ≠ 0

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.mem_startsForSomeAssignment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startsForSomeAssignment
    {N M L n y : ℕ} :
    y ∈ startsForSomeAssignment N M L n ↔
      ∃ assignment : LargePrimeAssignment L n,
        y ∈ startsForAssignment N M L n assignment

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.mem_startsWithSelectedLabel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_startsWithSelectedLabel
    {N M L n x : ℕ} {v : Fin (L + 1)} :
    x ∈ startsWithSelectedLabel N M L n v ↔
      x ∈ boundedRatioBlock N M ∧
      startCompleteVertexLabel x L v = n

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.pairwise_modEq_largeOddKernel
statement:
theorem pairwise_modEq_largeOddKernel

    {y z : ℕ}
    (hy : y ∈ startsForAssignment N M L n assignment)

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.right_mem_startsForSomeAssignment_of_selected_left

theorem right_mem_startsForSomeAssignment_of_selected_left

    (v : Fin (L + 1))
    (hvSelected :

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.selectedLabel_mem_Icc

theorem selectedLabel_mem_Icc

name: PaperC.BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.selectedOccurrence_ne_zero

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost_iff
    {A x y L N : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    CanonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N ↔
      canonicalResidualPrimeProduct
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy ≤ N

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost_iff_not_exceeds
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost_iff_not_exceeds
    {A x y L : ℕ}

    CanonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N ↔
      ¬CanonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds_iff
    {A x y L N : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    CanonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N ↔
      N < canonicalResidualPrimeProduct
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds_iff_not_atMost
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds_iff_not_atMost
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (N : ℕ) :
    CanonicalResidualPrimeProductExceeds
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N ↔
      ¬CanonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost
        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_branches_disjoint
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_branches_disjoint
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (N : ℕ) :

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_dichotomy

        (A := A) (L := L) hx hy N

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_eq_product_certificates

theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_eq_product_certificates

      ∏ C :
          {C : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent //
            C ∈ canonicalResidualComponents A x y L},

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_factorCount

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_pos
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualPrimeProduct_pos

    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.one_le_canonicalResidualPrimeProduct

theorem one_le_canonicalResidualPrimeProduct

name: PaperC.CRT.certificateCellWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem certificateCellWeightSum_le
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ)
    (cellCount modulus : ι → ℕ) (u : ℚ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hmodulus : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < modulus i) :
    certificateWeightSum s r
        (fun i ↦ u * (cellCount i : ℚ) / (modulus i : ℚ)) ≤
      (u * ∑ i ∈ s, (cellCount i : ℚ) / (modulus i : ℚ)) ^ r /
        r.factorial

name: PaperC.CRT.certificatePairCellWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem certificatePairCellWeightSum_le
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ)
    (modulus : ι → ℕ) (M : ℕ) (u : ℚ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hmodulus : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < modulus i) :
    certificateWeightSum s r
        (fun i ↦ u * (M : ℚ) / (modulus i : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤
      (u * (M : ℚ) *
          ∑ i ∈ s, 1 / (modulus i : ℚ) ^ 2) ^ r /
        r.factorial

name: PaperC.CRT.certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum_div_factorial
statement:
theorem certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum_div_factorial
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    certificateWeightSum s r w ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.CRT.factorial_mul_certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (r.factorial : ℚ) * certificateWeightSum s r w ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ r

name: PaperC.CRT.orderedCertificateToFunction_injective
statement:
theorem orderedCertificateToFunction_injective

    Function.Injective

name: PaperC.CRT.orderedCertificate_sum_eq_factorial_mul

theorem orderedCertificate_sum_eq_factorial_mul

name: PaperC.CRT.orderedCertificate_sum_le_all_functions
statement:
theorem orderedCertificate_sum_le_all_functions

name: PaperC.CRT.sum_certificateWeightSum_le_exponentialMajorant
statement:
theorem sum_certificateWeightSum_le_exponentialMajorant
    (s : Finset ι) (R : ℕ) (w : ι → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, certificateWeightSum s r w) ≤
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.CRT.unorderedCertificate_subset

name: PaperC.CRT.admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass_le
statement:
theorem admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass_le
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ)
    (residue₁ residue₂ modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime)
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ C₀ N : ℕ)
    (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlength₁ : b₁ - a₁ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (hlength₂ : b₂ - a₂ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (u : ℚ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass
        s r residue₁ residue₂ modulus a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ N u ≤
      ((((C₀ + 1) * N : ℕ) : ℚ) ^ 2) *
        ((∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℚ) ^ 2) ^ r /
          r.factorial)

name: PaperC.CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
statement:
theorem admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ)
    (residue modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime)

name: PaperC.CRT.labeledCell_admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass_le
statement:
theorem labeledCell_admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass_le
    (cells : π → Finset κ) (r : ℕ)
    (residue₁ residue₂ : LabeledCell cells → ℕ)
    (modulus : π → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ p, (modulus p).Prime)
    (hcard : ∀ p, (cells p).card ≤ M)
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ C₀ N : ℕ)
    (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlength₁ : b₁ - a₁ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (hlength₂ : b₂ - a₂ ≤ C₀ * N)
    (u : ℚ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    admissibleCertificatePairSolutionMass
        (Finset.univ : Finset (LabeledCell cells)) r
        residue₁ residue₂ (labeledCellModulus cells modulus)
        a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ N u ≤
      ((((C₀ + 1) * N : ℕ) : ℚ) ^ 2) *
        ((u * (M : ℚ) *
            ∑ p : π, 1 / (modulus p : ℚ) ^ 2) ^ r /
          r.factorial)

name: PaperC.CanonicalResidualComponents.canonicalResidualAmbient_admissibleCertificateSolutionMass_le
statement:

    {L a b N r : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a.Coprime b)
    (hqTwo : 2 ≤ Nat.max a b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ L + 1)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card) :
    CRT.admissibleCertificateSolutionMass
        (Finset.univ :
          Finset (CanonicalResidualAmbientCell L a b h))
        r
        canonicalResidualAmbientLeftResidue
        canonicalResidualAmbientCellModulus
        N (2 * N) N 4 ≤
      (((2 * N : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        (((3584 : ℚ) * (L + 1 : ℚ) /
            (Nat.log 2 (L + 1) : ℚ)) ^ r /
          (r.factorial : ℚ)))

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.mem_activeSmallProductPairs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_activeSmallProductPairs
    {N A L : ℕ} {hN : 2 ≤ N}
    {pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L} :
    pair ∈ activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN ↔
      CanonicalResidualPrimeProductAtMost
          (A := A) (L := L)
          (show 1 ≤ pair.1.1 by
            exact le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
              (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).1)
          (show 1 ≤ pair.1.2 by
            exact le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
              (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).2)
          N ∧
        0 < pairTau A hN pair

    pair ∈ positiveSigmaSmallProductPairs N A L hN ↔
      pair ∈ activeSmallProductPairs N A L hN ∧
        0 < pairSigma A pair

        (A := A) (L := L)
        (show 1 ≤ pair.1.1 by
          exact le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
            (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).1)
        (show 1 ≤ pair.1.2 by
          exact le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
            (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).2)
        N

name: PaperC.ResidualMasses.pair_coordinates_two_le
statement:
theorem pair_coordinates_two_le

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.card_filter_large_le_one

      ∀ ⦃s t : ι⦄, s ∈ indices → t ∈ indices → s ≠ t →
        factor s * factor t ≤ T ^ 2) :
    (indices.filter fun t ↦ T < factor t).card ≤ 1

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.card_incidences_eq_sum_left_fibers

theorem card_incidences_eq_sum_left_fibers
    (left : Finset α) (right : Finset β)

    (incidences left right related).card =
      ∑ b ∈ right, (left.filter fun a ↦ related a b).card

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.card_incidences_eq_sum_right_fibers

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.card_left_le_twice_card_right
statement:
theorem card_left_le_twice_card_right
    (left : Finset α) (right : Finset β)
    (related : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel related]
    (B m : ℕ)
    (hBPos : 0 < B)
    (hB : B ≤ 2 * m)
    (hlower :
      ∀ a ∈ left,
        m ≤ (right.filter fun b ↦ related a b).card)
    (hupper :
      ∀ b ∈ right,
        (left.filter fun a ↦ related a b).card ≤ B) :
    left.card ≤ 2 * right.card

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.eq_of_both_large
statement:
theorem eq_of_both_large
    (indices : Finset ι) (factor : ι → ℕ) (T : ℕ)
    (hpair :
      ∀ ⦃s t : ι⦄, s ∈ indices → t ∈ indices → s ≠ t →
        factor s * factor t ≤ T ^ 2)
    {s t : ι}
    (hs : s ∈ indices) (ht : t ∈ indices)
    (hsLarge : T < factor s) (htLarge : T < factor t) :
    s = t

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.incidence_double_count
statement:
theorem incidence_double_count
    (left : Finset α) (right : Finset β)
    (related : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel related]
    (m q : ℕ)
    (hlower :
      ∀ a ∈ left,
        m ≤ (right.filter fun b ↦ related a b).card)
    (hupper :
      ∀ b ∈ right,
        (left.filter fun a ↦ related a b).card ≤ q) :
    m * left.card ≤ q * right.card

name: PaperC.TerminalClosureCounting.incidence_half_specialization
statement:
theorem incidence_half_specialization
    (left : Finset α) (right : Finset β)
    (related : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel related]
    (B m : ℕ)
    (hB : B ≤ 2 * m)
    (hlower :
      ∀ a ∈ left,
        m ≤ (right.filter fun b ↦ related a b).card)
    (hupper :
      ∀ b ∈ right,
        (left.filter fun a ↦ related a b).card ≤ B) :
    B * left.card ≤ 2 * B * right.card

    (htau : ∀ z ∈ population, tau z ≤ B + 2) :
    (∑ z ∈ population, (2 ^ tau z - 1)) ≤
      population.card * (4 * 2 ^ B)

          N A L hN smallRowRank rankBudget).card ≤ firstBound)
    (hpartners :

PaperC.CanonicalTerminalPopulation.mem_terminalPairsAtBudget
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_terminalPairsAtBudget
    {N A L : ℕ} {hN : 2 ≤ N}
    {smallRowRank : SeparatedDyadicPair N L → ℕ}
    {rankBudget : ℕ}
    {pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L} :
    pair ∈ terminalPairsAtBudget

      pair ∈ deepCorePairs N A L hN ∧

        (pairChannelError x y c.1.1 c.1.2) cell| <
      ((4 * Nat.max c.1.1 c.1.2 * (L + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.canonicalResidualCertificates_prime_lt_four_mul_max_of_not_onChannel
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualCertificates_prime_lt_four_mul_max_of_not_onChannel
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (c : ReducedCandidate
      x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A))
    (C :
      {C : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent //
        C ∈ canonicalResidualComponents A x y L})
    (hnonexact :
      ¬OnChannel c.1.1 c.1.2
        (pairChannelError x y c.1.1 c.1.2)
        (canonicalResidualCertificates hx hy C).offsetCell) :
    (canonicalResidualCertificates hx hy C).prime <
      4 * Nat.max c.1.1 c.1.2 * (L + 1)

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.canonicalResidualComponentCount_le_two_add_primeCount_of_choice
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualComponentCount_le_two_add_primeCount_of_choice
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (c : ReducedCandidate
      x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A))
    (hchoice :
      canonicalReducedCandidate?
          x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A) =
        some c) :
    canonicalResidualComponentCount A x y L ≤
      2 +
        PrimesUpTo.count
          (4 * Nat.max c.1.1 c.1.2 * (L + 1))

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.card_exactCanonicalResidualCertificates_le_two_of_choice
statement:
theorem card_exactCanonicalResidualCertificates_le_two_of_choice
    {A x y L : ℕ}

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.card_nonexactCanonicalResidualCertificates_le_primeCount
statement:
theorem card_nonexactCanonicalResidualCertificates_le_primeCount
    {A x y L : ℕ}

    (c : ReducedCandidate
      x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A)) :
    (nonexactCanonicalResidualCertificates hx hy c).card ≤

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.mem_exactCanonicalResidualCertificates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_exactCanonicalResidualCertificates
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    {hx : 1 ≤ x} {hy : 1 ≤ y}
    {c : ReducedCandidate
      x y (L + 1) ((L + 1) ^ A)}
    {C :
      {C : (largePrimeGraph x y L).ConnectedComponent //
        C ∈ canonicalResidualComponents A x y L}} :

name: PaperC.SmallHeightResidualPrimeSupport.mem_nonexactCanonicalResidualCertificates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_nonexactCanonicalResidualCertificates
    {A x y L : ℕ}
    {hx : 1 ≤ x} {hy : 1 ≤ y}
    {c : ReducedCandidate

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.disjoint_normalizedFactors_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem disjoint_normalizedFactors_of_isCoprime
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizationMonoid R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R]
    {x y : R} (hxy : IsCoprime x y) :
    Disjoint
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors x)
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors y)

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_finset_prod_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_finset_prod_of_pairwise
    {R ι : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizationMonoid R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R]
    (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R)
    (hg0 : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ≠ 0)
    (hcop : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) :
    factorCountProduct (∏ i ∈ s, g i) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, factorCountProduct (g i)

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_mappedPrimePower_le
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_mappedPrimePower_le
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    (p : Ideal ℤ) (hp : p ≠ ⊥) [p.IsMaximal]
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    factorCountProduct
        ((Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) p) ^ a) ≤
      (a + 1) ^ 2

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_mul_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_mul_of_isCoprime
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizationMonoid R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R]
    {x y : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : IsCoprime x y) :
    factorCountProduct (x * y) =
      factorCountProduct x * factorCountProduct y

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_primeFactors_assembly
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_primeFactors_assembly
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (n : ℕ) :
    factorCountProduct
        (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p) =
      ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors,
        factorCountProduct (rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p)

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_rationalPrimePowerIdeal_le
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_rationalPrimePowerIdeal_le
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    {n p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) :
    factorCountProduct (rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p) ≤
      (n.factorization p + 1) ^ 2

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorCountProduct_span_natPrime_pow_le
statement:
theorem factorCountProduct_span_natPrime_pow_le
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    factorCountProduct
        ((Ideal.span ({(p : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K))) ^ a) ≤
      (a + 1) ^ 2

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.factorization_ne_zero_of_mem_primeFactors
statement:
theorem factorization_ne_zero_of_mem_primeFactors
    {n p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) :
    n.factorization p ≠ 0

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.local_quadratic_factor_bound
statement:
theorem local_quadratic_factor_bound
    (a r e f : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hfund : r * (e * f) = 2) :
    (a * e + 1) ^ r ≤ (a + 1) ^ 2

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.map_span_int_eq_span_intCast
statement:
theorem map_span_int_eq_span_intCast
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (M : ℤ) :
    (Ideal.span ({M} : Set ℤ)).map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) =
      Ideal.span ({(M : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K))

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.natCard_idealDivisors_eq_prod_factorCounts
statement:
theorem natCard_idealDivisors_eq_prod_factorCounts
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [DecidableEq (Ideal R)]
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    Nat.card {I : Ideal R // I ∣ J} =
      ∏ P ∈ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).toFinset,
        ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).count P + 1)

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.rationalPrimePowerIdeal_isCoprime
statement:
theorem rationalPrimePowerIdeal_isCoprime
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {n p q : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) (hq : q ∈ n.primeFactors)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    IsCoprime (rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p)
      (rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n q)

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.rationalPrimePowerIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem rationalPrimePowerIdeal_ne_bot
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {n p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) :
    rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p ≠ ⊥

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.span_intCast_eq_span_natAbs
statement:
theorem span_intCast_eq_span_natAbs
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (M : ℤ) :
    Ideal.span ({(M : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K)) =
      Ideal.span ({(M.natAbs : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K))

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.span_natCast_eq_prod_primeFactors
statement:
theorem span_natCast_eq_prod_primeFactors
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CharZero B]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Ideal.span ({(n : B)} : Set B) =
      ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors,
        (Ideal.span ({(p : B)} : Set B)) ^ n.factorization p

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.span_natCast_eq_prod_rationalPrimePowerIdeal
statement:
theorem span_natCast_eq_prod_rationalPrimePowerIdeal
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Ideal.span ({(n : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K)) =
      ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, rationalPrimePowerIdeal K n p

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.span_natPrime_isMaximal
statement:
theorem span_natPrime_isMaximal {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)).IsMaximal

name: PaperC.QuadraticIdealDivisors.span_natPrime_ne_bot
statement:
theorem span_natPrime_ne_bot {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ) ≠ (⊥ : Ideal ℤ)

name: PaperC.NonalignedCoreRank.finrank_componentKernel_eq_card_sub_kTilde
statement:
theorem finrank_componentKernel_eq_card_sub_kTilde
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (constraints : (ι → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] W) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker constraints) =
      Fintype.card ι - kTilde constraints

name: PaperC.NonalignedCoreRank.largePrimeKTilde_eq_kTilde
statement:
theorem largePrimeKTilde_eq_kTilde
    {x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (constraints :
      (UnpinnedComponent
          (largePrimeGraph x y L)
          (pinnedVertices x y L) → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] W) :
    largePrimeKTilde hx hy constraints =
      kTilde constraints

name: PaperC.NonalignedCoreRank.largePrime_exact_rank
statement:
theorem largePrime_exact_rank
    {x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (constraints :
      (UnpinnedComponent
          (largePrimeGraph x y L)
          (pinnedVertices x y L) → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] W) :
    Module.finrank F₂
        (LinearMap.ker
          (largePrimeConstraintMap hx hy constraints)) =
      defectiveVertexCount x y L +
          nontrivialComponentCount x y L -
        kTilde constraints

name: PaperC.NonalignedCoreRank.lemma_nine_ten_exact_rank
statement:
theorem lemma_nine_ten_exact_rank
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Dsharp csharp : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = Dsharp + csharp)
    (constraints : (ι → F₂) →ₗ[F₂] W) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker constraints) =
      Dsharp + csharp - kTilde constraints

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.canonicalSmallRowRank_le_corrected_add_components
statement:
theorem canonicalSmallRowRank_le_corrected_add_components
    {rowCount A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (matrix : CanonicalSmallRowMatrix rowCount A x y L) :
    canonicalSmallRowRank matrix ≤
      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount A x y L +

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.card_canonicalCoreCoordinate
statement:
theorem card_canonicalCoreCoordinate

statement:
theorem card_canonicalCorrectedDefectiveVertices

      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount A x y L

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.card_correctedDefectiveVertices
statement:
theorem card_correctedDefectiveVertices
    {x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    (correctedDefectiveVertices x y L a b h).card =
      correctedDefectCount x y L a b h

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.card_exactDefectiveVertices
statement:
theorem card_exactDefectiveVertices
    {x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ}

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.exactDefectiveVertices_subset_defectiveVertices
statement:
theorem exactDefectiveVertices_subset_defectiveVertices

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.finrank_canonicalSmallRowKernel
statement:
theorem finrank_canonicalSmallRowKernel
    {rowCount A x y L : ℕ}
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (matrix : CanonicalSmallRowMatrix rowCount A x y L) :
    Module.finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker matrix.mulVecLin) =
      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount A x y L +
          canonicalResidualComponentCount A x y L -

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.mem_exactDefectiveVertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_exactDefectiveVertices
    {x y L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} {v : Occurrence L} :
    v ∈ exactDefectiveVertices x y L a b h ↔
      ∃ unit : DefectiveChannelUnit x y L a b h,
        (Sum.inl unit.1.1.1 : Occurrence L) = v

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.pairTau_add_kTilde_eq_corrected_add_components
statement:
theorem pairTau_add_kTilde_eq_corrected_add_components
    {N A L : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L)
    (presentation :
      CanonicalSmallRowPresentation
        (dyadicCutoff N L) A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L
        (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).1
        (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).2) :
    pairTau A hN pair + presentation.kTilde =
      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
            A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L +
        canonicalResidualComponentCount
          A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L

name: PaperC.CanonicalExactRank.pairTau_eq_corrected_add_components_sub_kTilde
statement:
theorem pairTau_eq_corrected_add_components_sub_kTilde
    {N A L : ℕ}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (pair : SeparatedDyadicPair N L)
    (presentation :
      CanonicalSmallRowPresentation
        (dyadicCutoff N L) A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L
        (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).1
        (pair_coordinates_two_le hN pair).2) :
    pairTau A hN pair =
      canonicalCorrectedDefectCount
            A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L +
          canonicalResidualComponentCount
            A pair.1.1 pair.1.2 L -
        presentation.kTilde

name: PaperC.InfiniteRademacher.infiniteRandomValue_mul

theorem infiniteRandomValue_mul (ω : InfiniteSample) {a b : ℕ}

name: PaperC.InfiniteRademacher.infiniteRandomValue_sq

name: PaperC.InfiniteRademacher.infiniteValueBit_mul

name: PaperC.InfiniteRademacher.infiniteValueBit_sq

name: PaperC.InfiniteRademacher.measure_zeroTail
statement:

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.abs_scaledInversePowerTail_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_scaledInversePowerTail_sub_le
    {p q : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp : HasSum p 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ q j) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (m s : ℕ) :
    |(∑' i : ℕ,
        scaledInversePowerTerm p m s (i + (m + 1))) -
      (∑' i : ℕ,
        scaledInversePowerTerm q m s (i + (m + 1)))| ≤
      tailRatio m ^ s

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.inversePowerWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem inversePowerWeight_le_one (j s : ℕ) :
    ((j : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ s ≤ 1

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.inversePowerWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem inversePowerWeight_nonneg (j s : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ((j : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ s

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.scaledInversePowerTail_le
statement:
theorem scaledInversePowerTail_le
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)
    (hp : HasSum p 1) (m s : ℕ) :
    ∑' i : ℕ,
        scaledInversePowerTerm p m s (i + (m + 1)) ≤
      tailRatio m ^ s

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.scaledInversePowerTail_nonneg
statement:
theorem scaledInversePowerTail_nonneg
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)
    (m s : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∑' i : ℕ,
      scaledInversePowerTerm p m s (i + (m + 1))

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.scaledInversePowerTerm_self
statement:
theorem scaledInversePowerTerm_self
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} {m s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    scaledInversePowerTerm p m s m = p m

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.scaledInversePowerTransform_eq
statement:
theorem scaledInversePowerTransform_eq
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)
    (hp : Summable p) (m s : ℕ) :
    (m : ℝ) ^ s * inversePowerTransform p s =
      ∑' j : ℕ, scaledInversePowerTerm p m s j

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.scaledInversePowerTransform_sub_lower_sub_eq_tail
statement:
theorem scaledInversePowerTransform_sub_lower_sub_eq_tail
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)
    (hp : Summable p) {m s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (m : ℝ) ^ s * inversePowerTransform p s -
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, scaledInversePowerTerm p m s j -
        p m =
      ∑' i : ℕ, scaledInversePowerTerm p m s (i + (m + 1))

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.shifted_mass_tsum_le_one
statement:
theorem shifted_mass_tsum_le_one
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.summable_inversePowerTransform

theorem summable_inversePowerTransform
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.summable_scaledInversePowerTerm

theorem summable_scaledInversePowerTerm
    {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j)

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.tailRatio_lt_one
statement:
theorem tailRatio_lt_one (m : ℕ) :
    tailRatio m < 1

name: PaperC.DirichletAtomConvergence.tailRatio_nonneg
statement:

name: PaperC.SectionThirteenFiniteBound.finite_corollary_thirteen_nine
statement:
theorem finite_corollary_thirteen_nine
    {fullLaw goodLaw targetPoisson goodPoisson : ℕ → ℝ}
    {badMass bOne averageBTwo parameterShift : ℝ}
    (hfull : Summable fullLaw)
    (hgood : Summable goodLaw)
    (htarget : Summable targetPoisson)
    (hgoodPoisson : Summable goodPoisson)
    (hfull0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ fullLaw k)
    (hgood0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ goodLaw k)
    (htarget0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ targetPoisson k)
    (hgoodPoisson0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ goodPoisson k)
    (hbad :
      natTotalVariation fullLaw goodLaw ≤ badMass)
    (hagg :
      natTotalVariation goodLaw goodPoisson ≤
        2 * (bOne + averageBTwo))
    (hparameter :
      natTotalVariation goodPoisson targetPoisson ≤
        parameterShift) :
    natTotalVariation fullLaw targetPoisson ≤
      badMass + 2 * (bOne + averageBTwo) + parameterShift

name: PaperC.SectionThirteenFiniteBound.finite_corollary_thirteen_nine_of_component_bounds
statement:
theorem finite_corollary_thirteen_nine_of_component_bounds
    {fullLaw goodLaw targetPoisson goodPoisson : ℕ → ℝ}
    {badMass bOne averageBTwo parameterShift : ℝ}
    {weightedBad badCount dyadicSize edgeCount
      localPairs pairDefect : ℝ}
    {twoPowL twoPowTwoL : ℝ}
    (hfull : Summable fullLaw)
    (hgood : Summable goodLaw)
    (htarget : Summable targetPoisson)
    (hgoodPoisson : Summable goodPoisson)
    (hfull0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ fullLaw k)
    (hgood0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ goodLaw k)
    (htarget0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ targetPoisson k)
    (hgoodPoisson0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ goodPoisson k)
    (hbadCoupling :
      natTotalVariation fullLaw goodLaw ≤ badMass)
    (hagg :
      natTotalVariation goodLaw goodPoisson ≤
        2 * (bOne + averageBTwo))
    (hparameterCoupling :
      natTotalVariation goodPoisson targetPoisson ≤
        parameterShift)
    (hbad :
      badMass ≤ (2 * weightedBad + badCount) / twoPowL)
    (hbOne :
      bOne ≤ (dyadicSize + edgeCount) / twoPowTwoL)
    (hbTwo :
      averageBTwo ≤
        (localPairs + edgeCount + pairDefect) / twoPowTwoL)
    (hparameter :
      parameterShift ≤ badCount / twoPowL) :
    natTotalVariation fullLaw targetPoisson ≤
      (2 * weightedBad + 2 * badCount) / twoPowL +
        2 * (dyadicSize + localPairs +
          2 * edgeCount + pairDefect) / twoPowTwoL

statement:
theorem sectionFourteenFour_laplaceFunctional
    {N L : ℕ → ℕ} {rate : ℝ} {E : ℕ}
    {g : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {laplace error : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hN : Tendsto N atTop atTop)
    (hscale : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ criticalSpatialScale (N n) (L n))
      atTop (𝓝 rate))
    (hg : ∀ e ≤ E,
      ContinuousOn (fun t ↦ g t e) (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2))
    (_hg0 : ∀ t e, 0 ≤ g t e)
    (herror : Tendsto error atTop (𝓝 0))
    (happrox :
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        |laplace n -
          Real.exp
            (-markedThinnedParameter (N n) (L n) E g)| ≤
          error n) :
    Tendsto laplace atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.exp
        (-(rate * ∫ t in Set.Ico (1 : ℝ) 2,
          ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (E + 1),
            (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) *
              (1 - Real.exp (-g t e))))))

      atTop (𝓝 rate))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2))
    (_hg0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t)
    (herror : Tendsto error atTop (𝓝 0))
    (happrox :
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        |laplace n -
          Real.exp
            (-spatialThinnedParameter (N n) (L n) g)| ≤
          error n) :
    Tendsto laplace atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.exp
        (-(rate * ∫ t in Set.Ico (1 : ℝ) 2,
          (1 - Real.exp (-g t))))))

theorem tendsto_laplace_of_parameter_and_error
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}

    (hparameter : Tendsto parameter l (𝓝 a))
    (herror : Tendsto error l (𝓝 0))

name: PaperC.LaplaceVoidClosure.indicatorSum_thinnedIndicator_eq_thinnedCount

theorem indicatorSum_thinnedIndicator_eq_thinnedCount

    (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (z : Ω × (ι → Bool)) :
    indicatorSum (thinnedIndicator X) z =

name: PaperC.LaplaceVoidClosure.indicatorSum_thinnedIndicator_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem indicatorSum_thinnedIndicator_eq_zero_iff

    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (z : Ω × (ι → Bool)) :
    indicatorSum (thinnedIndicator X) z = 0 ↔
      NoRetainedActive (fun i ↦ X i z.1) z.2

name: PaperC.LaplaceVoidClosure.poissonParameter_thinnedIndicator
statement:
theorem poissonParameter_thinnedIndicator
    {Ω : Type u} {ι : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (q : ι → ℝ)
    (hq0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1) :
    poissonParameter
        (productPMF μ (bernoulliProductPMF q hq0 hq1))
        (thinnedIndicator X) =
      ∑ i, marginal μ X i * q i

name: PaperC.startProbability_eq_ite

theorem startProbability_eq_ite
    (N L x : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    startProbability N L x =
      if Compatible (startSystem (dyadicCutoff N L) x L) (startRhs L) then
        (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂
            (LinearMap.ker (startSystem (dyadicCutoff N L) x L)) : ℚ) /
          (2 ^ Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (DyadicSample N L) : ℚ)
      else
        0

name: PaperC.V282.SteinFiniteExpectation.expectation_finset_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_finset_sum (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :

name: PaperC.V282.SteinFiniteExpectation.expectation_indicator_countOn
statement:
theorem expectation_indicator_countOn (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (i : ι) (s : Finset ι) :
    finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω =>
      (if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (countOn X s ω : ℝ)) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, jointMarginal μ X i j

name: PaperC.V282.SteinFiniteExpectation.expectation_indicator_eq_marginal

theorem expectation_indicator_eq_marginal (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (i : ι) :

name: PaperC.V282.SteinFiniteExpectation.expectation_indicator_mul
statement:
theorem expectation_indicator_mul (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (i j : ι) :
    finitePMFExpectation μ
      (fun ω => (if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (if X j ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = jointMarginal μ X i j

name: PaperC.V282.SteinFiniteExpectation.expectation_indicator_outside
statement:
theorem expectation_indicator_outside (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (i : ι) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω =>
      (if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        f (countOn X (Finset.univ \ closedNeighborhood G i) ω + 1)) =
      marginal μ X i * finitePMFExpectation μ
        (fun ω => f (countOn X (Finset.univ \ closedNeighborhood G i) ω + 1))

name: PaperC.Prel8.FiniteConditioning.expectation_conditional

    (hA : 0 < eventProbability μ A) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation (conditional μ A hA) f =

name: PaperC.Prel8.FiniteConditioning.probability_conditional

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.constrained_maximum
statement:
theorem constrained_maximum {H I floor w : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIV : I ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H)
    (hf : floor ∈ Icc (saddleCutoff 1 H) (saddleCutoff 2 H))
    (hw : w ∈ Icc (saddleCutoff 1 H) (saddleCutoff 2 H)) (hfw : floor ≤ w) :
    budget (fun v => saddleCost (H/v)) I w ≤
      budget (fun v => saddleCost (H/v)) I (max floor (informationCutoff H I))

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.cutoff_full_information
statement:
theorem cutoff_full_information {H : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H) :
    informationCutoff H (saddleCutoff 1 H)=saddleCutoff 1 H

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.cutoff_pos
statement:
theorem cutoff_pos {H I : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIV : I ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) : 0 < informationCutoff H I

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.cutoff_spec
statement:
theorem cutoff_spec {H I : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIV : I ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    informationCutoff H I ∈ Icc (saddleCutoff 1 H) (saddleCutoff 2 H) ∧
      2*saddleCost (H/informationCutoff H I)=informationCutoff H I+I

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.cutoff_strict_antitone
statement:
theorem cutoff_strict_antitone {H I J : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIJ : I < J) (hJV : J ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    informationCutoff H J < informationCutoff H I

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleBudget.cutoff_zero
statement:
theorem cutoff_zero {H : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H) :
    informationCutoff H 0=saddleCutoff 2 H

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.exponentialIntegralRemainder_bound
statement:
theorem exponentialIntegralRemainder_bound {u : ℝ} (hu : 6 ≤ u) :
    |exponentialIntegralRemainder u| ≤
      |exponentialIntegralRemainder 6| + 4 * (Real.exp u / u ^ 3)

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.exponentialIntegralRemainder_bound_eventually
statement:
theorem exponentialIntegralRemainder_bound_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atTop,
      |exponentialIntegralRemainder u| ≤ 5 * (Real.exp u / u ^ 3)

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.exponentialIntegral_two_term_expansion
statement:
theorem exponentialIntegral_two_term_expansion :
    (fun u => exponentialIntegral u - Real.exp u / u - Real.exp u / u ^ 2)
      =O[atTop] (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp u / u ^ 3)

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.hasDerivAt_exp_div_cube
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exp_div_cube {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp t / t ^ 3)
      (Real.exp u * (u - 3) / u ^ 4) u

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.hasDerivAt_exp_div_sq
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exp_div_sq {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp t / t ^ 2)
      (Real.exp u * (u - 2) / u ^ 3) u

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.hasDerivAt_exponentialIntegralRemainder
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exponentialIntegralRemainder {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    HasDerivAt exponentialIntegralRemainder (2 * Real.exp u / u ^ 3) u

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.hasDerivAt_exponentialIntegralUpperControl
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exponentialIntegralUpperControl {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    HasDerivAt exponentialIntegralUpperControl
      (2 * Real.exp u * (u - 6) / u ^ 4) u

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.strictMonoOn_exponentialIntegralRemainder
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_exponentialIntegralRemainder :
    StrictMonoOn exponentialIntegralRemainder (Ici 6)

name: PaperC.V282.ExponentialIntegralAsymptotics.strictMonoOn_exponentialIntegralUpperControl
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_exponentialIntegralUpperControl :
    StrictMonoOn exponentialIntegralUpperControl (Ici 6)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.log_saddleHeight
statement:
theorem log_saddleHeight {a u : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hu : saddleParameterBase ≤ u) :
    Real.log (saddleHeight a u) =
      2 * u - Real.log u + Real.log a + Real.log (saddleCostFactor u)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.log_saddleParameter_identity
statement:
theorem log_saddleParameter_identity {a H : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hH : saddleThreshold a ≤ H) :
    Real.log H = 2 * saddleParameter a H - Real.log (saddleParameter a H) +
      Real.log a + Real.log (saddleCostFactor (saddleParameter a H))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.normalizedExponentialIntegral_error_eventually
statement:
theorem normalizedExponentialIntegral_error_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atTop,
      |normalizedExponentialIntegral u - 1 - 1 / u| ≤ 5 / u ^ 2

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.saddleCostFactor_identity
statement:
theorem saddleCostFactor_identity {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    saddleCostFactor u = 1 - normalizedExponentialIntegral u / u

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.saddleCostFactor_pos
statement:
theorem saddleCostFactor_pos {u : ℝ} (hu : saddleParameterBase ≤ u) :
    0 < saddleCostFactor u

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.saddleCostParam_eq_exp_mul_factor
statement:
theorem saddleCostParam_eq_exp_mul_factor (u : ℝ) :
    saddleCostParam u = Real.exp u * saddleCostFactor u

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.tendsto_log_saddleCostFactor
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_saddleCostFactor :
    Tendsto (fun u => Real.log (saddleCostFactor u)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.tendsto_normalizedExponentialIntegral
statement:
theorem tendsto_normalizedExponentialIntegral :
    Tendsto normalizedExponentialIntegral atTop (𝓝 1)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.tendsto_saddleCostFactor
statement: theorem tendsto_saddleCostFactor : Tendsto saddleCostFactor atTop (𝓝 1)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleAsymptotics.tendsto_saddleParameter_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleParameter_atTop {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (saddleParameter a) atTop atTop

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.hard_saddle_second_order
statement:
theorem hard_saddle_second_order :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff 1 H ^ 2 / H - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (Real.log H + Real.log (Real.log H) - Real.log 2 - 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.saddleCutoff_square_div_identity
statement:
theorem saddleCutoff_square_div_identity {a H : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hH : saddleThreshold a ≤ H) :
    saddleCutoff a H ^ 2 / H =
      a * (saddleParameter a H - normalizedExponentialIntegral (saddleParameter a H))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.saddleParameter_refined_identity
statement:
theorem saddleParameter_refined_identity {a H : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hH : saddleThreshold a ≤ H) (hHone : 1 < H) :
    saddleParameter a H - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (Real.log H + Real.log (Real.log H) - Real.log (2 * a)) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (saddleParameter a H / Real.log H) + Real.log 2 -
        Real.log (saddleCostFactor (saddleParameter a H)))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.saddle_cutoff_second_order
statement:
theorem saddle_cutoff_second_order {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff a H ^ 2 / H - (a / 2) *
      (Real.log H + Real.log (Real.log H) - Real.log (2 * a) - 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.soft_saddle_second_order
statement:
theorem soft_saddle_second_order :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff 2 H ^ 2 / H -
      (Real.log H + Real.log (Real.log H) - Real.log 4 - 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.tendsto_log_div_saddleParameter
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_div_saddleParameter {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => Real.log H / saddleParameter a H) atTop (𝓝 2)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.tendsto_saddleParameter_div_log
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleParameter_div_log {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleParameter a H / Real.log H) atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleExpansion.tendsto_saddleParameter_second_order
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleParameter_second_order {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleParameter a H - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (Real.log H + Real.log (Real.log H) - Real.log (2 * a))) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.hard_saddle_second_order_log_scale
statement:
theorem hard_saddle_second_order_log_scale :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℝ => saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log N) ^ 2 / Real.log N - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (Real.log (Real.log N) + Real.log (Real.log (Real.log N)) - Real.log 2 - 2))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.log_log_small_against_hard_nu
statement:
theorem log_log_small_against_hard_nu :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℝ => Real.log (Real.log N) / saddleNu 1 (Real.log N))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.soft_saddle_second_order_log_scale
statement:
theorem soft_saddle_second_order_log_scale :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℝ => saddleCutoff 2 (Real.log N) ^ 2 / Real.log N -
      (Real.log (Real.log N) + Real.log (Real.log (Real.log N)) - Real.log 4 - 2))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_log_div_saddleNu
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_div_saddleNu {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => Real.log H / saddleNu a H) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_saddleCutoff_normalized
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleCutoff_normalized {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff a H / Real.sqrt (H * Real.log H))
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt (a / 2)))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_saddleCutoff_square_normalized
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleCutoff_square_normalized {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff a H ^ 2 / (H * Real.log H)) atTop (𝓝 (a / 2))

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_saddleNu_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleNu_atTop {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (saddleNu a) atTop atTop

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_saddleParameter_div_nu
statement:
theorem tendsto_saddleParameter_div_nu {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleParameter a H / saddleNu a H) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleScales.tendsto_soft_div_hard_saddle
statement:
theorem tendsto_soft_div_hard_saddle :
    Tendsto (fun H => saddleCutoff 2 H / saddleCutoff 1 H)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt 2))

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleScales.parameter_bounds
statement:
theorem parameter_bounds {H I : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIV : I ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    saddleParameter 2 H ≤ informationParameter H I ∧ informationParameter H I ≤ saddleParameter 1 H

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleScales.parameter_div_log_tendsto
statement:
theorem parameter_div_log_tendsto (I : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hI : ∀ᶠ H in atTop, 0 ≤ I H ∧ I H ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    Tendsto (fun H => informationParameter H (I H)/Real.log H) atTop (𝓝 (1/2))

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleScales.parameter_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem parameter_tendsto_atTop (I : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hI : ∀ᶠ H in atTop, 0 ≤ I H ∧ I H ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    Tendsto (fun H => informationParameter H (I H)) atTop atTop

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleScales.quadratic_identity
statement:
theorem quadratic_identity {H I : ℝ} (hH : max (saddleThreshold 1) (saddleThreshold 2) ≤ H)
    (hI : 0 ≤ I) (hIV : I ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    (informationCutoff H I)^2+I*informationCutoff H I =
      2*H*(informationParameter H I-normalizedExponentialIntegral (informationParameter H I))

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleScales.quadratic_normalized_tendsto
statement:
theorem quadratic_normalized_tendsto (I : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hI : ∀ᶠ H in atTop, 0 ≤ I H ∧ I H ≤ saddleCutoff 1 H) :
    Tendsto (fun H => ((informationCutoff H (I H))^2+I H*informationCutoff H (I H))/(H*Real.log H))
      atTop (𝓝 1)

name: PaperC.Prel8.InformationSaddleLimit.budget_quadratic_formula
statement:
theorem budget_quadratic_formula {x j : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hj : 0 ≤ j) :
    (x-j)/2=(Real.sqrt (j^2+4*(x^2+j*x))-3*j)/4

name: PaperC.V282.SteinTestTotalVariation.finiteNatLaw_totalVariation_le_of_test_sets
PaperC.V282.SteinTestTotalVariation.natTotalVariation_eq_positive_set
statement:
theorem natTotalVariation_eq_positive_set {p q : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hq0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q k) :
    natTotalVariation p q =
      (∑' k, if q k ≤ p k then p k else 0) -
        ∑' k, if q k ≤ p k then q k else 0

name: PaperC.V282.SteinTestTotalVariation.natTotalVariation_le_of_test_sets
PaperC.V282.SteinTestTotalVariation.restricted_finiteNatLaw_eq_eventProbability
statement:
theorem restricted_finiteNatLaw_eq_eventProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (W : Ω → ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) :
    (∑' k, if k ∈ A then finiteNatLaw μ W k else 0) =
      eventProbability μ (fun ω => W ω ∈ A)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinTestTotalVariation.summable_restricted_mass
statement:
theorem summable_restricted_mass {p : ℕ → ℝ} (hp : Summable p)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (A : Set ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k => if k ∈ A then p k else 0)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.firstSteinFactor_le_one
statement: theorem firstSteinFactor_le_one (rate : ℝ≥0) : firstSteinFactor rate ≤ 1

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.firstSteinFactor_nonneg
statement: theorem firstSteinFactor_nonneg (rate : ℝ≥0) : 0 ≤ firstSteinFactor rate

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.hasSum_poissonMass
statement: theorem hasSum_poissonMass (rate : ℝ≥0) : HasSum (poissonMass rate) 1

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.poissonMass_formula
statement:
theorem poissonMass_formula (rate : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    poissonMass rate k = Real.exp (-(rate : ℝ)) * (rate : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.poissonMass_nonneg
statement: theorem poissonMass_nonneg (rate : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ poissonMass rate k

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.poissonMass_zero
statement: theorem poissonMass_zero (k : ℕ) : poissonMass 0 k = if k = 0 then 1 else 0

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.poissonSetMass_zero
statement: theorem poissonSetMass_zero (A : Set ℕ) : poissonSetMass 0 A = if 0 ∈ A then 1 else 0

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.steinSolutionBounds_all
statement:
theorem steinSolutionBounds_all (hStein : ScalarSteinFactorsStatement) (rate : ℝ≥0) :
    SteinSolutionBounds rate (zeroSteinFactor rate) (firstSteinFactor rate)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.steinSolutionBounds_zero
statement: theorem steinSolutionBounds_zero : SteinSolutionBounds 0 1 1

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.zeroSteinFactor_le_one
statement: theorem zeroSteinFactor_le_one (rate : ℝ≥0) : zeroSteinFactor rate ≤ 1

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarSteinInput.zeroSteinFactor_nonneg
statement: theorem zeroSteinFactor_nonneg (rate : ℝ≥0) : 0 ≤ zeroSteinFactor rate

name: PaperC.Prel8.PoissonCloudTail.doubled_rate_tendsto
PaperC.Prel8.PoissonCloudTail.tail_summable
statement:
theorem tail_summable (rate : ℝ≥0) (K : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ if K<k then poissonMass rate k else 0)

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.affine_word_forced
statement:
theorem affine_word_forced {ι : Type*} (offset : R → ι → F₂) (word : ι → F₂)
    (r : R) : (word-offset r)+offset r=word

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.exact_conditional_expectation
statement:
theorem exact_conditional_expectation (μ : FinitePMF R) (target : R → Ξ)
    (f : R × Ξ → ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation (productPMF μ (FinitePMF.uniform Ξ)) (fun z => f (force target z)) =
      finitePMFExpectation (productPMF μ (FinitePMF.uniform Ξ))
        (fun z => if z.2=target z.1 then f z else 0) / (Fintype.card Ξ : ℝ)⁻¹

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.force_fixes_satisfied
statement:
theorem force_fixes_satisfied (target : R → Ξ) (z : R × Ξ) (h : z.2=target z.1) :
    force target z=z

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.force_hits
statement:
theorem force_hits (target : R → Ξ) (z : R × Ξ) :
    (force target z).2=target (force target z).1

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.force_idempotent
statement:
theorem force_idempotent (target : R → Ξ) (z : R × Ξ) :
    force target (force target z)=force target z

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.force_preserves_nonpivots
statement:
theorem force_preserves_nonpivots (target : R → Ξ) (z : R × Ξ) :
    (force target z).1=z.1

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.forced_expectation
statement:
theorem forced_expectation (μ : FinitePMF R) (target : R → Ξ) (f : R × Ξ → ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation (productPMF μ (FinitePMF.uniform Ξ)) (fun z => f (force target z)) =
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun r => f (r,target r))

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.forcing_event_probability
statement:
theorem forcing_event_probability (μ : FinitePMF R) (target : R → Ξ) :
    eventProbability (productPMF μ (FinitePMF.uniform Ξ)) (fun z => z.2=target z.1) =
      (Fintype.card Ξ : ℝ)⁻¹

name: PaperC.Prel8.PrivateForcing.restricted_expectation
statement:
theorem restricted_expectation (μ : FinitePMF R) (target : R → Ξ) (f : R × Ξ → ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation (productPMF μ (FinitePMF.uniform Ξ))
      (fun z => if z.2=target z.1 then f z else 0) =
      (Fintype.card Ξ : ℝ)⁻¹ * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun r => f (r,target r))

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelCRT.hosted_subset
statement:
theorem hosted_subset (n h Q : ℕ) (modulus : ι → ℕ) :
    hostedGrid n h Q modulus ⊆ (univ : Finset (ι → Fin h × Fin (Q+1))).biUnion
      (assignedGrid n h Q modulus)

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelCRT.mem_solutions
statement:
theorem mem_solutions (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (modulus offset : ι → ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
    x ∈ solutions n S modulus offset ↔ x ∈ Icc 1 n ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, modulus i ∣ x + offset i

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelCRT.solutions_count
statement:
theorem solutions_count (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (modulus offset : ι → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (hinj : Function.Injective modulus) :
    ((solutions n S modulus offset).card : ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)/(∏ i ∈ S, (modulus i:ℝ))+1

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelCRT.solutions_count_le
statement:
theorem solutions_count_le (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (modulus offset : ι → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (hinj : Function.Injective modulus)
    (hr : (∏ i ∈ S, modulus i) ≤ 2*n) :
    ((solutions n S modulus offset).card : ℝ) ≤
      (n:ℝ) * (3:ℝ)^S.card / (∏ i ∈ S, (modulus i:ℝ))

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelAllocation.grid_card
statement: theorem grid_card (n h : ℕ) : (grid n h).card = n^h

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelAllocation.uniform_finset_probability
statement:
theorem uniform_finset_probability {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) [Nonempty S] (P : α → Prop) :
    eventProbability (FinitePMF.uniform S) (fun x ↦ P x.val) =
      ((S.filter P).card : ℝ) / S.card

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelExponent.card_log_le
statement:
theorem card_log_le (Y m : ℕ) (hY : 1 < Y) :
    ((largeOddPrimeSupport Y m).card : ℝ)*Real.log Y ≤ Real.log (largeOddKernel Y m)

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelPowerSums.sum_Icc_rankin_le
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_rankin_le (T : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (r : ℝ) ^ (-1 + σ)) ≤
      1 + (T : ℝ) ^ σ / σ

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelPowerSums.sum_Ioc_le_integral
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_le_integral (B X : ℕ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hBX : B ≤ X)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 0) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc B X, (n : ℝ) ^ a) ≤ ∫ x in (B : ℝ)..X, x ^ a

name: PaperC.Prel8.RoughKernelPowerSums.sum_Ioc_tail_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_tail_le (Y X : ℕ) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ioc Y X, (r : ℝ) ^ (-1 - s)) ≤ (Y : ℝ) ^ (-s) / s

name: PaperC.Prel8.UniformGridFibres.coordinate_deleted_le
statement:
theorem coordinate_deleted_le (n h : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (i : Fin (h+1)) (G : Finset ℕ) :
    eventProbability (gridLaw n (h+1) hn) (fun J ↦ J.val i ∉ G) ≤
      (((Icc 1 n) \ G).card:ℝ)/n

name: PaperC.Prel8.UniformGridFibres.fibre_card_le
statement:
theorem fibre_card_le (n h j : ℕ) (i : Fin (h+1))
    (P : (Fin (h+1) → ℕ) → Prop) (R : (Fin h → ℕ) → Prop)
    (hmap : ∀ J ∈ grid n (h+1), P J → J i=j → R (fun b ↦ J (i.succAbove b))) :
    (((grid n (h+1)).filter P).filter (fun J ↦ J i=j)).card ≤ ((grid n h).filter R).card

name: PaperC.Prel8.UniformGridFibres.probability_eq
statement:
theorem probability_eq (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (P : (Fin k → ℕ) → Prop) :
    eventProbability (gridLaw n k hn) (fun J ↦ P J.val) =
      (((grid n k).filter P).card:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^k

name: PaperC.Prel8.UniformGridFibres.probability_le_of_fibres
statement:
theorem probability_le_of_fibres (n h : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (i : Fin (h+1))
    (P : (Fin (h+1) → ℕ) → Prop) (R : ℕ → (Fin h → ℕ) → Prop) (B : ℝ)
    (hmap : ∀ j ∈ Icc 1 n, ∀ J ∈ grid n (h+1), P J → J i=j → R j (fun b ↦ J (i.succAbove b)))
    (hbound : ∀ j ∈ Icc 1 n, (((grid n h).filter (R j)).card:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^h*B) :
    eventProbability (gridLaw n (h+1) hn) (fun J ↦ P J.val) ≤ B

name: PaperC.Prel8.UniformGridFibres.probability_le_of_fibres_average
statement:
theorem probability_le_of_fibres_average (n h : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (i : Fin (h+1))
    (P : (Fin (h+1) → ℕ) → Prop) (R : ℕ → (Fin h → ℕ) → Prop) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmap : ∀ j ∈ Icc 1 n, ∀ J ∈ grid n (h+1), P J → J i=j → R j (fun b ↦ J (i.succAbove b)))
    (hbound : ∀ j ∈ Icc 1 n, (((grid n h).filter (R j)).card:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^h*B j) :
    eventProbability (gridLaw n (h+1) hn) (fun J ↦ P J.val) ≤ (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 n, B j)/n

name: PaperC.V11.HardConditioningSaddle.min_div_self_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem min_div_self_le_sqrt
    {B u : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hu : 0 < u) :
    min (B / u) u ≤ Real.sqrt B

name: PaperC.V11.PrimeHarmonic.sum_inv_smallPrimesUpTo_real_le_harmonic_log
statement:
theorem sum_inv_smallPrimesUpTo_real_le_harmonic_log (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo T, (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      4 + 14 * (harmonic (Nat.log 2 T + 1) : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V11.PrimeHarmonic.sum_inv_smallPrimesUpTo_real_le_log_logTwo
statement:
theorem sum_inv_smallPrimesUpTo_real_le_log_logTwo (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo T, (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      18 + 14 * Real.log (Nat.log 2 T + 1)

name: PaperC.V11.TruncatedDefectCount.card_kernel_one_le_unfiltered_sqrt_sum
statement:
theorem card_kernel_one_le_unfiltered_sqrt_sum
    (B X : ℕ) :
    (boundedLargeKernelValues B 1 X).card ≤
      ∑ small ∈ (smallPrimesUpTo B).powerset,
        Nat.sqrt (X / small.prod id)

name: PaperC.V11.TruncatedDefectCount.mem_admissibleSmallSupports
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_admissibleSmallSupports
    {B X : ℕ} {small : Finset ℕ} :
    small ∈ admissibleSmallSupports B X ↔
      small ⊆ smallPrimesUpTo B ∧ small.prod id ≤ X

name: PaperC.V11.SharpKernelDefect.finite_equation_three_four
statement:
theorem finite_equation_three_four
    (X T : ℕ) {σ : ℝ}
    (hT : 3 ≤ T) (hTX : T ≤ X)
    (hσpos : 0 < σ) (hσ : σ < 1 / 2) :
    (rankinDefectCount X T : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-σ * Real.log (X : ℝ) +
          equationThreeFourEnvelope T σ 120)

name: PaperC.V11.SharpKernelDefect.finite_equation_three_four_of_reciprocal_bound
statement:
theorem finite_equation_three_four_of_reciprocal_bound
    (X T : ℕ) {σ C : ℝ}
    (hT : 3 ≤ T) (hTX : T ≤ X)
    (hσpos : 0 < σ) (hσ : σ < 1 / 2)
    (hrecip :
      (∑ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo T, ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤
        C * Real.log (Real.log (3 * (T : ℝ)))) :
    (rankinDefectCount X T : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-σ * Real.log (X : ℝ) +
          equationThreeFourEnvelope T σ C)

name: PaperC.V11.SyndromeCollision.exists_short_kernel_word_of_two_pow_lt_volume
statement:
theorem exists_short_kernel_word_of_two_pow_lt_volume
    {m r t : ℕ}
    (φ : BinaryWord m →ₗ[F₂] BinaryWord r)
    (hlarge : 2 ^ r < volume m t) :
    ∃ z : BinaryWord m, z ≠ 0 ∧ hammingNorm z ≤ 2 * t ∧ φ z = 0

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.compatible_probability_inverse_rank
statement:
theorem compatible_probability_inverse_rank (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (b : W)
    (h : Compatible A b) :
    uniformSolutionProbability A b = 1/(2 : ℚ)^Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range A)

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.compatible_prod_of_rowOverlap_zero
statement:
theorem compatible_prod_of_rowOverlap_zero (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (B : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] Z)
    (b : W) (c : Z) (hA : Compatible A b) (hB : Compatible B c)
    (hover : rowOverlap A B=0) : Compatible (A.prod B) (b,c)

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.conditional_affine_probability
statement:
theorem conditional_affine_probability (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (B : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] Z)
    (b : W) (c : Z) (h : Compatible (A.prod B) (b,c)) :
    uniformSolutionProbability (A.prod B) (b,c)/uniformSolutionProbability A b =
      1/(2 : ℚ)^(Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range B)-rowOverlap A B)

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.rowOverlap_le_right_rank
statement:
theorem rowOverlap_le_right_rank (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (B : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] Z) :
    rowOverlap A B≤Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range B)

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.rowSpace_finrank
statement:
theorem rowSpace_finrank (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) :
    Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (rowSpace A)=Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range A)

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.rowSpace_prod
statement:
theorem rowSpace_prod (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (B : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] Z) :
    rowSpace (A.prod B)=rowSpace A ⊔ rowSpace B

name: PaperC.V282.AffineBorderLinear.stacked_rank_add_overlap
statement:
theorem stacked_rank_add_overlap (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] W) (B : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] Z) :
    Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range (A.prod B))+rowOverlap A B =
      Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range A)+Module.finrank 𝔽₂ (LinearMap.range B)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.componentFunctions_injective
statement:
theorem componentFunctions_injective (left right : E → V) :

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.component_edge
statement:
theorem component_edge (left right : E → V) (e : E) :
