name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.component_surjective
statement: theorem component_surjective (left right : E → V) : Function.Surjective (component left right)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.constant_on_component
PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.finrank_cycleSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_cycleSpace (left right : E → V) :
    finrank F₂ (cycleSpace left right) =
      Fintype.card E + Fintype.card (Component left right) - Fintype.card V

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.finrank_gradient_kernel
statement:
theorem finrank_gradient_kernel (left right : E → V) :
    finrank F₂ (LinearMap.ker (gradientMatrix left right).mulVecLin) =
      Fintype.card (Component left right)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.gradientMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem gradientMatrix_apply (left right : E → V) (z : V → F₂) (e : E) :
    (gradientMatrix left right).mulVecLin z e = z (left e) + z (right e)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.incidence_rank_add_components
statement:
theorem incidence_rank_add_components (left right : E → V) :
    finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (incidenceMap left right)) +
      Fintype.card (Component left right) = Fintype.card V

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.mem_gradient_kernel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradient_kernel_iff (left right : E → V) (z : V → F₂) :
    z ∈ LinearMap.ker (gradientMatrix left right).mulVecLin ↔
      ∀ e, z (left e) = z (right e)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.range_componentFunctions
statement:
theorem range_componentFunctions (left right : E → V) :
    LinearMap.range (componentFunctions left right) =
      LinearMap.ker (gradientMatrix left right).mulVecLin

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraIncidence.transpose_gradient_eq_incidence
statement:
theorem transpose_gradient_eq_incidence (left right : E → V) :
    (gradientMatrix left right).transpose.mulVecLin = incidenceMap left right

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraPrivateGraph.lemma_two_seven
statement:
theorem lemma_two_seven (left right : E → V) (vertexVector : V → P → F₂)
    (root : Component left right → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c, component left right (root c) = c)
    (hprivate : HasPrivatePivots vertexVector (component left right) root) :
    LinearMap.ker (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right) ≤ cycleSpace left right ∧
    finrank F₂ (cycleSpace left right) = cyclomaticNumber left right ∧
    Fintype.card E - cyclomaticNumber left right ≤
      finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right))

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraPrivateGraph.lemma_two_seven_tree
statement:
theorem lemma_two_seven_tree (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : G.IsTree) (r : V) (v : V → P →₀ F₂)
    (pivot : {w : V // w ≠ r} → P)
    (hdiag : ∀ w, v w.val (pivot w) = 1)
    (hoff : ∀ w z, z ≠ w.val → v z (pivot w) = 0) :
    finrank F₂ (Submodule.span F₂ (Set.range
      (fun e : G.edgeSet => PrivatePivots.edgeSum v e.val))) = Fintype.card G.edgeSet

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureAlgebraPrivateGraph.rank_add_components_le
statement:
theorem rank_add_components_le (left right : E → V) (vertexVector : V → P → F₂)
    (root : Component left right → V)
    (hroot : ∀ c, component left right (root c) = c)
    (hprivate : HasPrivatePivots vertexVector (component left right) root) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ finrank F₂ (LinearMap.range (representedEdgeMap vertexVector left right)) +
      Fintype.card (Component left right)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTIntervals.integer_solutions_modEq
statement:
theorem integer_solutions_modEq
    (residue : ι → ℤ) (modulus : ι → ℕ) (indices : List ι)
    (hcoprime : indices.Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on modulus)) {x y : ℤ}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ indices, x ≡ residue i [ZMOD (modulus i : ℤ)])
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ indices, y ≡ residue i [ZMOD (modulus i : ℤ)]) :
    x ≡ y [ZMOD ((indices.map modulus).prod : ℤ)]

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTIntervals.modulus_le_of_admissible
statement:
theorem modulus_le_of_admissible {s : Finset ι} {r M : ℕ} (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (T : UnorderedCertificate s r)
    (hT : CertificateAdmissible modulus M T) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ T.1) :
    modulus i ≤ M

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSummation.certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum_div_factorial
statement:
theorem certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum_div_factorial
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    certificateWeightSum s r w ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSummation.factorial_mul_certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_certificateWeightSum_le_pow_sum
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (r.factorial : ℝ) * certificateWeightSum s r w ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ r

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSummation.orderedCertificate_sum_eq_factorial_mul
statement:
theorem orderedCertificate_sum_eq_factorial_mul
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : OrderedCertificate s r,
        ∏ j, w (orderedCertificateToFunction z j).1) =
      (r.factorial : ℝ) * certificateWeightSum s r w

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSummation.orderedCertificate_sum_le_all_functions
statement:
theorem orderedCertificate_sum_le_all_functions
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ z : OrderedCertificate s r,
        ∏ j, w (orderedCertificateToFunction z j).1) ≤
      ∑ f : Fin r → s, ∏ j, w (f j).1

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSummation.ordering_product_eq_certificate_product
statement:
theorem ordering_product_eq_certificate_product
    {s : Finset ι} {r : ℕ} (w : ι → ℝ)
    (T : UnorderedCertificate s r) (e : Fin r ↪ T.1) :
    (∏ j, w (e j).1) = ∏ i ∈ T.1, w i

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTMass.certificateMass_le_of_count
statement:
theorem certificateMass_le_of_count
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (count : UnorderedCertificate s r → ℕ) (M D : ℕ) (u V : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hcount : ∀ T, CertificateAdmissible modulus M T →
      (count T : ℝ) ≤ V / (certificateModulusProduct modulus T : ℝ) ^ D) :
    certificateMass s r modulus count M u ≤
      V * ((∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ) ^ D) ^ r / r.factorial)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTMass.intervalMass_le
statement:
theorem intervalMass_le (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (residue : ι → ℤ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (a b : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C₀) (hab : a ≤ b) (hlen : (b - a : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    intervalMass s r residue modulus a b M u ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) * ((∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ)) ^ r / r.factorial)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTMass.product_local_weight
statement:
theorem product_local_weight {s : Finset ι} {r : ℕ} (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (D : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (T : UnorderedCertificate s r) :
    (∏ i ∈ T.1, u / (modulus i : ℝ) ^ D) =
      u ^ r / (certificateModulusProduct modulus T : ℝ) ^ D

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTMass.rectangleMass_le
statement:
theorem rectangleMass_le (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (residue₁ residue₂ : ι → ℤ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C₀) (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlen₁ : (b₁ - a₁ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M) (hlen₂ : (b₂ - a₂ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    rectangleMass s r residue₁ residue₂ modulus a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ M u ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) ^ 2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ r / r.factorial)

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSeries.certificateMass_eq_zero_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem certificateMass_eq_zero_of_card_lt
    (s : Finset ι) (r : ℕ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (count : UnorderedCertificate s r → ℕ) (M : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hr : s.card < r) :
    certificateMass s r modulus count M u = 0

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSeries.certificateMass_tsum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem certificateMass_tsum_eq_sum
    (s : Finset ι) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (count : (r : ℕ) → UnorderedCertificate s r → ℕ) (M : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    (∑' r, certificateMass s r modulus (count r) M u) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (s.card + 1), certificateMass s r modulus (count r) M u

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSeries.certificateMass_tsum_le_of_count
statement:
theorem certificateMass_tsum_le_of_count
    (s : Finset ι) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (count : (r : ℕ) → UnorderedCertificate s r → ℕ) (M D : ℕ) (u V : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hcount : ∀ r T, CertificateAdmissible modulus M T →
      (count r T : ℝ) ≤ V / (certificateModulusProduct modulus T : ℝ) ^ D) :
    (∑' r, certificateMass s r modulus (count r) M u) ≤
      V * ∑' r : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ) ^ D) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSeries.intervalMass_tsum_le
statement:
theorem intervalMass_tsum_le (s : Finset ι) (residue : ι → ℤ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (a b : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C₀) (hab : a ≤ b) (hlen : (b - a : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (∑' r, intervalMass s r residue modulus a b M u) ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) * ∑' r : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ)) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTSeries.rectangleMass_tsum_le
statement:
theorem rectangleMass_tsum_le (s : Finset ι) (residue₁ residue₂ : ι → ℤ) (modulus : ι → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ i, (modulus i).Prime) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C₀) (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlen₁ : (b₁ - a₁ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M) (hlen₂ : (b₂ - a₂ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (∑' r, rectangleMass s r residue₁ residue₂ modulus a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ M u) ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) ^ 2 * ∑' r : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ s, u / (modulus i : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTCellSeries.factorialSeries_mono
statement:
theorem factorialSeries_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    (∑' r : ℕ, x ^ r / r.factorial) ≤ ∑' r : ℕ, y ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTCellSeries.lemma_three_eleven_interval
statement:
theorem lemma_three_eleven_interval
    (cells : π → Finset κ) (E modulus : π → ℕ) (residue : LabeledCell cells → ℤ)
    (hprime : ∀ p, (modulus p).Prime) (hE : ∀ p, (cells p).card ≤ E p)
    (a b : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (hC : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hlen : (b - a : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (∑' r, intervalMass (Finset.univ : Finset (LabeledCell cells)) r
      residue (labeledCellModulus cells modulus) a b M u) ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) *
        ∑' r : ℕ, (u * ∑ p : π, (E p : ℝ) / (modulus p : ℝ)) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTCellSeries.lemma_three_eleven_rectangle
statement:
theorem lemma_three_eleven_rectangle
    (cells : π → Finset κ) (E : ℕ) (modulus : π → ℕ)
    (residue₁ residue₂ : LabeledCell cells → ℤ)
    (hprime : ∀ p, (modulus p).Prime) (hE : ∀ p, (cells p).card ≤ E)
    (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℤ) (C₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (hC : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂)
    (hlen₁ : (b₁ - a₁ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M) (hlen₂ : (b₂ - a₂ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * M)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (∑' r, rectangleMass (Finset.univ : Finset (LabeledCell cells)) r
      residue₁ residue₂ (labeledCellModulus cells modulus) a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ M u) ≤
      ((C₀ + 1) * M) ^ 2 *
        ∑' r : ℕ, (u * E * ∑ p : π, 1 / (modulus p : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ r / r.factorial

name: PaperC.V282.ClosureCRTCellSeries.sum_labeledCell_weight
statement:
theorem sum_labeledCell_weight (cells : π → Finset κ) (modulus : π → ℕ) (u : ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ z : LabeledCell cells, u / (labeledCellModulus cells modulus z : ℝ) ^ D) =
      u * ∑ p : π, ((cells p).card : ℝ) / (modulus p : ℝ) ^ D

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.defects_monomial_le_terminal
statement:
theorem defects_monomial_le_terminal {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * Q ≤ M ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * Q

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.exceptional_terminal_le_moderate
statement:
theorem exceptional_terminal_le_moderate {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M ^ (3 / (4 : ℝ)) * Q ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤ M * Q ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ))

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.host_monomial_le_shallow
statement:
theorem host_monomial_le_shallow {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    M ^ (3 / (2 : ℝ)) ≤ M ^ (3 / (2 : ℝ)) * Q ^ (1 / (6 : ℝ))

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.moderate_monomial_eq_geometric_mean
statement:
theorem moderate_monomial_eq_geometric_mean {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M * Q ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) =
      (M ^ (5 / (3 : ℝ))) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) *
        (M ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * Q) ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ))

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.moderate_monomial_le_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem moderate_monomial_le_weighted_sum {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M * Q ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 / (3 : ℝ)) * M ^ (5 / (3 : ℝ)) +
        (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * (M ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * Q)

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.rational_monomials_le_two_moderate
statement:
theorem rational_monomials_le_two_moderate {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    M * Q ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) + M * Q ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * (M * Q ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)))

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.rawProfile_le_two_coarseProfile
statement:
theorem rawProfile_le_two_coarseProfile {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    rawProfile M Q ≤ 2 * coarseProfile M Q

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.rawProfile_nonneg
statement:
theorem rawProfile_nonneg {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    0 ≤ rawProfile M Q

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.shallow_monomial_eq_geometric_mean
statement:
theorem shallow_monomial_eq_geometric_mean {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M ^ (3 / (2 : ℝ)) * Q ^ (1 / (6 : ℝ)) =
      (M ^ (5 / (3 : ℝ))) ^ (5 / (6 : ℝ)) *
        (M ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * Q) ^ (1 / (6 : ℝ))

name: PaperC.V282.ProfileMonomials.shallow_monomial_le_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem shallow_monomial_le_weighted_sum {M Q : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    M ^ (3 / (2 : ℝ)) * Q ^ (1 / (6 : ℝ)) ≤
      (5 / (6 : ℝ)) * M ^ (5 / (3 : ℝ)) +
        (1 / (6 : ℝ)) * (M ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * Q)

name: PaperC.V282.DictionaryProfileNormalization.dictionaryPolynomialProfile_nonneg
PaperC.V282.DictionaryProfileNormalization.dictionary_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem dictionary_diagonal_le {N a m : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (ha : 0 < a) (ham : a ≤ m) :
    a ^ 2 * N ≤ N ^ (-(1 / (3 : ℝ))) *
      ((N * a) ^ (4 / (3 : ℝ)) * m ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)))

name: PaperC.V282.DictionaryProfileNormalization.dictionary_monomial_identity
statement:
theorem dictionary_monomial_identity {N a m : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (ha : 0 < a) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (u v : ℝ) :
    a ^ 2 * (N ^ u * (m / a) ^ v) =
      N ^ (u - 2 + v) * (N * a) ^ (2 - v) * m ^ v

name: PaperC.V282.DictionaryProfileNormalization.dictionary_terminal_identity
statement:
theorem dictionary_terminal_identity {N a : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N) (ha : 0 < a) :
    a ^ 2 * (N ^ (2 / (3 : ℝ)) * (1 / a)) = N ^ (-(1 / (3 : ℝ))) * (N * a)

name: PaperC.V282.DictionaryProfileNormalization.normalized_cappedProfile_le
statement:
theorem normalized_cappedProfile_le {N a m Q : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (ha : 0 < a) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hQ : Q = m / a) :
    a ^ 2 * cappedProfile N Q (1 / a) ≤
      N ^ (-(1 / (3 : ℝ))) * dictionaryPolynomialProfile (N * a) m

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.disagreement_le_sum_coordinate_disagreements
statement:
theorem disagreement_le_sum_coordinate_disagreements {Ω ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z W : Ω → ι → ℕ) :
    eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω ≠ W ω) ≤
      ∑ i, eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω i ≠ W ω i)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.event_discrepancy_le_disagreement
statement:
theorem event_discrepancy_le_disagreement {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z W : Ω → α) (A : Set α) :
    |eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω ∈ A) - eventProbability μ (fun ω => W ω ∈ A)| ≤
      eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω ≠ W ω)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.finiteFieldLaw_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteFieldLaw_nonneg
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z : Ω → α) (k : α) :
    0 ≤ finiteFieldLaw μ Z k

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.hasSum_finiteFieldLaw
statement:
theorem hasSum_finiteFieldLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z : Ω → α) :
    HasSum (finiteFieldLaw μ Z) 1

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.hasSum_uniformMixture
statement:
theorem hasSum_uniformMixture {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (p : ι → α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, HasSum (p i) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k => uniformAverage (fun i => p i k)) 1

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_comm
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_comm
    (p q : α → ℝ) :
    massTotalVariation p q = massTotalVariation q p

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_eq_positive_set
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_eq_positive_set {p q : α → ℝ}
    (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hq0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q k) :
    massTotalVariation p q =
      (∑' k, if q k ≤ p k then p k else 0) -
        ∑' k, if q k ≤ p k then q k else 0

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_finiteFieldLaw_le_coordinate_disagreements
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_finiteFieldLaw_le_coordinate_disagreements {Ω ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z W : Ω → ι → ℕ) :
    massTotalVariation (finiteFieldLaw μ Z) (finiteFieldLaw μ W) ≤
      ∑ i, eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω i ≠ W ω i)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_finiteFieldLaw_le_disagreement
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_finiteFieldLaw_le_disagreement {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z W : Ω → α) :
    massTotalVariation (finiteFieldLaw μ Z) (finiteFieldLaw μ W) ≤
      eventProbability μ (fun ω => Z ω ≠ W ω)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_le_of_test_sets
PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_le_one
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_le_one {p q : α → ℝ}
    (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hq0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q k) :
    massTotalVariation p q ≤ 1

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_nonneg
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_nonneg
    (p q : α → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ massTotalVariation p q

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_retainedField_le_bad_sites
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_retainedField_le_bad_sites {Ω ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (good : Finset ι) (W : Ω → ι → ℕ) :
    massTotalVariation (finiteFieldLaw μ W) (finiteFieldLaw μ (retainedField good W)) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ badFieldSites good, eventProbability μ (fun ω => W ω i ≠ 0)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_triangle
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_triangle
    {p q r : α → ℝ}
    (hp : Summable p) (hq : Summable q) (hr : Summable r)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k)
    (hq0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q k)
    (hr0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ r k) :
    massTotalVariation p r ≤
      massTotalVariation p q + massTotalVariation q r

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.massTotalVariation_uniformMixture_le
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_uniformMixture_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (p : ι → α → ℝ) (q : α → ℝ)
    (hsummable :
      ∀ i, Summable fun k ↦ |p i k - q k|) :
    massTotalVariation
        (fun k ↦ uniformAverage (fun i ↦ p i k)) q ≤
      uniformAverage
        (fun i ↦ massTotalVariation (p i) q)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.mem_badFieldSites
statement:
theorem mem_badFieldSites {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (good : Finset ι) (i : ι) :
    i ∈ badFieldSites good ↔ i ∉ good

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.restricted_finiteFieldLaw_eq_eventProbability
statement:
theorem restricted_finiteFieldLaw_eq_eventProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (W : Ω → α) (A : Set α) :
    (∑' k, if k ∈ A then finiteFieldLaw μ W k else 0) =
      eventProbability μ (fun ω => W ω ∈ A)

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.summable_abs_sub_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem summable_abs_sub_of_nonneg
    {p q : α → ℝ}
    (hp : Summable p) (hq : Summable q)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hq0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q k) :

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.summable_finiteFieldLaw
statement:
theorem summable_finiteFieldLaw

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.summable_restricted_mass

name: PaperC.V282.FiniteFieldTotalVariation.uniformMixture_nonneg
statement:
theorem uniformMixture_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquarePacking.card_le_seven_of_separated
statement:
theorem card_le_seven_of_separated {S : Finset ℕ} {a B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hwindow : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ n ∧ n < a + B)
    (hsep : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ n ∈ S, m < n → B < 7 * (n - m)) :
    S.card ≤ 7

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquarePacking.coefficient_card_le_seven
statement:
theorem coefficient_card_le_seven {S : Finset ℕ} {a lo B : ℕ}
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hmedium : ∀ p ∈ S, B < 11 * p)
    (hwindow : ∀ p ∈ S, lo ≤ a * p ^ 2 ∧ a * p ^ 2 < lo + B) :
    S.card ≤ 7

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquarePacking.square_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem square_coefficient_le {B n p a : ℕ} (hB : 1332 ≤ B)
    (hp : B < 11 * p) (hn : n ≤ B ^ 2 + B) (heq : n = a * p ^ 2) :

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquarePacking.square_multiple_separation
statement:
theorem square_multiple_separation {a B p q : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a)

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquareExceptions.squareIncidences_card_le
statement:
theorem squareIncidences_card_le {lo B : ℕ} (hB : 1332 ≤ B)

name: PaperC.V282.MediumSquareExceptions.square_incidence_card_le
statement:
theorem square_incidence_card_le {S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)} {lo B : ℕ}
    (hB : 1332 ≤ B)
    (hwindow : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < z.1 ∧ lo ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 < lo + B ∧ z.1 ≤ B ^ 2 + B)

name: PaperC.V282.MediumMultipleCounts.div_le_multiples_card

name: PaperC.V282.MediumMultipleCounts.floor_sum_le_incidence_card
PaperC.V282.MediumMultipleCounts.floor_sum_le_odd_incidence_add

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumSquares.coefficient_card_le

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumSquares.floor_sum_le_odd_incidence_add
statement:
theorem floor_sum_le_odd_incidence_add {K lo B : ℕ} {P : Finset ℕ}

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumLayers.floor_lt_cutoff

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumLayers.layer_card

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumLayers.layer_primes_eq
statement:

name: PaperC.V282.FixedMediumLayers.mem_mediumPrimes

name: PaperC.V282.FullPrimeAssignment.sum_eq_selected
statement:
theorem sum_eq_selected
    {x L p : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hpL : L + 1 < p)
    (c : Fin (L + 1) → F₂) (v : Fin (L + 1))
    (hv : parityVec (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v) p ≠ 0) :
    (∑ w : Fin (L + 1), c w * parityVec (startCompleteVertexLabel x L w) p) =
      c v * parityVec (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v) p

name: PaperC.V282.FullIntervalPrimeAssignment.left_mem_boundedAssignment_of_selected_right
statement:
theorem left_mem_boundedAssignment_of_selected_right
    {A Z L x y : ℕ} (hA : 2 ≤ A)
    (hx : x ∈ boundedRatioBlock A Z) (hy : y ∈ boundedRatioBlock A Z)
    (c : Sum (Fin (L + 1)) (Fin (L + 1)) → F₂)
    (hEq : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      ∑ i, c i * parityVec (twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L i) p = 0)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) (hvSelected : c (Sum.inr v) ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.startsForSomeAssignment A Z L
      (startCompleteVertexLabel y L v)

name: PaperC.V282.FullIntervalPrimeAssignment.right_mem_boundedAssignment_of_selected_left
statement:
theorem right_mem_boundedAssignment_of_selected_left
    {A Z L x y : ℕ} (hA : 2 ≤ A)
    (hx : x ∈ boundedRatioBlock A Z) (hy : y ∈ boundedRatioBlock A Z)
    (c : Sum (Fin (L + 1)) (Fin (L + 1)) → F₂)
    (hEq : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      ∑ i, c i * parityVec (twoStartCompleteVertexLabel x y L i) p = 0)
    (v : Fin (L + 1)) (hvSelected : c (Sum.inl v) ≠ 0) :
    y ∈ BoundedRatioRelationalHosts.startsForSomeAssignment A Z L
      (startCompleteVertexLabel x L v)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.card_boxSolutions_le_gcd
statement:
theorem card_boxSolutions_le_gcd
    (q q' h a b c d : ℕ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((boxSolutions q q' h a b c d).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + ((b : ℝ) - a) * (q'.gcd q : ℝ) / q'

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.card_boxSolutions_le_primitive_step
statement:
theorem card_boxSolutions_le_primitive_step
    (q q' h a b c d : ℕ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((boxSolutions q q' h a b c d).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((b : ℝ) - a) / (q' / q'.gcd q : ℕ) + 1

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.card_boxSolutions_le_shift
statement:
theorem card_boxSolutions_le_shift
    (q q' h a b c d : ℕ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hh : 0 < h) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((boxSolutions q q' h a b c d).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + ((b : ℝ) - a) * h / q'

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.card_dyadic_boxSolutions_le
statement:
theorem card_dyadic_boxSolutions_le
    (q q' h R S X : ℕ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hh : 0 < h) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hscale : X ≤ 2 * q' * S) :
    ((boxSolutions q q' h R (2 * R) S (2 * S)).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + 2 * R * S * h / X

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.first_coordinates_modEq
statement:
theorem first_coordinates_modEq {q q' h r s r' s' : ℕ} (hq' : 0 < q')
    (heq : q * r + h = q' * s) (heq' : q * r' + h = q' * s') :
    r ≡ r' [MOD q' / q'.gcd q]

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.fst_injOn_boxSolutions
statement:
theorem fst_injOn_boxSolutions {q q' h a b c d : ℕ} (hq' : 0 < q') :
    Set.InjOn Prod.fst (↑(boxSolutions q q' h a b c d) : Set (ℕ × ℕ))

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.gcd_dvd_shift_of_solution
statement:
theorem gcd_dvd_shift_of_solution {q q' h r s : ℕ}
    (heq : q * r + h = q' * s) : q'.gcd q ∣ h

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.mem_boxSolutions
statement:
theorem mem_boxSolutions {q q' h a b c d : ℕ} {rs : ℕ × ℕ} :
    rs ∈ boxSolutions q q' h a b c d ↔
      (a ≤ rs.1 ∧ rs.1 < b) ∧ (c ≤ rs.2 ∧ rs.2 < d) ∧
        q * rs.1 + h = q' * rs.2

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelBoxCount.primitive_step_pos
statement:
theorem primitive_step_pos {q q' : ℕ} (hq' : 0 < q') :
    0 < q' / q'.gcd q

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.card_kernelQuotients_le
statement:
theorem card_kernelQuotients_le (B X R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ((kernelQuotients B X R).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (X / R : ℕ) *
        ∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.card_kernelQuotients_le_sqrt_ratio
statement:
theorem card_kernelQuotients_le_sqrt_ratio (B X R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ((kernelQuotients B X R).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt ((X : ℝ) / R) *
        ∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotient_eq_square_mul_small
statement:
theorem kernelQuotient_eq_square_mul_small {B n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    kernelQuotient B n = DefectivePredicate.canonicalSquarePart n ^ 2 * smallOddPart B n

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotient_hDefective
statement:
theorem kernelQuotient_hDefective {B n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    HDefective B (kernelQuotient B n)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotient_le_div
statement:
theorem kernelQuotient_le_div {B n X R : ℕ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hnX : n ≤ X) (hkernel : R ≤ largeOddKernel B n) :
    kernelQuotient B n ≤ X / R

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotient_mul_kernel
statement:
theorem kernelQuotient_mul_kernel (B n : ℕ) :
    kernelQuotient B n * largeOddKernel B n = n

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotient_pos
statement: theorem kernelQuotient_pos {B n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < kernelQuotient B n

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.kernelQuotients_subset_kernel_one
statement:
theorem kernelQuotients_subset_kernel_one (B X R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    kernelQuotients B X R ⊆ boundedLargeKernelValues B 1 (X / R)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelQuotients.largeOddKernel_kernelQuotient_eq_one
statement:
theorem largeOddKernel_kernelQuotient_eq_one {B n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    largeOddKernel B (kernelQuotient B n) = 1

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelRangeCount.card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_quotient_counts
statement:
theorem card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_quotient_counts
    (B h X R S : ℕ) (hX : 0 < X) (hh : 0 < h) (hhX : h ≤ X) :
    ((shiftedKernelRangeValues B h X R S).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((kernelQuotients B (3 * X) R).card : ℝ) *
        ((kernelQuotients B (3 * X) S).card : ℝ) *
          (1 + 2 * R * S * h / X)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelRangeCount.card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_sqrt_fibres
statement:
theorem card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_sqrt_fibres
    (B h X R S : ℕ) (hX : 0 < X) (hh : 0 < h) (hhX : h ≤ X)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hS : 0 < S) :
    ((shiftedKernelRangeValues B h X R S).card : ℝ) ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt ((3 * X : ℝ) / R) * Real.sqrt ((3 * X : ℝ) / S) *
        (∏ p ∈ smallPrimesUpTo B, (1 + (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹)) ^ 2 *
          (1 + 2 * R * S * h / X)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelRangeCount.card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_sum_boxes
statement:
theorem card_shiftedKernelRangeValues_le_sum_boxes
    (B h X R S : ℕ) (hX : 0 < X) (hhX : h ≤ X) :
    (shiftedKernelRangeValues B h X R S).card ≤
      ∑ q ∈ kernelQuotients B (3 * X) R,
        ∑ q' ∈ admissibleSecondQuotients B X S,
          (boxSolutions q q' h R (2 * R) S (2 * S)).card

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelRangeCount.mem_shiftedKernelRangeValues
statement:
theorem mem_shiftedKernelRangeValues {B h X R S n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ shiftedKernelRangeValues B h X R S ↔
      (X ≤ n ∧ n < 2 * X) ∧
      (R ≤ largeOddKernel B n ∧ largeOddKernel B n < 2 * R) ∧
      (S ≤ largeOddKernel B (n + h) ∧ largeOddKernel B (n + h) < 2 * S)

name: PaperC.V282.ShiftedKernelRangeCount.shiftedKernelRangeValues_subset_quotientBoxCover
statement:
theorem shiftedKernelRangeValues_subset_quotientBoxCover
    (B h X R S : ℕ) (hX : 0 < X) (hhX : h ≤ X) :
    shiftedKernelRangeValues B h X R S ⊆ quotientBoxCover B h X R S

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.card_increasingPairs
statement:
theorem card_increasingPairs (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (increasingPairs s).card = s.card.choose 2

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.card_windowIncidences
statement:
theorem card_windowIncidences (B T L : ℕ) (starts : Finset ℕ) :
    (windowIncidences B T L starts).card = windowEnergy B T L starts

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.card_windowIncidences_eq_shifted
statement:
theorem card_windowIncidences_eq_shifted
    (B T L a b : ℕ) (starts : Finset ℕ)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ starts, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), a ≤ x - 1 + i ∧ x - 1 + i < b) :
    (windowIncidences B T L starts).card = (shiftedWindowIncidences B T L a b starts).card

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.card_windowPlacements_le
statement:
theorem card_windowPlacements_le (starts : Finset ℕ) (L h n : ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ starts, 1 ≤ x) :
    (windowPlacements starts L h n).card ≤ L + 1

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.dyadic_windowEnergy_eq_sum_shifted
statement:
theorem dyadic_windowEnergy_eq_sum_shifted
    (B T L X : ℕ) (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    windowEnergy B T L (Finset.Ico X (2 * X)) =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, ∑ n ∈ shiftedKernelValues B T (X - 1) (2 * X + L) h,
        (windowPlacements (Finset.Ico X (2 * X)) L h n).card

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.dyadic_windowEnergy_le_length_mul_sum_shifted
statement:
theorem dyadic_windowEnergy_le_length_mul_sum_shifted
    (B T L X : ℕ) (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    windowEnergy B T L (Finset.Ico X (2 * X)) ≤ (L + 1) *
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, (shiftedKernelValues B T (X - 1) (2 * X + L) h).card

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.mem_increasingPairs
statement:
theorem mem_increasingPairs {s : Finset ℕ} {ij : ℕ × ℕ} :
    ij ∈ increasingPairs s ↔ ij.1 ∈ s ∧ ij.2 ∈ s ∧ ij.1 < ij.2

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.windowEnergy_eq_sum_shifted
statement:
theorem windowEnergy_eq_sum_shifted
    (B T L a b : ℕ) (starts : Finset ℕ)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ starts, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), a ≤ x - 1 + i ∧ x - 1 + i < b) :
    windowEnergy B T L starts =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, ∑ n ∈ shiftedKernelValues B T a b h,
        (windowPlacements starts L h n).card

name: PaperC.V282.KernelWindowEnergy.windowEnergy_le_length_mul_sum_shifted
statement:
theorem windowEnergy_le_length_mul_sum_shifted
    (B T L a b : ℕ) (starts : Finset ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ starts, 1 ≤ x)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ starts, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), a ≤ x - 1 + i ∧ x - 1 + i < b) :
    windowEnergy B T L starts ≤ (L + 1) *
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, (shiftedKernelValues B T a b h).card

name: PaperC.V282.OrderedPairCounting.card_larger_fiber_le_two_partners
statement:
theorem card_larger_fiber_le_two_partners (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (x : ℕ) :
    ((s.filter fun p => max p.1 p.2 = x).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((smallerPartners s x).card : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.OrderedPairCounting.card_le_two_mul_largerStarts_mul
statement:
theorem card_le_two_mul_largerStarts_mul
    (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (R : ℝ)
    (hpartners : ∀ x ∈ largerStarts s, ((smallerPartners s x).card : ℝ) ≤ R) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((largerStarts s).card : ℝ) * R

name: PaperC.V282.OrderedPairCounting.card_normalized_fiber_le_two
statement:
theorem card_normalized_fiber_le_two (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (q : ℕ × ℕ) :
    ((s.filter fun p => normalizedPair p = q).card : ℝ) ≤ 2

name: PaperC.V282.OrderedPairCounting.normalizedPair_eq_iff
statement:
theorem normalizedPair_eq_iff (p q : ℕ × ℕ) :
    normalizedPair p = normalizedPair q ↔ p = q ∨ p = q.swap

name: PaperC.V282.KernelEnergyCounting.card_cast_le_windowEnergy
statement:
theorem card_cast_le_windowEnergy {B T L : ℕ} (starts selected : Finset ℕ)
    (hsub : selected ⊆ starts)
    (hsmall : ∀ x ∈ selected, 2 ≤ (smallKernelOffsets B T L x).card) :
    (selected.card : ℝ) ≤ (windowEnergy B T L starts : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.KernelEnergyCounting.card_le_windowEnergy
statement:
theorem card_le_windowEnergy {B T L : ℕ} (starts selected : Finset ℕ)
    (hsub : selected ⊆ starts)
    (hsmall : ∀ x ∈ selected, 2 ≤ (smallKernelOffsets B T L x).card) :
    selected.card ≤ windowEnergy B T L starts

name: PaperC.V282.KernelEnergyCounting.card_pairs_le_two_energy_mul
statement:
theorem card_pairs_le_two_energy_mul {B T L : ℕ} (starts : Finset ℕ)
    (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hstarts : largerStarts s ⊆ starts)
    (hsmall : ∀ x ∈ largerStarts s, 2 ≤ (smallKernelOffsets B T L x).card)
    (hpartners : ∀ x ∈ largerStarts s, ((smallerPartners s x).card : ℝ) ≤ R) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (windowEnergy B T L starts : ℝ) * R

name: PaperC.V282.LogarithmicWordPowers.length_pow_uniformSubpolynomial
statement:
theorem length_pow_uniformSubpolynomial (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (d : ℕ) :
    UniformSubpolynomialOn
      (fun M L => ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log M)
      (fun _ L => (L + 1 : ℝ) ^ d)

name: PaperC.V282.LogarithmicWordPowers.polynomial_factor_le_rpow_eventually
statement:
theorem polynomial_factor_le_rpow_eventually
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (a : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ∀ L : ℕ,
      ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log M →
      |a * (L + 1 : ℝ) ^ d| ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ ε

name: PaperC.V282.LogarithmicWordPowers.polynomial_factor_uniformSubpolynomial
statement:
theorem polynomial_factor_uniformSubpolynomial
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (a : ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    UniformSubpolynomialOn
      (fun M L => ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log M)
      (fun _ L => a * (L + 1 : ℝ) ^ d)

name: PaperC.V282.LogarithmicWordPowers.two_pow_div_le_word_rpow
statement:
theorem two_pow_div_le_word_rpow (L d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (L / d) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1)) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ))

name: PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.finiteFieldLaw_statistic_bound
PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.hasSum_pushforwardMass
statement:
theorem hasSum_pushforwardMass {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) {p : α → ℝ}
    {c : ℝ} (hp : HasSum p c) : HasSum (pushforwardMass f p) c

name: PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.massTotalVariation_pushforward_le
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_pushforward_le {α β : Type*} (f : α → β)
    {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) :
    massTotalVariation (pushforwardMass f p) (pushforwardMass f q) ≤
      massTotalVariation p q

name: PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.pushforwardMass_eq_restricted
statement:
theorem pushforwardMass_eq_restricted {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (p : α → ℝ)
    (b : β) : pushforwardMass f p b = ∑' a, if f a = b then p a else 0

name: PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.pushforwardMass_finiteFieldLaw
statement:
theorem pushforwardMass_finiteFieldLaw {Ω α β : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (Z : Ω → α) (f : α → β) :
    pushforwardMass f (finiteFieldLaw μ Z) = finiteFieldLaw μ (fun ω => f (Z ω))

name: PaperC.V282.MassPushforward.pushforwardMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem pushforwardMass_nonneg {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) {p : α → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : β) : 0 ≤ pushforwardMass f p b

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.couplingMass_diagonal
statement:
theorem couplingMass_diagonal (p q : α → ℝ) (x : α) :
    couplingMass p q (x,x)=overlap p q x

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.couplingMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem couplingMass_nonneg {p q : α → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x)
    (z : α × α) : 0≤couplingMass p q z

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.couplingMass_swap
statement:
theorem couplingMass_swap (p q : α → ℝ) (x y : α) :
    couplingMass p q (x,y)=couplingMass q p (y,x)

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.hasSum_couplingMass
statement:
theorem hasSum_couplingMass {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) : HasSum (couplingMass p q) 1

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.hasSum_couplingMass_column
statement:
theorem hasSum_couplingMass_column {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) (y : α) :

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.hasSum_couplingMass_row
statement:
theorem hasSum_couplingMass_row {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) (x : α) :
    HasSum (fun y => couplingMass p q (x,y)) (p x)

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.hasSum_residual
statement:
theorem hasSum_residual {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) :
    HasSum (residual p q) (massTotalVariation p q)

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.overlap_nonneg
statement:
theorem overlap_nonneg {p q : α → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) (x : α) :
    0≤overlap p q x

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.residual_eq_zero_of_variation_zero
statement:
theorem residual_eq_zero_of_variation_zero {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) (hzero : massTotalVariation p q=0) (x : α) :
    residual p q x=0

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.residual_nonneg
statement: theorem residual_nonneg (p q : α → ℝ) (x : α) : 0≤residual p q x

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.residual_product_self
statement: theorem residual_product_self (p q : α → ℝ) (x : α) : residual p q x*residual q p x=0

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.summable_overlap
statement:
theorem summable_overlap {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : Summable p)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) : Summable (overlap p q)

name: PaperC.V282.MaximalCouplingMass.variation_eq_one_sub_overlap
statement:
theorem variation_eq_one_sub_overlap {p q : α → ℝ} (hp : HasSum p 1) (hq : HasSum q 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ x,0≤p x) (hq0 : ∀ x,0≤q x) :
    massTotalVariation p q=1-∑' x,overlap p q x

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.floor_eq_layers
statement:
theorem floor_eq_layers {B p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ mediumPrimes B) :
    B / p = ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 10, if j ≤ B / p then 1 else 0

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.floor_lt_eleven
statement: theorem floor_lt_eleven {B p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ mediumPrimes B) : B / p < 11

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.floor_sum_eq_prime_layers
statement:
theorem floor_sum_eq_prime_layers (B : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ mediumPrimes B, B / p =
      ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 10, (PrimesUpTo.count (B / j) - PrimesUpTo.count (B / 11))

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.layer_card
statement:
theorem layer_card {B j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ Icc 1 10) :
    ((mediumPrimes B).filter (fun p => j ≤ B / p)).card =
      PrimesUpTo.count (B / j) - PrimesUpTo.count (B / 11)

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.layer_primes_eq
statement:
theorem layer_primes_eq {B j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ Icc 1 10) :
    (mediumPrimes B).filter (fun p => j ≤ B / p) =
      smallPrimesUpTo (B / j) \ smallPrimesUpTo (B / 11)

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.mem_mediumPrimes
statement:
theorem mem_mediumPrimes {B p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ mediumPrimes B ↔ p.Prime ∧ p ≤ B ∧ B < 11 * p

name: PaperC.V282.MediumPrimeLayers.prime_layers_le_odd_incidence_add
statement:
theorem prime_layers_le_odd_incidence_add {lo B : ℕ}
    (hlo : 0 < lo) (hB : 1332 ≤ B) (htop : lo + B ≤ B ^ 2 + B + 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 10, (PrimesUpTo.count (B / j) - PrimesUpTo.count (B / 11)) ≤
      (oddIncidences lo B (mediumPrimes B)).card + 854

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.configurationEquiv_apply

theorem configurationEquiv_apply (α σ : Type*) (d : ℕ)

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.levelEquiv_val

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.massTotalVariation_injective
statement:
theorem massTotalVariation_injective {α β : Type*} (f : α → β)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (p q : α → ℝ) :
    massTotalVariation (pushforwardMass f p) (pushforwardMass f q) =
      massTotalVariation p q

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.measurable_configurationEquiv

theorem measurable_configurationEquiv (α σ : Type*) [Countable α] [Countable σ]

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.measurable_configurationEquiv_symm

theorem measurable_configurationEquiv_symm (α σ : Type*) [Countable α] [Countable σ]

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.pushforwardMass_injective_apply
statement:
theorem pushforwardMass_injective_apply {α β : Type*} (f : α → β)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : α → ℝ) (a : α) :
    pushforwardMass f p (f a) = p a

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.pushforwardMass_zero_off_range
statement:
theorem pushforwardMass_zero_off_range {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (p : α → ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.MovingMarkedLevels.runLength_eq
statement:
theorem runLength_eq (b d e : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ b) :

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureSpace.continuous_fixedPointMeasure

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureSpace.continuous_pointDirac

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.encoding_tendsto_iff
statement:
theorem encoding_tendsto_iff [Nonempty X] (x : X) {α : Type*} {l : Filter α}
    (mu : α→FiniteMeasure X) (target : FiniteMeasure X) :
    Tendsto (fun i => probabilityMassEncoding x (mu i)) l (𝓝 (probabilityMassEncoding x target)) ↔
      Tendsto mu l (𝓝 target)

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.finite_integral_add
statement:
theorem finite_integral_add (mu nu : FiniteMeasure X) (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) :
    (∫ x,f x ∂(mu+nu : FiniteMeasure X))=(∫ x,f x ∂mu)+(∫ x,f x ∂nu)

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.isInducing_encoding
statement:
theorem isInducing_encoding [Nonempty X] (x : X) :

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.point_law_limit_unique
statement:
theorem point_law_limit_unique [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetrizableSpace X] [SeparableSpace X]
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] (laws : α→ProbabilityMeasure (PointMeasure X))
    (mu nu : ProbabilityMeasure (PointMeasure X))
    (hmu : Tendsto laws l (𝓝 mu)) (hnu : Tendsto laws l (𝓝 nu)) : mu=nu

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.shifted_nonzero
statement:
theorem shifted_nonzero (x : X) (mu : FiniteMeasure X) :

name: PaperC.V282.PointMeasureWeakUniqueness.tendsto_of_add_constant

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceModel.mem_columnSupport

theorem mem_columnSupport (H : Matrix R V F₂) (r : R) (v : V) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceModel.mem_pinnedColumns
statement:
theorem mem_pinnedColumns (H : Matrix R V F₂) (v : V) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceModel.mem_rowSupport
statement:
theorem mem_rowSupport (H : Matrix R V F₂) (r : R) (v : V) :
    v ∈ rowSupport H r ↔ H r v ≠ 0

statement:
theorem mulVecLin_apply_eq_support_sum (H : Matrix R V F₂) (f : V → F₂) (r : R) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceModel.row_shapes
PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceCounting.columnSupport_le_component_sub_one
statement:
theorem columnSupport_le_component_sub_one (H : Matrix R V F₂)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s)
    (c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent)
    (hc : ¬ ComponentPinned (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H) c)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ c.supp) :
    (columnSupport H v).card ≤ Fintype.card c.supp - 1

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceCounting.componentMass_le_degree
statement:
theorem componentMass_le_degree (H : Matrix R V F₂) (K : ℕ)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport H v).card ≤ K)
    (c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentMass H c ≤ K * Fintype.card c.supp

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceCounting.componentMass_le_simple
statement:
theorem componentMass_le_simple (H : Matrix R V F₂)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s)
    (c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent)
    (hc : ¬ ComponentPinned (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H) c) :
    componentMass H c ≤ Fintype.card c.supp * (Fintype.card c.supp - 1)

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceCounting.exists_other_endpoint
statement:
theorem exists_other_endpoint (H : Matrix R V F₂)

    ∃ w, w ≠ v ∧ rowSupport H r = {v,w}

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceCounting.sum_componentMass
statement:
theorem sum_componentMass (H : Matrix R V F₂) :
    (∑ c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent, componentMass H c) = incidenceMass H

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceKernel.finrank_kernel_eq_unpinned
statement:
theorem finrank_kernel_eq_unpinned (H : Matrix R V F₂)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceKernel.kernel_eq_pinnedGraphSpace
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_pinnedGraphSpace (H : Matrix R V F₂)

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceKernel.mem_kernel_iff_support_sums

theorem mem_kernel_iff_support_sums (H : Matrix R V F₂) (f : V → F₂) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceKernel.rank_add_unpinned_eq_card
statement:
theorem rank_add_unpinned_eq_card (H : Matrix R V F₂)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2) :
    H.rank + Fintype.card (UnpinnedComponent (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H)) =
      Fintype.card V

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceRank.component_mass_budget
statement:
theorem component_mass_budget (H : Matrix R V F₂) (K : ℕ)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport H v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s)
    (c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentMass H c + (K + 1) *
      (if ComponentPinned (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H) c then 0 else 1) ≤
      (K + 1) * Fintype.card c.supp

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceRank.incidenceMass_add_nullity_le
statement:
theorem incidenceMass_add_nullity_le (H : Matrix R V F₂) (K : ℕ)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport H v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s) :
    incidenceMass H + (K + 1) *
      Fintype.card (UnpinnedComponent (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H)) ≤
      (K + 1) * Fintype.card V

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceRank.lemma_e_two
statement:
theorem lemma_e_two (H : Matrix R V F₂) (K : ℕ)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport H v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s) :

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceRank.sum_unpinned_indicator

theorem sum_unpinned_indicator (H : Matrix R V F₂) :
    (∑ c : (incidenceGraph H).ConnectedComponent,
      if ComponentPinned (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H) c then 0 else 1) =
      Fintype.card (UnpinnedComponent (incidenceGraph H) (pinnedColumns H))

name: PaperC.V282.SimpleIncidenceRank.unpinned_component_numeric_bound
statement:
theorem unpinned_component_numeric_bound (mass r K : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdegree : mass ≤ K * r) (hsimple : mass ≤ r * (r - 1)) :

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceRank.finrank_ker_rowProjection

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceRank.mulVecLin_deleteRows

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceRank.private_column_mem_range

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceRank.rank_eq_private_add_deleted
statement:
theorem rank_eq_private_add_deleted (A : Matrix R C F₂) (D : Finset R)

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceRank.rowProjection_surjective

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceCounting.columnSupport_deleteRows_le

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceCounting.deleted_incidence_le_rank

theorem incidenceMass_le_deleted_add_private (H : Matrix R V F₂) (D : Finset R)

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceCounting.incidenceMass_le_private_add_deleted_rank
statement:
theorem incidenceMass_le_private_add_deleted_rank (H : Matrix R V F₂) (D : Finset R) (K : ℕ)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport H r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport H v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport H r).card = 2 → rowSupport H r = rowSupport H s → r = s)

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceBudget.private_incidence_rank_budget
statement:
theorem private_incidence_rank_budget (A : Matrix R C F₂) (D : Finset R)
    (select : V → C) (K : ℕ)
    (hprivate : ∀ r ∈ D, Pi.single r (1 : F₂) ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport (A.submatrix id select) v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card = 2 →
      rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r = rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) s → r = s)
    (hloss : ∀ r ∈ D, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 1) :
    (K + 1) * D.card + (incidenceMass (A.submatrix id select) - D.card) ≤
      (K + 1) * A.rank

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceBudget.private_incidence_rank_real
statement:
theorem private_incidence_rank_real (A : Matrix R C F₂) (D : Finset R)
    (select : V → C) (K : ℕ)
    (hprivate : ∀ r ∈ D, Pi.single r (1 : F₂) ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport (A.submatrix id select) v).card ≤ K)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card = 2 →
      rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r = rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) s → r = s)
    (hloss : ∀ r ∈ D, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 1) :
    (D.card : ℝ) + (incidenceMass (A.submatrix id select) - D.card : ℕ) / (K + 1 : ℝ) ≤
      (A.rank : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.PrivateIncidenceBudget.private_incidence_rank_twelfth
statement:
theorem private_incidence_rank_twelfth (A : Matrix R C F₂) (D : Finset R)
    (select : V → C)
    (hprivate : ∀ r ∈ D, Pi.single r (1 : F₂) ∈ LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 2)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (columnSupport (A.submatrix id select) v).card ≤ 11)
    (hsimple : ∀ r s, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card = 2 →
      rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r = rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) s → r = s)
    (hloss : ∀ r ∈ D, (rowSupport (A.submatrix id select) r).card ≤ 1) :
    (D.card : ℝ) + (incidenceMass (A.submatrix id select) - D.card : ℕ) / 12 ≤
      (A.rank : ℝ)

name: PaperC.V282.RationalGeometryMass.geometryMass_le_height_envelope
statement:
theorem geometryMass_le_height_envelope (L : ℕ) :
    geometryMass L ≤
      ∑ q ∈ Icc 2 L, (2 * q) * (((2 * q) * L + 1) * 2 ^ (L / q))

name: PaperC.V282.RationalGeometryMass.geometryMass_le_poly_two_pow_half
statement:
theorem geometryMass_le_poly_two_pow_half (L : ℕ) :
    geometryMass L ≤ 6 * (L + 1) ^ 4 * 2 ^ (L / 2)

name: PaperC.V282.RationalGeometryMass.geometryMass_le_uniform_height_envelope
statement:
theorem geometryMass_le_uniform_height_envelope (L : ℕ) :
    geometryMass L ≤
      L * (2 * L) * ((2 * L) * L + 1) * 2 ^ (L / 2)

name: PaperC.V282.RationalGeometryMass.geometry_mem_sum_iff
statement:
theorem geometry_mem_sum_iff {L a b : ℕ} {h : ℤ} :
    (Nat.max a b ∈ Icc 2 L ∧
      (a, b) ∈ reducedRatiosAtHeight (Nat.max a b) ∧
      h ∈ nontrivialChannelHeights L a b) ↔
    0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a.Coprime b ∧ 2 ≤ Nat.max a b ∧
      2 ≤ (channelCells L a b h).card

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.log_le_upperSaddleBranch
statement:
theorem log_le_upperSaddleBranch {nu : ℝ} (hnu : Real.exp 1 ≤ nu) :
    Real.log nu ≤ upperSaddleBranch nu

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.tendsto_log_div_upperSaddleBranch
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_div_upperSaddleBranch :
    Tendsto (fun nu => Real.log nu / upperSaddleBranch nu) atTop (𝓝 1)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.tendsto_upperSaddleBranch_div_log
statement:
theorem tendsto_upperSaddleBranch_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun nu => upperSaddleBranch nu / Real.log nu) atTop (𝓝 1)

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.tendsto_upperSaddleBranch_second_order
statement:

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.upperSaddleBranch_le_two_log_eventually
statement:
theorem upperSaddleBranch_le_two_log_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ nu : ℝ in atTop, upperSaddleBranch nu ≤ 2 * Real.log nu

name: PaperC.V282.SaddleBranchAsymptotics.upperSaddleBranch_refined_identity
statement:
theorem upperSaddleBranch_refined_identity {nu : ℝ}
    (hnu : Real.exp 1 ≤ nu) (hnuone : 1 < nu) :
    upperSaddleBranch nu - Real.log nu - Real.log (Real.log nu) =
      Real.log (upperSaddleBranch nu / Real.log nu)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinLocalTelescoping.active_outside_difference_le
statement:
theorem active_outside_difference_le (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (i : ι) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) (ω : Ω) :
    (if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
      |f (countOn X (Finset.univ \ closedNeighborhood G i) ω + 1) -
        f (indicatorSum X ω)| ≤
      d * ((if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        countOn X ((closedNeighborhood G i).erase i) ω)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinLocalTelescoping.full_outside_difference_le
statement:
theorem full_outside_difference_le (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (i : ι) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) (ω : Ω) :
    |f (indicatorSum X ω + 1) -
      f (countOn X (Finset.univ \ closedNeighborhood G i) ω + 1)| ≤
      d * countOn X (closedNeighborhood G i) ω

name: PaperC.V282.SteinLocalTelescoping.local_stein_error_le
statement:
theorem local_stein_error_le (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (i : ι) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) :
    |marginal μ X i * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (indicatorSum X ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω =>
        (if X i ω = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f (indicatorSum X ω))| ≤
      d * (marginal μ X i ^ 2 +
        marginal μ X i * ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i, marginal μ X j +
        ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i, jointMarginal μ X i j)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinScalarTelescoping.scalar_stein_error_le
statement:
theorem scalar_stein_error_le (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) :
    |poissonParameter μ X * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (indicatorSum X ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => (indicatorSum X ω : ℝ) * f (indicatorSum X ω))| ≤
      d * (bOne μ X G + bTwo μ X G)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinScalarTelescoping.sum_local_cost_eq_bOne_add_bTwo
statement:
theorem sum_local_cost_eq_bOne_add_bTwo (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) :
    (∑ i, (marginal μ X i ^ 2 +
      marginal μ X i * ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i, marginal μ X j +
      ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i, jointMarginal μ X i j)) =
      bOne μ X G + bTwo μ X G

name: PaperC.V282.SteinSoftTelescoping.abs_expectation_bounded
statement:
theorem abs_expectation_bounded (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (F : Ω → ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ ω, |F ω| ≤ c) : |finitePMFExpectation μ F| ≤ c

name: PaperC.V282.SteinSoftTelescoping.exceptional_error_le
statement:
theorem exceptional_error_le (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (bad : Finset ι) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {e c : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hf : ∀ k, |f k| ≤ c) :
    |e * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (indicatorSum X ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => (countOn X bad ω : ℝ) * f (indicatorSum X ω))| ≤
      c * (e + ∑ i ∈ bad, marginal μ X i)

name: PaperC.V282.SteinSoftTelescoping.goodSteinCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem goodSteinCost_nonneg (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (good : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ goodSteinCost μ X G good p

name: PaperC.V282.SteinSoftTelescoping.good_error_le
statement:
theorem good_error_le (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (good : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hgood : ∀ i ∈ good, marginal μ X i = p)
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) :
    |(good.card : ℝ) * p * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (indicatorSum X ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => (countOn X good ω : ℝ) * f (indicatorSum X ω))| ≤
      d * goodSteinCost μ X G good p

name: PaperC.V282.SteinSoftTelescoping.soft_stein_error_le
statement:
theorem soft_stein_error_le (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (good : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hgood : ∀ i ∈ good, marginal μ X i = p)
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) {c d : ℝ} (hf : ∀ k, |f k| ≤ c)
    (hd : ∀ k, |f (k + 1) - f k| ≤ d) :
    |(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * p * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (indicatorSum X ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => (indicatorSum X ω : ℝ) * f (indicatorSum X ω))| ≤
      d * goodSteinCost μ X G good p +
        c * ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p + ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, marginal μ X i)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarPoissonBounds.expectation_stein_equation
statement:
theorem expectation_stein_equation (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (W : Ω → ℕ)
    (rate : ℝ≥0) (A : Set ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (heq : ∀ k : ℕ, (rate : ℝ) * f (k + 1) - (k : ℝ) * f k =
      (if k ∈ A then 1 else 0) - poissonSetMass rate A) :
    (rate : ℝ) * finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => f (W ω + 1)) -
      finitePMFExpectation μ (fun ω => (W ω : ℝ) * f (W ω)) =
        eventProbability μ (fun ω => W ω ∈ A) - poissonSetMass rate A

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarPoissonBounds.lemma_b_two_finite
statement:
theorem lemma_b_two_finite (hStein : ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G) (good : Finset ι)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hgood : ∀ i ∈ good, marginal μ X i = p)
    (rate : ℝ≥0) (hrate : (rate : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * p) :
    natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw μ (indicatorSum X)) (poissonMass rate) ≤
      firstSteinFactor rate * goodSteinCost μ X G good p +
        zeroSteinFactor rate *
          ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p + ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, marginal μ X i)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarPoissonBounds.scalar_poisson_bound
statement:
theorem scalar_poisson_bound (hStein : ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
    (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G) :
    natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw μ (indicatorSum X)) (poissonMass (poissonRate μ X)) ≤
      firstSteinFactor (poissonRate μ X) * (bOne μ X G + bTwo μ X G)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarPoissonBounds.scalar_poisson_bound_of_solutions
statement:
theorem scalar_poisson_bound_of_solutions (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G) {c d : ℝ}
    (hsol : SteinSolutionBounds (poissonRate μ X) c d) :
    natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw μ (indicatorSum X)) (poissonMass (poissonRate μ X)) ≤
      d * (bOne μ X G + bTwo μ X G)

name: PaperC.V282.ScalarPoissonBounds.soft_poisson_bound_of_solutions
statement:
theorem soft_poisson_bound_of_solutions (μ : FinitePMF Ω) (X : ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : HasExactDependencyGraph μ X G)
    (good : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hgood : ∀ i ∈ good, marginal μ X i = p)
    (rate : ℝ≥0) (hrate : (rate : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * p) {c d : ℝ}
    (hsol : SteinSolutionBounds rate c d) :
    natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw μ (indicatorSum X)) (poissonMass rate) ≤
      d * goodSteinCost μ X G good p +
        c * ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p + ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, marginal μ X i)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftConditionalPoisson.average_goodSteinCost
statement:
theorem average_goodSteinCost (ν : FinitePMF Θ) (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω)
    (X : Θ → ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι) (good : Finset ι) (p : ℝ) :
    finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => goodSteinCost (μ θ) (X θ) G good p) =
      good.card * p ^ 2 +
        p * (∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
          finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => marginal (μ θ) (X θ) j)) +
        ∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
          finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => jointMarginal (μ θ) (X θ) i j)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftConditionalPoisson.lemma_b_two_average
statement:
theorem lemma_b_two_average (hStein : ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
    (ν : FinitePMF Θ) (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω) (X : Θ → ι → Ω → Bool)
    (G : SimpleGraph ι) (hdep : ∀ θ, HasExactDependencyGraph (μ θ) (X θ) G)
    (good : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hgood : ∀ θ, ∀ i ∈ good, marginal (μ θ) (X θ) i = p)
    (rate : ℝ≥0) (hrate : (rate : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * p) :
    finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ =>
      natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw (μ θ) (indicatorSum (X θ))) (poissonMass rate)) ≤
      firstSteinFactor rate *
        (good.card * p ^ 2 +
          p * (∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
            finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => marginal (μ θ) (X θ) j)) +
          ∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
            finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => jointMarginal (μ θ) (X θ) i j)) +
      zeroSteinFactor rate *
        ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => marginal (μ θ) (X θ) i))

name: PaperC.V282.SoftConditionalPoisson.weighted_environment_restriction_le
statement:
theorem weighted_environment_restriction_le (ν : FinitePMF Θ)
    (event : Θ → Prop) [DecidablePred event] (distance budget : Θ → ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ θ, distance θ ≤ budget θ) (hbudget : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ budget θ)
    {eventMass : ℝ} (hmass : 0 < eventMass) :
    finitePMFExpectation ν (fun θ => if event θ then distance θ else 0) / eventMass ≤
      finitePMFExpectation ν budget / eventMass

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.integrable_eventProbability
statement:
theorem integrable_eventProbability (ν : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω) (hμ : ∀ ω, Measurable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω))
    (event : Ω → Prop) : Integrable (fun θ => eventProbability (μ θ) event) ν

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.integrable_probability_mass
statement:
theorem integrable_probability_mass (ν : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω) (hμ : ∀ ω, Measurable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω)) (ω : Ω) :
    Integrable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω) ν

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.integrable_soft_budget
statement:
theorem integrable_soft_budget (ν : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω) (hμ : ∀ ω, Measurable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω))
    (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι) (good : Finset ι) (p : ℝ) (rate : ℝ≥0) :
    Integrable (fun θ => firstSteinFactor rate * goodSteinCost (μ θ) X G good p +
      zeroSteinFactor rate * ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, marginal (μ θ) X i)) ν

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.lemma_b_two_integral
statement:
theorem lemma_b_two_integral (hStein : ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
    (ν : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω) (hμ : ∀ ω, Measurable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω))
    (X : ι → Ω → Bool) (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (hdep : ∀ᵐ θ ∂ν, HasExactDependencyGraph (μ θ) X G) (good : Finset ι)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ θ ∂ν, ∀ i ∈ good, marginal (μ θ) X i = p)
    (rate : ℝ≥0) (hrate : (rate : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * p) :
    (∫ θ, natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw (μ θ) (indicatorSum X)) (poissonMass rate) ∂ν) ≤
      firstSteinFactor rate *
        (good.card * p ^ 2 +
          p * (∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
            ∫ θ, marginal (μ θ) X j ∂ν) +
          ∑ i ∈ good, ∑ j ∈ (closedNeighborhood G i).erase i,
            ∫ θ, jointMarginal (μ θ) X i j ∂ν) +
      zeroSteinFactor rate *
        ((Finset.univ \ good).card * p +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ good, ∫ θ, marginal (μ θ) X i ∂ν)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.measurable_finiteNatLaw
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteNatLaw (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω)
    (hμ : ∀ ω, Measurable (fun θ => (μ θ).prob ω)) (W : Ω → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun θ => finiteNatLaw (μ θ) W k)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftMeasureAverage.measurable_poissonDistance
statement:
theorem measurable_poissonDistance (μ : Θ → FinitePMF Ω)

    Measurable (fun θ => natTotalVariation (finiteNatLaw (μ θ) W) (poissonMass rate))

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.degree_exponential_le_softExponential
PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.envelope_mul_exp
statement:
theorem envelope_mul_exp (rate : ℝ≥0) (w error : ℝ) :
    intensityEnvelope rate * Real.exp (-w + error) = Real.exp (positiveLog rate - w + error)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.exp_positiveLog
statement: theorem exp_positiveLog (rate : ℝ≥0) : Real.exp (positiveLog rate) = intensityEnvelope rate

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.intensityEnvelope_le_rpow_of_positiveLog_le
PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.intensityEnvelope_mul_rpow_le
PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.one_le_intensityEnvelope
statement: theorem one_le_intensityEnvelope (rate : ℝ≥0) : 1 ≤ intensityEnvelope rate

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.positiveLog_le_cutoff_of_softExponential_le_one
PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.softBudget_le_exponentials
statement:
theorem softBudget_le_exponentials {rate : ℝ≥0}
    {diagonal defect degree relation touching bad P w error : ℝ}
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hPone : P ≤ 1) (hdegree : 0 ≤ degree)
    (hdiagonal : diagonal ≤ P) (hdefect : defect ≤ P) (htouching : touching ≤ P)
    (hrelation : relation ≤ P * ((rate : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 * (rate : ℝ)))
    (hdegreeExp : degree ≤ Real.exp (-w + error))
    (hbadExp : bad ≤ Real.exp (-w / 2 + error)) :
    softBudget rate diagonal defect degree relation touching bad ≤
      2 * softExponential rate w error + 3 * Real.exp (positiveLog rate - w + error) +
        6 * intensityEnvelope rate * P

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.soft_rate_minimum_of_budget
statement:
theorem soft_rate_minimum_of_budget {rate : ℝ≥0}
    {value diagonal defect degree relation touching bad P S w error : ℝ}
    (hvalue : value ≤ 1) (herror : 0 ≤ error) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hdegree : 0 ≤ degree)
    (hdiagonal : diagonal ≤ P) (hdefect : defect ≤ P) (htouching : touching ≤ P)
    (hrelation : relation ≤ P * ((rate : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 * (rate : ℝ)))
    (hdegreeExp : degree ≤ Real.exp (-w + error)) (hbadExp : bad ≤ Real.exp (-w / 2 + error))
    (hbudget : value ≤ softBudget rate diagonal defect degree relation touching bad)
    (habsorb : positiveLog rate ≤ w → intensityEnvelope rate * P ≤ S) :
    value ≤ 6 * min 1 (softExponential rate w error + S)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.soft_rate_rpow_of_budget
statement:
theorem soft_rate_rpow_of_budget {rate : ℝ≥0}
    {value diagonal defect degree relation touching bad N power delta w error : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ≤ delta * Real.log N)
    (hvalue : value ≤ 1) (herror : 0 ≤ error) (hdegree : 0 ≤ degree)
    (hdiagonal : diagonal ≤ N ^ power) (hdefect : defect ≤ N ^ power) (htouching : touching ≤ N ^ power)
    (hrelation : relation ≤ N ^ power * ((rate : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 * (rate : ℝ)))
    (hdegreeExp : degree ≤ Real.exp (-w + error)) (hbadExp : bad ≤ Real.exp (-w / 2 + error))
    (hbudget : value ≤ softBudget rate diagonal defect degree relation touching bad) :
    value ≤ 6 * min 1 (softExponential rate w error + N ^ (power + delta))

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.sqrt_envelope_mul_exp
statement:
theorem sqrt_envelope_mul_exp (rate : ℝ≥0) (w error : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (intensityEnvelope rate) * Real.exp (-w / 2 + error) = softExponential rate w error

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.sqrt_intensityEnvelope_eq_exp
statement:
theorem sqrt_intensityEnvelope_eq_exp (rate : ℝ≥0) :
    Real.sqrt (intensityEnvelope rate) = Real.exp (positiveLog rate / 2)

name: PaperC.V282.SoftPoissonRates.sqrt_intensityEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_intensityEnvelope_le (rate : ℝ≥0) :
    Real.sqrt (intensityEnvelope rate) ≤ intensityEnvelope rate

name: PaperC.V282.ThresholdPathEquivalence.differenceConfiguration_apply
statement:

name: PaperC.V282.ValueRelations.mem_parity_kernel_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parity_kernel_iff (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂))
    (P : (β → 𝔽₂) →ₗ[𝔽₂] (Fin 2 → 𝔽₂)) (u : RelationSpace A) :
    u ∈ LinearMap.ker (parityOnRelations A P) ↔ P u = 0

name: PaperC.V282.ValueRelations.parityNullity_le
statement:
theorem parityNullity_le (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂))
    (P : (β → 𝔽₂) →ₗ[𝔽₂] (Fin 2 → 𝔽₂)) :
    parityNullity A P ≤ relationRho A

name: PaperC.V282.ValueRelations.relationRho_le_parityNullity_add_two
statement:
theorem relationRho_le_parityNullity_add_two
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂))
    (P : (β → 𝔽₂) →ₗ[𝔽₂] (Fin 2 → 𝔽₂)) :
    relationRho A ≤ parityNullity A P + 2

name: PaperC.V282.ValueRelations.relation_weight_le_four_parity_weight_add_host
statement:
theorem relation_weight_le_four_parity_weight_add_host
    (A : V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂))
    (P : (β → 𝔽₂) →ₗ[𝔽₂] (Fin 2 → 𝔽₂)) :
    2 ^ relationRho A - 1 ≤
      4 * (2 ^ parityNullity A P - 1) +
        3 * (if relationRho A ≠ 0 then 1 else 0)

name: PaperC.V282.ValueRelations.sum_relation_weight_le_four_parity_weight_add_hosts
statement:
theorem sum_relation_weight_le_four_parity_weight_add_hosts
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → V →ₗ[𝔽₂] (β → 𝔽₂))
    (P : ι → (β → 𝔽₂) →ₗ[𝔽₂] (Fin 2 → 𝔽₂)) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (2 ^ relationRho (A i) - 1) ≤
      4 * (∑ i ∈ s, (2 ^ parityNullity (A i) (P i) - 1)) +
        3 * (s.filter fun i => relationRho (A i) ≠ 0).card
